passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Bandit Leader (Pup)
passages.content:
Bandit Leader: So the runt made it here.
Pup: Ready to talk now? I'd even be up for trying that 
"blade to your throat" idea of yours, too. Dealer's 
choice.

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Bandit Leader (Satia)
passages.content:
Bandit Leader: Heh, no biting comment this time? I wonder if your 
bite is as a bad as your bark.
Satia: There is no need. Your value is as dead as you 
yourself will soon be.

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Bandit Leader (Rowan)
passages.content:
Bandit Leader: You fucking brat... I'll pry it off your cold dead 
body.
Rowan: That does remind me. You wouldn't happen to 
have gold on you? You still owe me for that craps 
game I won.
Bandit Leader: You fucking- ...hehehe... I'm gonna enjoy this.

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Bandit Leader (Dead)
passages.content:
Bandit Leader: Fuck... So close... Just needed... to...kill the... 
brat...

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Intro
passages.content:
Rowan: Arrghh!!!
The man stumbled over his feet and he burst 
forward from the forest.

But the fall to the dirt soon turned into an elegant 
roll that returned him to his feet.
Rowan: Ah! Salvation~
Bandit Leader: It's that fucking brat!? Why now of all times?!
Ivan: Don't tell me...?
Satia: Dammit! That cretin... We were distracted.
Rowan: I, a most humbled traveling bard, am at your 
service.
Pup: B- Bard?! You have a mini army after you!
Rowan: Everyone's a critic these days.
Ivan: So you're what they're after, eh?

He seems to be a fair source of information, at 
least. Pup. Satia. Keep the boy safe.
Win Condition: Defeat the Bandit Leader. 

Lose Condition: Anyone gets killed.
Win Condition: Defeat the Bandit Leader. 

Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan or Ivan die

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Thief Steals
passages.content: The chest contents have been stolen!

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Tut1
passages.content:
With a proper party in tow, it's time we talked 
about mechanics like the convoy.

The convoy is the inventory for items that do not 
fit in individual character inventories.

Pup, the main character, has access to this at all 
times in battle. Other characters in spaces next to
him can also access it.
The camp menu between chapters will later let you 
freely move items and weapons between the 
convoy and characters. Make sure to use it!

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Tut2
passages.content:
With a few good slashes and stabs at the enemy, 
you've probably noticed that the number next to
each characters' weapons have went down.
This is called weapon durability. Weapons have 
limited uses, and you should take care not to burn 
through a good weapon too quickly.
At the same time, you cannot just neglect 
attacking. Along with experience, characters also 
have a Weapon Rank.
There are 5 weapons ranks (E->A). Every use 
increases a unit's experience with the weapon, and 
higher rankings let you equip better weapons.

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Win
passages.content:
What remained of the bandits scattered in a panic.
Pup: They're getting away!
Ivan: It's fine. With the head cut off, they'll be no major 
trouble any time soon.
Satia: I do hope we gave them a few lengthy nightmares 
to keep them company, at least.
Pup: Right...
Pup: There's still something we need to do, right? Or do 
we already have the full story?
Ivan: The boy said some interesting stuff before, but due 
diligence is half the job.
Pup: Where is he anyways?
My head swiveled to find the man from before 
squatting over the dead body of the bandit leader.
Pup: Forget something?
Rowan: ...
Pup: Ilvanis to... bard man!
Pup: Of course... this was already one of those days. We 
don't even have your name yet, do we?
Satia: True. I do not believe we had a chance.
Rowan: Haha... Serendipitous, isn't it?
Rowan: (Clears throat)
The man spun on his heel all the way to a standing 
position. He found himself looking down on the 
smaller Pup.
Pup: H- Hey... A little close.
Rowan: ...
Rowan: My greatest condolences! Introductions are more 
than just a formality, of course.
Rowan: You may refer to me as Rowan. I am a traveling 
bard from the Kingdom of Cartenan.
Rowan: My journey brought me to Rabaneau so
I could offer my services in aiding
the weary soldiers.
Pup: So basically what we already knew. A bad bard that 
pissed off a group of bandits.
Rowan: A bit unfair of an assessment, do you not think? 
Perhaps a ballad would change your tune?
Pup: Ah, I think it might be your tune that's the issue. 
What with the bandits wanting to kill you.
Rowan: You do wound me, good sir.
Rowan: If anything, my song soothed their aching hearts... 
after I won their life savings in a game of chance.
Pup: That's... probably something we should talk to you 
in more detail about... later.
Pup: Anyways, it's nice to meet you. My name is Anton 
Baranov.
Pup: Along with my father, Ivan, and a comrade, Satia, 
we are all members of the Nightless Crow 
Mercenary Corp.
Rowan: A pleasure.
Pup: We'll see

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Ivan → Rowan
passages.content:
Rowan: It's good to see a friendly face.
Ivan: Everything's relative, I suppose.

Your current value, relative to us,
relies on what you know, after all.
Rowan: P- Perhaps I can also offer a melody for your 
troubles?

passages.name: CH1- Nightless Crows - Pup → Rowan
passages.content:
Pup: How did this turn out this way?
Rowan: Snake eyes.
Rowan: I am inclined to think their pursuit turned into an 
obsession after I won against their commander in a 
high stakes gamble.
Pup: I didn't need another reason to want to kill the 
guy. How ridiculous.

passages.name: Ch 1's Supply Run - P1
passages.content:
Pup: *Sigh*... *sigh*...
My hand gripped the sword even tighter, and my 
heavy panting subsided while I collected myself.

The figure across from me wore armor from head 
to toe and reflected my own visage.
Armored Figure: Hmph.
I smiled in response. This would be the last blow.
Pup: ...!
With a step forward, the heavy mail felt like 
feathers to my mind and the sword like any other.

His step matched mine and the two curtains of 
steel rallied forth towards a barrage of power 
to end it once and for all.
And so, steel came unto steel, until a winner 
was decided.

It was...
Pup: (Was...?)
Pup: Urgh!
I squirmed as a heavy weight entrapped my body. 

It wasn't long before my senses were jolted 
entirely to consciousness by a tongue swiping 
itself across my face.
Jakson: *Bark*!
Pup: G- Good afternoon to you, too.
In the corner of my vision, I spotted another figure 
to the side of my bedding. This one was 
positioned like he just dropped something.
Norde: You're awake. Good.

We're busier than normal with today's mission. You 
are now tasked with purchasing supplies in town 
for the corp at large.
Pup: What? Since when did we do that solo?
Norde: Jakson has volunteered to accompany you.
Pup: The... dog...? You're not serious, are you?
Norde: Try to finish up before the evening meal. We'll 
be questioning the prisoner at that point.
Pup: W- Wait!
Pup: I guess this is why we're called the 'Nightless 
Crows'... No rest for the weary.
Jakson: *Bark*!
Pup: And you're just excited for dinner? Can't say I 
blame you.
Pup: Might as well get on it.

...
Pup: Jakson... boy... move, please?
Jakson panted out a few chords that almost 
sounded like a chuckle to me. He did eventually 
get off me.
Pup: We could probably hang some of the 
groceries around your neck.
Jakson: *Whine*...
Pup: No complaints. We both know I can't carry a 
week's worth of food for a dozen plus people by 
myself.
Jakson: *Bark*!
The camp was full of a hustle and bustle as we 
made out way through it.
Sati

passages.name: Ch 1's Supply Run - Choice Part
passages.content:
[Choice]:  Ask for a bulk discount. / Try to leverage your history here. / Feign disinterest to get a discount.
Pup: I would love to buy it, but... I'm a bit short on the 
remaining funds.
Pup: I did buy quite a lot from you already. You wouldn't 
by chance be willing to give a little discount?
Pup: It'd certainly do a lot to make me remember you 
and want to do business with you in the future.
Jakson: *Whine*...
Merchant: Hmm... Well...

I guess it can't hurt. It's not that large of 
a discount.
Pup: T- Thank you!
Pup: I would love to buy it from such a lovely lady, but... 
I'm a bit short on the remaining funds.
Pup: You said you've been getting a lot of my corp 
buying from you lately, right?
Pup: We've been buying a lot... so maybe you'd consider 
giving me a discount on it?
Jakson: *Whine*...
Merchant: Hmm... Well...

I guess it can't hurt. It's not that large of 
a discount.
Pup: Really? Thank you.
Pup: It's a bit much. Looks like a quality product, but I 
don't think I can realistically buy it.

Maybe if it was a little cheaper, but... Oh well.
Pup: Come on, Jakson. We should start heading back.
Merchant: Haha... If you want a discount, then why not just 
ask for it?
Pup: I... uh... mean... I can't afford it so I... shouldn't...
Merchant: You never know what an opportunity can provide 
you until you've at least tried, it after all.

With all the business your group has given me, I 
can give a little bit of a discount.
Pup: I... thank you.
The nice merchant packaged up my purchases and 
helped me hang some of it around Jakson's neck 
like a collar, much to his displeasure.
Merchant: Perhaps this is a bit presumptuous of me, but you 
remind me a bit of my own child.
Pup: I... Pardon?
Merchant: Always trying their best. Trying to live up to their 
expectations. Trying to be a hero like father.
Pup: ...
Merchant: I refer specifically to my own child. You just feel 
like a go getter, too.

Haha... apologies. I jumped ahead a bit much 
there.
Pup: I... won't preten

passages.name: CH2 - Intro to ch2
passages.content:
Telegraph: *Click* *click* *click*
Pup: ...
I took a sip of water from my mug. The 
clicking sound stopped.

With a glance to the side, I saw my fellows as 
calm as ever.
Pup: You two... okay?
Norde: I am fine.
Satia: Is something wrong?
Pup: (No one else is getting annoyed by that?)
Pup: No, nothing's wrong. I just-
Telegraph: *Click* *click* *click*
Pup: I- I'm just going to go check on my father...
Satia: ...
Satia: Do you think something happened?
Norde: Something inane, I imagine.
Ivan: And how much money did you win off them? Or at 
least claim to?
Rowan: Enough to treat myself and a lady friend to a 
magnificent meal that night.
Ivan: Again... Specifics, please...
Rowan: That would require me to have counted it.
Rowan: What I received was... more like a burlap sack. With 
a money symbol painted on it.
Ivan: ...
Rowan: I assumed he had previous problems with losing it.
Ivan: ...
Pup: Hello, you two. Going well?
After stepping into their view, I pulled up a chair 
and seated myself.
Ivan: ...
Pup: That bad?
Rowan: I would accommodate you as a new arrival, but...
Rowan: ...alas, I am somewhat tied up at this time.
He waved at me. There was still rope tied tightly 
around his wrists.
Pup: I may regret this, but is there anything I can do to 
help?
Ivan: Doubtful.
Pup: Not even something minor?
Pup: (I need to find an excuse to stay over here. At 
least for a little while.)
Ivan tilted his head in thought.
Pup: What about... if I...

...?
From the corner of my eye, I saw a man in a regal, 
fanciful outfit badgering the barkeep.

After a few seconds, their gaze turned towards us.
Pup: ...?!
Fancy Man: Good day! Good day! Might you be the leader of 
the Dayless Doves?
Pup: You mean Nightless Crows?
Fancy Man: Yes, yes. Whichever.

Now, to answer the question...?
Ivan: ...
Ivan looked him over. After a few seconds to  
consider if he was a threat, he relaxed and then 
spoke.
Ivan: Yes. I am.
Fancy Man: Perfect! We're in need of a good few dirtied hands.

I am from th

passages.name: CH2 - After pg13
passages.content:
Norde: ...and who was it that you had this dinner with?
Rowan: Her name?
Rowan: What was it...? Linda? Lucia? Luna?
Pup: I wonder if she even remembers your name herself.
Norde: Hmm... A better question then. Did she say where 
she was from?
Pup: Why would that matter?
Rowan: Alas, our pleasantries did not expand to such a 
topic.
Norde: Had you met her before this encounter?
Rowan: It was our first meeting.
Norde: ...
Norde: Had anyone approached you about your actions 
during these events? In any capacity?
Rowan: Ah, there it is.

That... that is the real question, is it not?

Did our beloved bard involve himself in grander 
designs within the chaos incited?
Norde: Hm... 

Then you understand well enough.
Rowan: I cannot say anything stood out to me.

Mayhaps you deign me worthy of your worries, 
though? Something may spark a memory within.
Norde and Rowan seemed to stare at each other 
awkwardly until I felt the need to speak up.
Pup: Norde... What is he talking about? Is there
something here I'm not aware of?
Rowan: I imagine an extension of the war.
Rowan: What of it, then? A new wide scale invasion? Into
Nolvanus? Into Rabaneau?

Or perhaps a sprint across a border for an 
Oathbreaker?
Rowan: Ah. Might you be working for the Covenant?
Norde: We are not. We are working for the governors of 
the Rabaneau region we came from.
Pup: Oathbreaker? Aren't those all held in protection by 
the Covenant?
Norde: It is irrelevant. The boy just wants to distract with 
dramatics.
Norde: Again. Have you been approached by anyone that 
seems suspicious at all?
Rowan: Heh.
Rowan: As I said, I have no awareness of such an event.
Norde: Very well. We had a few men checking your story 
at the restaurant.

We'll know if you are trustworthy upon our return.
Rowan: ...
With a scuff of the chair, Norde was on his feet. He 
reached over to place his notes in the group's 
supply pack.
Rowan: Ah, have your comrades returned?
My father and Satia had headed out to conduct 
a patrol.
Norde:

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Commander (Pup)
passages.content:
Pup: Tsk... I've never fought soldiers before.
Pup: Don't blame me for what's about to happen. Blame 
your superior officer for this stupid move of their's.

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Commander (Ivan)
passages.content:
Ivan: This was supposed to be a simple job.
Ivan: I'm not one to leave the job half done, though. 
Prepare yourself.

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Commander (Rowan)
passages.content:
Rowan: Why? Why would they invade?
Rowan: *Sigh*... The fools...
Rowan: For the sake of everyone's happiness. I will do what 
I must.

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Commander (Norde)
passages.content:
Norde: So they are an organized army unit, in the end... 
This will complicate things.
Norde: Perhaps it could serve as a good test of my training, 
at least.

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Intro
passages.content:
Norde: ...
Pup: S- Stay here. I'll go check what's going-
I turned to see Rowan reaching towards the 
supply pack on the table. He pulled out his 
heirloom. The one that allowed magic.
Pup: ...?!
Pup: H- How did you get free?!
The ropes that were around his wrists were strewn 
across the edge of the table.
Rowan: Ah, are you still here?
Rowan: Then, please allow me to assist. I believe you'll 
require my skills.
Pup: T- The ropes were tight. We... checked that 
recently.
My hands hovered around the grip of my sword.
Rowan: ...

Hm hm... I wonder how you'd react?
Rowan fastened his heirloom necklace around his 
neck and then pulled up his sleeve to reveal 
a bracelet.
It was a bracelet with a small antique key 
connected to it.
Rowan: Eul'avais. Have you heard of it?

It is... 

...an Oathbreaker.
Pup: What?!

(An... Oathbreaker?! Of THE Oathbreakers?!)
Pup: (Then... he's broken the oath to the Goddess?!)

You are... a corrupted soul?
Rowan: I'm sure your concern for my purity would make 
the Covenant proud.
Rowan: Alas, the laws of the Goddess can be quite 
inconvenient at times.
Rowan: Like with certain overeager chastity devices...
Pup: Overeager... w- what now?
Rowan: Such purity yourself. We make a fine pair of yin 
and yang.
Rowan: An Oathbreaker can create miracles and curses 
that defy the laws of the Goddess's domain.

Eul'avais is capable of undoing any restraint. 
Bindings, locks, and beyond.
Rowan spun his wrist as if to showcase the item 
in his possession.
Rowan: Did you notice your friend locked the door behind 
him?
Pup: (What?! Goddess damn you, Norde! I'm not here 
to be babysat!)
Rowan: If you wish to help him...
Rowan: ...well, if you do, I will note that time is not likely 
on our side.
Norde: Bandits... Pillaging, maybe? Even civilians are 
distracted with the festivities, so there is a
sick sense to that logic.
Pup: F- Fine. But if you do as much as raise your hand 
against a single one of us...
Rowan: I wouldn't dare. You are much too... pecul

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Turn 1
passages.content:
Rowan: If we're to reach him in time, we need to get 
through the locked door.
If Rowan, or any unit with a key or the skill 
"Unlock" move next to a door, they can 
unlock it. The same applies to chests.
Keys are 1 use only, while Rowan's Oathbraker has 
unlimited uses. 

At the same time, only Rowan can make use of the 
Eul'avais he now has in his inventory.

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Rescued Norde
passages.content:
Norde: Why is the... person of interest... no longer bound? 
Anton, did you release him?
Pup: What? No, he-
Rowan: I was able to break free myself.
Rowan: There is no need to worry. I simply wish to help.
Rowan: You kind folk are my best bet to not be drawn and 
quartered during my next foray into Rabaneau, 
after all.
Norde: ...
Pup: (We can deal with his situation after everyone else 
is accounted for.)
Pup: You're safe. Now where are the others?
Norde: Yes, let's focus on that.
Norde: Groups of bandits seem to be swarming from the 
east.

They're taking advantage of the celebration to 
loot the surrounding areas. Be alert.
Rowan: Ah, is that the chattering of hooves?
Satia: There are so many of them.
Ivan: It may very well be more than one mercenary corp.
Ivan: Might they be working together?
Jakson: ...?
Jakson's head perked up as he looked across the 
field.
Pup: Is that...?
Norde: It is.
Norde raised his hand to create a signal that 
Ivan replicated.
Norde: Time to regroup.
Ivan: What's your situation?
Norde: We've neutralized what bandits we've come across. 
Others have likely passed the encampment already.
Satia: Our team identified small roving groups heading 
westward.
Norde: The fort had an emergency telegraph.

We should...

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - After enemies appear
passages.content:
Pup: More?
Rowan: Wait... But these are...?
Satia: Soldiers? Where from, though?
Ivan: ...?!
Ivan: *Exhale*...
Ivan: Those... Those are Imperial army uniforms. They're 
from Nolvanus.
Pup: What? I thought... Wasn't it bandits that were 
looting?!
Norde: We need to send a message to Lockhart.
Ivan: Aim for the enemy commander. Disrupt their chain 
of command so we can focus on getting a message 
out.
Win Condition: Defeat the enemy commander.

Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan, Norde or Ivan die.
Win Condition: Defeat the enemy commander.

Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan,or Ivan die.

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Tut2
passages.content:
Time for some rescuing! ...What do you mean 
Norde was already rescued? That's actually not 
what I mean.
There is a mechanic in the game called "Rescue".
With it, cavalry and flying type units can shield and 
carry another unit.
It uses up turns, but it can also help move less 
mobile units faster across maps. Both cavalry and 
fliers can also move after picking up the ally.

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Win con2
passages.content:
Norde: Without their commander, the soldiers have begun 
to scatter.
Pup: Right, if we have a second, then...
I looked over at Rowan. He seemed to be 
dedicated despite his earlier attitude.
Pup: (I guess the Oathbreaker thing can wait...
for now...)
Ivan: It's enough of opening to act, then? 
We should hurry with a message.
Pup: (Right, priorities.)
Ivan: Rowan, correct?
Rowan: Y- Yes?
Ivan: The telegraph. Can you send a message?
Rowan: I can make an attempt.
Rowan placed himself next to the telegraph 
transmitter and held the charm on his necklace 
tightly.
After a deep breath, Rowan began tapping away 
at the device.
Rowan: Huh?

There's... no resistance?
Norde: Dammit... The line's been cut.
Pup: So this... Is this all coordinated?
Ivan stood there for several seconds both 
thinking and calming himself.
Ivan: We'll have to ride for Lockhart.

We've no time to waste.
Ruslan: There it is. Peeking out over the horizon... 
Lockhart.
Steel Wolf: ...

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Place Event
passages.content:
Eve: Light! So much brilliant light!
There was a girl with stars practically swimming 
around her head. She was hugging the floor.
Pup: Uh... Are you okay? How long were you in there?
Eve: I don't know. It felt like a year.
Pup: It's sort of a bad time for this. Can you get out of 
here? The town isn't too far away.
Eve: The town...

I don't wanna.
Pup: I didn't realize it was a choice.
Pup: Why are you even here?
Eve: I woke up in a field a bit ago. I'm a bit fuzzy on 
how, but after that I went to town.
Eve: "Be a waitress, it's just like farming" they said.

Well, as a farmer, at least I didn't get locked in a 
prison cell as a prank!
Eve: I think...

They really weren't helpful with my patchy 
memories either.
Pup: This place is just getting progressively more 
dangerous, you know?
Eve: Can I stick around with you nice people? I don't 
want to go back to that town.
Eve: You need a farmer? I've done that before.
Pup: We. Are. On. A. Battlefield.
Eve: Then I can try to fight! I might not be great, but I 
don't think I'd be a hindrance.
Pup: This isn't how saving people is supposed to go...
Pup: I can't control you. Just try to not get hurt, 
please?
Eve: Right!

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Satia → Rowan
passages.content:
Satia: That necklace...
Rowan: Necklace...? Ah, right.
Rowan: Given the dire circumstances, it seemed only 
appropriate for me to use whatever I could to help.
Satia: Help... who exactly?
Rowan: No need to fret. I am on your side.
Satia: Just remember that if you give me reason to regret 
you having that...
Satia: I'll fix it by ensuring there isn't a neck left for it to 
hang on.
Rowan: I... understand...

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Pup → Jakson
passages.content:
Pup: There you are, boy. Everything go well while you 
were out with the patrol?
I gave Jakson a pet on the head.
Jakson: *Concerned bark*!
Pup: Yeah, we'll take them out. You and me together.
Pup: I'm sure I can get you a nice treat if you try extra 
hard, too.
Jakson: *Happy bark*!

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Ivan → Rowan
passages.content:
Ivan: I heard you can encode telegraph messages.
Rowan: In a limited capacity, yes.
Ivan: Good. We may need to rely on you.
Rowan: Are you not going to give me the evil eye like your 
comrades?
Ivan: Do you want me to? Give me a reason, then.
Rowan: Message... taken.

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Pup → Norde
passages.content:
Norde: How did you get past the locked door?
Pup: I... uh...
Pup: (Is this really the time? I'll just keep it on the 
downlow for now.)
Pup: The locks are old and can be knocked open easily.
Norde: Hm...
Pup: Hey! Before I forget... You forgot something.
Pup: Missing your axe? Feeling a little lonely out here 
with just a lance?
Norde: Hm... Thank you, I suppose.

passages.name: CH2 (Battle) - Ivan → Norde
passages.content:
Ivan: Is Pup okay?
Norde: Anton seems to be faring well enough despite the 
scenario.
Ivan: Thank you for looking after him.
Norde: It's no problem. He is your son, in the end.

passages.name: CH3 - Intro
passages.content:
As we saddled our horses two a piece, we began 
our long ride westward for Lockhart.

We were not the first to make that journey this 
day.

First, civilians aplenty made the daytrip into the city 
for the birthday festivities.
Next, bandits began their pillaging. They pushed 
their way further and further into the state's 
borders.
By our best estimation... This was a trap. It was a 
distraction.
As the bandits were causing chaos, the Nolvanus 
Imperial Military slipped through the border.
They took strategic location after strategic location. 
Communications lines were cut.

Even if a message had been delivered in time, it 
would've been about the bandits' incursion over 
any military one.
We rushed as much as we could to the crown 
jewel city state of the West Auran Alliance: 
Lockhart.
It was only a hope that we would make it in time 
to make a difference.

passages.name: CH3 - After map
passages.content:
Rowan: Fighting has broken out...
Pup: We're too late?
Ivan: Too late to warn the city, yes.
Norde: Should we fall back, then? The mission is a failure.
Ivan: ...
Pup: What?
Pup: (We can't just leave the city to this fate.)
I jumped off the horseback and started towards 
the city proper.
Pup: We should stay and fight!
Norde: Fight what? For what? We are not an army of 
Lockhart, or of any kind.
Ivan: ...
Pup: I- I...
Pup: No. We're not an army...
My shoulders slumped, and my grip on the sword 
handle faltered.
Rowan: Mayhap it is not my place to say...
Rowan: But there are civilians caught between the blades. 
Even more so because of the celebrations.
Pup: Even if we're not... we're here now..
Pup: We can at least try to help keep the people safe.
Ivan: ...
Norde: ...
Norde approached me. He was uncomfortably and 
intimidatingly close.
Norde: ...
Pup: I- It's... It's the right thing to do.
Norde: ...
Norde: That it is.
Norde: A hero's gambit, have you?
Pup: Y- Yeah...
Pup: (Yeah. Like a proper hero.)
I breathed a deep breath as the tension from 
speaking up was let loose.

passages.name: CH3 - Pg4 Satia Alive
passages.content:
Satia: Ivan, what was it that Harold used to say all the 
time when he led the Crows?
Satia: "A job's not worth doing if you're not willing to go 
all the way"?
Ivan: Something like that, yes. And you take it as a creed 
for the Crows?
Norde: Sir, shall we map out a plan of action?
Ivan: Hmph. I'm not heartless. Best to not leave the job 
half done, then?
Satia: I think the old boss would be happy if he could see 
this moment.

passages.name: CH3 - Pg4 Satia Alive
passages.content:
Norde: Sir, shall we map out a plan of action?
Ivan: Best to not leave the job half done, then? Didn't 
Harold used to say that?
Norde: Like a mantra.

passages.name: CH3 - Contiunue
passages.content:
Ivan: That's that, then.

We've been hired to protect Lockhart, her 
princess, and her people.
Ivan: Shall we?
Pup: Definitely!

(We can do this. I can.)
I tightened my grip on my sword.
Ivan: Just... try not to be reckless, please.
Norde: We can start by...
Norde began to quickly set out a rudimentary 
plan for us to follow.
Pup: Right... right...
Rowan: ...
Rowan: ...!?
Rowan: Mi-!

passages.name: Ch 2's Supply Run - Talk
passages.content:
Merchant: Hmm... *scratches chin*

It looks like the rush from the birthday celebrations 
have died out.

Guess they must've made their way to Lockhart by 
now.
Merchant: Ngh... Eh... My back.
The merchant started to shuffle through his wares 
as he prepared to close up shop for the day.
Merchant: Hm?
He stopped mid stretch, and his head tilted to look 
behind him.
Merchant: Uh... what?
It was...
Pup: H-Hey. Could...
Pup: What did you want again, Norde?
There were two people saddled on a horse.
Norde: A sweet potato.
One was a stern looking man that seemed to be a 
mix of Taikolyn and Einlyn races.
Pup: Right. What about everyone else...?
The other was a young man with a smallish stature.
Norde: Must I do your job for you?
Pup: N- No! I got it.
Pup: Sir, please. One sweet potato... an apple... and... 
and... two loafs of peach bread?
Pup: Is that even right...?
Norde: I... do not know.

passages.name: Ch 2's Supply Run - Sat Alive
passages.content: Pup: Satia's gonna kill me if we got the orders wrong...

passages.name: Ch 2's Supply Run - Sat Death
passages.content:
Pup: The others are gonna be angry if we got the 
orders wrong...

passages.name: Ch 2's Supply Run - New Event
passages.content:
The merchant stood there, still in mid-stretch, and 
looked at the two in bewilderment.
Pup: Sir?!
The boy was holding out money.
Merchant: What's happening now?
Pup: We're in a bit of a hurry. Can we buy the food or 
not?!
Merchant: Hm... I suppose.
The merchant headed over to pack up the items, 
though he did so at a relaxed pace.
Norde: I knew we should've tried the next stall over.
Pup: Come on, come on, come on.
Merchant: ...

*Scratches chin*

Here you go.
The sack of food was snatched up at a feverish 
pace and quickly replaced with coin.
Within a few blinks of the eye, the horse had 
already started to fade from distance.

Though one thing could be heard like a quiet 
whisper in the wind...
Pup: THANK YOU!
Merchant: Hmm... *scratches chin*

You're welcome.
After a relaxed pivot back to the stall, the 
merchant continued to pack his wares.

passages.name: CH4 - Scene 1
passages.content:
Villager: What do you think it's about?
Other Villager: I wonder if it has to do with the smoke coming 
from the north a couple days ago?
Another Villager: *Yawn*... Who cares? I just want it to end so I 
can get back to helping with the farm.
A crowd gathered around a small stage.

Creaks accompanied a dip in the chatter of the 
crowd. A figure soon stood atop the stage for 
all to see and hear.
Mayor: Now, now. Calm down everyone. 
The announcement won't come any quicker.
Other Villager: Does this have to do with Lockhart!?
Mayor: *Sigh*... What did I just say?

We are translating the finalized message from the 
telegraph network as we speak.
Charlotte: What did he say? Was it something about 
Lockhart?
Mariel: They haven't started yet, I think?
In the recesses of a darkened alley, two sets of 
ears did their best to listen in from beyond the 
edge of the crowd.
Charlotte: Tsk. If only I could hear it less muffled.
Mariel: That's probably a chance that we wouldn't want 
to take...
Charlotte: I know, I know... But still...
Mayor: ...there it is... begin soon...
Charlotte: I heard that, at least.
Mayor: Here we are, then. Let's get started.
The mayor cleared his throat.
Mayor: "Citizens of our sister city within our Alliance..."

"We of Lockhart apologize for any confusion the 
recent disturbance may have caused. It would 
appear that..."
Mariel: I think he's claiming the same stuff that the 
Imperial General claimed the other day.
Charlotte: Bastards...
Other Villager: Another power struggle in one of the big cities?
Another Villager: *Yawn*... Was just a matter of time.
Villager: Lockhart has been pretty stable, though? I don't 
recall them ever having a leadership shuffle before.

Not in my lifetime, at least.
The chatter of the crowd started to deafen the 
mayor's speech. But...
Mayor: "We are pleased to inform you that the root cause 
of the disturbance has been identified and 
removed."
"As it stands..."
But a few words managed to cut through the noise 
as the

passages.name: CH4 - Scene 2
passages.content:
Pup: ...
My eyes opened, but I didn't move.

With a turn of my head, my eyes looked over to 
see my father sleeping in the other bed. 

The restlessness that had plagued him prior was 
a thing of the past.
Pup: Argh...
Some hair had found itself surprising me as it fell 
into my eyeline. I quickly brushed it aside.
Pup: *Sigh*
With an exasperated sigh, I found myself placing 
my arm over my eyes to block out the light.

I thought back on to the event that happened a 
couple days prior: The attack on Lockhart.

Ever since then, our group had stayed at an inn 
south of the city. We didn't have a plan, but my 
father's injuries made moving him dangerous.
Pup: Why?

(Why did this happen? Why would the Goddess let 
this...)
Pup: ...the Goddess...?
A memory popped into my head.
Rowan: Alas, the laws of the Goddess can be quite 
inconvenient at times.

An Oathbreaker can create miracles and curses that 
defy the laws of the Goddess's domain.
Rowan spun his wrist as if to showcase the item in 
his possession.
Rowan: Eul'avais is capable of undoing any restraint. 
Bindings, locks, and beyond.
Pup: I... almost forgot about that.
In the quiet, I could hear the faint sound of 
plucked strings from beyond the room's door.
Pup: ...and I never told anyone...
Within my next breath, I found my feet touching 
the floor and guiding me to the sound I heard.
As deftly as I could, my steps led to me to a 
doorway to the inn's lobby.
Pup: Hm...
The plucks of strings proved to be louder, and I 
peaked around the corner to see Rowan, Norde 
and others lazing about without much to do.
Pup: (How to approach this? The man... well...)
Pup: Hmm...

(Breaking the Oath to the Goddess is one thing... 
We also found him in suspicious circumstances 
when we first came across him.)
(He and Norde talked about an escalation of the 
war between Nolvanus and Rabaneau, too.)
Pup: (Could he really have had a role in that...? I could 
imagine someone who'd be willing to use an
Oathbreaker to do that, but...)

passages.name: CH4 - Scene 3
passages.content:
My father grabbed a seat as we reluctantly agreed 
to put off dealing with Rowan until we were in 
safer waters.
Charlotte expedited the conversation to her own 
news from the town square.
Charlotte: And with that, we would appreciate an escort to 
the town's limits.

Afterwards, we can be on our way and you on 
yours.
Ivan: Hmm... I've given this some thought.
Ivan bit down on some meat the inn was serving. 
After such a long rest, he appeared famished.
Ivan: The Crows used to have a saying... "A job's not 
worth doing if you're not willing to go all the way", 
I believe.
Ivan: I think I've come to want to live up to that, as the 
current leader.
Satia: *Giggle*, how eerily familiar?
Ivan: At least I do. The rest of you...
Ivan turned towards the other members of the 
Nightless Crows.
Ivan: You're free to return to the rest of the group 
when we have safe passage that way.
Mariel: You really don't have to. This much is plenty.
Pup: I definitely think we should keep helping them.
Pup: (After what happened...)
Rowan: I think it is a beautiful sentiment.
Pup: You don't get an opinion.
Norde: I had already written to the rest of our comrades 
with the assumption we would do as much.
Satia: Was there a doubt that we'd want to help?
Charlotte: I...
Ivan: Plus, how are you going to pay us without the
key to your vaults of riches?
Charlotte: Heh...
Charlotte: Alright. Alright. We shall see this through together, 
then?
Mariel: Thank you... All of you...
Jakson: *Reassuring bark*...
Jakson nuzzled up against Mariel's leg.
Mariel: You, too.
Mariel: We can... make things right.
Norde: Then shall we make our escape as soon as we can?
Ivan: Best not to move without a plan.
Ivan bit another large bite out of the meat.
Ivan: ...or an empty stomach.
Pup: I honestly don't think I've seen you so ravenous 
before, Dad...
Norde: Then, as to a plan, where are we headed? I 
imagine the two options are Rabaneau or New 
Aureria?
Charlotte: Actually...
Charlotte: I don't think New Aureria

passages.name: CH4 - Scene 4
passages.content:
After we grabbed our gear, the innkeeper let us 
leave via the backdoor.

While Charlotte and Mariel weren't likely to be 
recognized by locals easily, we also didn't want 
to draw attention to ourselves for no reason.
Ivan: Ms. Charlotte, go with Norde. You will likely find him 
quite reliable.

Ms. Mariel, you can go with Pup. You can trust him 
as well.
Ivan: As for our companion no one trusts... 
I'll pair with him.
Rowan: We shall have a lovely, uneventful stroll, then?
Pup: Trusting me with the important task?
Ivan: ...
Ivan's hand landed on the top of my head.
Ivan: Please... Just stay safe.
Pup: No need to worry about me just because I've got 
this illness. 

I can do still hold my own in a-
Ivan: Anton.
Pup: I...
Pup: Okay. I will do my best.
Ivan: Thank you.
Broken off into pairs with each of our guests 
getting an escort, we each took a different route 
out of the town.
My father walked away from me with a back that 
felt like I hadn't seen it in a long time. Like a view I 
hadn't seen since I was young.
Pup: (It doesn't matter what barrier I need to get over. 
If I can't... then there's no point.)
I turned towards Mariel and we moved to our 
route.
Rowan and Ivan walked along the perimeter of the 
town square.
Ivan: Rowan, correct?
Rowan: Forgetful? You've asked as much before.
Rowan: The answer is yes, by the way.
Ivan: When we have ourselves at a safe distance, you 
can make yourself scarce.

Otherwise we will likely be obligated to hand you 
over to the Covenant.
Rowan: ...

I think...
As Rowan spoke the words, his eyes drifted to a 
chest with some soldiers walking away from it.
Rowan: I think we could stand to have some insurance for 
our escape.
Ivan: I could certainly get behind that, but... 
What do you have in mind?
Rowan: I've an inkling of an idea.
Norde and Charlotte crossed the town via the port 
side outskirts.
Norde: Nolvanus has no navy, correct?
Charlotte: Yeah. They don't have many ports that aren't 
frozen over most of the year.
Norde:

passages.name: CH4 - Scene 5
passages.content:
............................
Pup: Ugh...
My groggy eyes opened to the sound of horse 
hoofs clomping on the ground.
Pup: We need to... help...?!
Charlotte: Finally awake?
Norde: Anton, are you okay to walk?
Pup: I'm fine. Where's my father? We need to go help.
Norde: It is... too late.
Norde: Ivan and the bard decided to set off some small 
scale explosions in town.

While it served as a distraction during our 
absconsion from it, going back would only 
find the soldiers on high alert.
Pup: ...What?
Rowan: ...
Norde: We must place our faith in Ivan, for now.
Norde: We'll make to Rabaneau, like he was suggesting, 
and wait for him there.
Charlotte: Wait, but I-
Norde: We are past the point of decision making. A voyage 
to Cartenan can come later.
Pup: But we need-
Norde: Anton. We are past the point of decision making.
Pup: ...
Mariel: Hey, everyone... I think there's... soldiers ahead?
All of our eyes shifted to see a small group of 
soldiers on the horizon. They hadn't appeared to 
notice us.
Norde: Princesses, what is along this path to the south?
Norde said as much as he pulled us out of their line 
of sight.
Charlotte: More villages. They're probably searching them, 
too.
Norde: Vigilant we will be, then. Do not let yourself be 
distracted.

Be ready for whatever may turn the corner in front 
of us.
Pup: (Goddess... dammit... I have no choice, don't I?)
I tightly held the locket I was given.

passages.name: CH5 - Scene 1
passages.content:
I took the lead as we exited the town we had 
been staying in.

With a strong step forward, I was officially on our 
path to Ranakstown.
Pup: *Deep breath*...
I slapped my cheeks a few times with vigor.
Pup: LET'S GO!!!
Rowan: Huzzah!
Pup: Not you.
Pup: Actually, why don't you just stay
behind?
Rowan: Did our venerable auditor not give me some well of 
credibility to pull from?
Pup: Who knows? Maybe you mind controlled him with 
your Oathbreaker.
Rowan: Ah, such abuse.
Rowan: If you keep it up, I may even come to enjoy it~
Pup: Can you not?
Charlotte: What are you supposed to be? A morning person?
Rowan: I am a man of many hours.

From day to night to the waning of either, I am 
gladly at your disposal.
Rowan: ...for services of any vice that invites your parlay~
Charlotte: Flirting at the first opportunity from a nearly 
complete stranger? I feel at home already.
Rowan: Mayhap we not have traveled together for long...
Rowan: But our relationship feels like one casted in the 
steel of days past.
Charlotte: Oh no. My loins. They burn.

Quick! Take this!
Charlotte dumped her pack into Rowan's hands.
Rowan: What is-
Rowan: Grk!

T- This weight...
Charlotte: I've always been a big fan of the vice of sloth. 
Thanks for offering your services.
Rowan: This is... not exactly... what I...
Pup: Huh...
Charlotte: What's the staring for? You want to take an extra 
load, too?
Pup: No, just... You're not what I was expecting of a 
princess.
Charlotte: What were you expecting?
Pup: Well... I used to hear fairy tales about princesses. 
Saved by heroes and the like.
Pup: Where they were graceful, kind, elegant...
Charlotte: Do tell me all about how I don't live up to the 
standard.
Pup: Oh! Don't worry. You're no slouch. You're very 
pretty and... well...
Charlotte: Hah. So this was a poor excuse to flirt in the end?
I shook my head in objection, but Charlotte just 
giggled at the action.
Charlotte: You're not the first to try and compare me to a 
proper princess.
Pup: "Proper"? Do

passages.name: CH5 - Scene 2
passages.content:
Nora: ...they'd need to cross the Crimson Sea.
Jude: Or they fled behind the advancing troops of the 
Republic.

Those are your two choices. Cartenan or 
Rabaneau.
Nora: They could have fled directly south as well.
Jude: Those big fox ears on your head just for show?
Nora: Choose your next words carefully, honlyn.
Jude: Ah, what a pain in the ass.
Jude: No, you're right! They'd go south to get help from 
no one.
Jude: Honestly, it's what I'd do if I were them. It'd get 
me to my next paycheck sooner too.
Nora: Hmph.
Nora: And what about you...

...sir?
Steel Wolf: ...
The figure clad in armor had not moved for some 
time.

He stared down at his kill.
Nora: Come on. Stop wasting time on that corpse.

Aren't you supposed to be in charge?
Jude: They probably retreated behind the Rabaneau front 
line before it was pushed back.

It's an old saying. The simplest answer often ends 
up being the truth.
Nora: I wasn't looking for your opinion.
Jude: Argh! You're overcomplicating it.
Jude: Why would they ignore the Republic when that 
opportunity comes waltzing up to them?

Is it really that you just want an excuse to keep 
rushing forward?
Nora: Tsk. We have a job to do.

We need to secure Lockhart so it can properly 
reorganize.
Nora: I won't sit still with such threats still out there.
The two stared each other down.
Steel Wolf: They are no threats.
Jude: Huh? It talked?
Steel Wolf: Their champion is dead.
Nora: And what of it? 

The other fugitives are still out there.
Steel Wolf: Their champion was weak.
Nora and Jude looked on with confusion.
Steel Wolf: Woman clad in red steel.

Are you strong?
Nora: Am I...?
Nora: ...
Nora: I am as strong as I need to be for Lockhart's 
future.
Steel Wolf: Then there is no threat.

Their champion was weak.

Therefore, they are weak.

And there is only one fate awaiting the weak.
The Steel Wolf turned on his heel and began back 
towards Lockhart.
Steel Wolf: Misery and death.

All roads lead to such an end.

passages.name: CH5 - Scene 3
passages.content:
The group traveled as a whole through the 
southern region of the West Auran Alliance.

While we were on our guard for imperial troops 
catching up to us, none ever did.

Despite this good fortune, our route to Cartenan 
was still blocked by the sea to our north.

The Crimson Sea was infamous for being very 
dangerous to navigate. Few ports offered transit 
across it.
With Lockhart as an enemy, we only had one 
choice of where to seek help.

Ranakstown. The infamous pirate's cove of the 
Crimson Sea.
Norde: Then this would be Ranakstown?
Cainan: That it is. Have you not been?
Charlotte: I imagine most try to avoid pirate hotspots.
Norde: Bandits are nothing new in our line of work.
Norde: Bar the port, this city does have shades of bandit 
country more inland.
Mariel: It certainly has a different aura about it than 
Lockhart has.
Satia: Ah, I didn't get a chance to think about it on our 
way from Lockhart, but the sea air is lovely.

Such a long time since I had the
pleasure~
Pup: My feet are killing me.
Pup: There's bound be an inn nearby, right?
Cainan: Ah, not so fast.
Cainan: If we wish to take a ship in the morning, we'd best 
make contact with a crew before the night takes 
us.
Norde: True. They'd need time to prep.
Pup: Then let's do that.
Our group walked through the city and asked 
around about potential leads.
Pup: (For a pirate town, you'd think they'd be easier to 
find.)
The inquiry seemed to be fleeting.

At least, it seemed that way until...
Young Girl: Sorry, can't say I ever seen no ferry services around 
this place.
A young nekolyn woman had stopped in her day 
to humor our questions.
Norde: We are in... a hurry of sorts.
Norde: Our group would be open to less... formal 
solutions.
Norde: Given the reputation of Ranakstown...
Young Girl: Ugh... those creeps.
Pup: Creeps meaning... pirates?
Young Girl: Shh!
Young Girl: The local guard don't like when people talk about 
them.

But...
Young Girl: If you're that desperate, there's a tavern I work at 
t

passages.name: CH6 - New Event
passages.content:
WARNING: Cainan is about to leave the party. 
You may want to remove any items of value.
 
Are you ready to move foward?
[Choice]: Yes / No
Tatiana: Ugh... This... stupid... I want to go back in 
my armor, and...
Tatiana's words stopped in her throat as she felt 
something rising.
Pup: Ugh... Does anyone else... feel..
I stopped my words as a wooziness started to wash 
over my mind.
Otis: Oi! If ya gonna hurl, do it over the side!
Mariel: I- It'll be alright... You just need to get used to it.

Maybe we should all get some air?
Charlotte: First timers...
Charlotte: It's probably worth getting them some air.
The chilled sea air burst into the cabin and met the 
first time seafarers' lungs.
Pup: That's... ugh... That helps.
Charlotte: Heh. Try running a merchant shipping company.
Norde: I can only imagine how poorly that'd go.
Pup: Oh... you were out here...
Pup: Maybe inside was better.
A few of the others had already been on deck, 
including Norde, Cainan, and members of Otis's 
crew.
Norde: Helpful.

Especially so if a third of our group would be useless 
in a fight due to sea sickness.
Satia: Now, now... No need to pick a fight just to prove a 
point.
Pup: After all this time, stuff like that out of your mouth 
still sounds vaguely like a threat.
Cainan: What a lovely atmosphere.
Rowan: Indeed. Mayhap we see forgiveness and 
merriment?
Pup: You. Don't. Talk.
Rowan: If you make me.
Pup: Okay... I'm throwing it overboard.
I took a step forward.
Otis: I'll throw ya both overboard if you don't shut ya 
stupid traps.
Charlotte: Maybe the seasickness isn't the worst effect of the 
voyage, but being cooped up for days...
Otis: Argh! I'm never taking on fucking stowaways again.
Charlotte: I paid you way too much for you to be pretending 
we're stowaways.
Otis: Yeah, and you're not getting any refund if I need 
to throw some stowaways overboard.
Charlotte: Hmph.
Norde: *Sigh*...
Rowan: Ha... haha...?
Pup: Nrgh...
An awkward, tense silence fell over the group.
Cainan: Truly

passages.name: CH7 - Reagyn (Pup)
passages.content: Reagyn: A- Argh! What... What are you doing?!

passages.name: CH7 - Story start
passages.content:
Pup: (So, how to do this dance thing...)
Pup: (Or, you know, I could just go for a win in a less 
nonsensical way.)
Pup: (Not like she wants to hear me out...)
Pup: Ugh...
Reagyn: Shall we begin?
Reagyn raised her weapon in an intentional way 
that seemed to be part of the sports’ rules, so I 
followed suit.
Head Noble: Now! Begin!
In order to correctly "dance", Pup must step into all 
red squares in one turn. 

Dancers' ability allow units to move again. Move the 
dancers next to Pup to use this ability.

passages.name: CH7 - Reset
passages.content: Reagyn: Come now. What are you standing still for?

passages.name: CH7 - Charsimatic
passages.content:
Pup: ...!
Reagyn: ...!
As I followed the prompts I was given to move, I...

...was outpacing her.

Not at first, but by the end of the dance...
Head Noble: And that is the end! The result... It is a... win! For 
Pup Baranov!
Reagyn: Hmph. That surprised me. I should’ve taken you 
more seriously.
She turned away in a bit of a huff.
Pup: See what a battle hardened warrior can do?
Charlotte: I didn’t actually think you had it in you.
Kara: An impressive display of finesse.
Pup: Hm? Of what?
Kara: Ah... It isn’t so important.
+1 Charisma Points

passages.name: CH7 - Direct
passages.content:
Head Noble: Why did...? That... That would be a disqualification.

Lady Charlotte... Why did...?
Charlotte: I- I’m so sorry. Pup just... Or Anton is very new to 
all this, I just...
The two trailed off out of my earshot.
Pup: What? It’s a duel. We’re supposed to fight each 
other.
Pup: I didn’t go for a fatal attack!
Kara: Anton... do please let it go.
Reagyn: ...A brute, as expected.
Pup: ...!
Charlotte: This was my fault. I just let my mouth run and the 
Lord got the wrong impression.
Pup: *Sigh*...
+1 Direct Points

passages.name: CH7 - FInish map
passages.content:
Head Noble: And with that, we can move onto our main event. 
Please, can everyone move along to the arena 
field?
Pup: *Sigh*... What other runaround have we got to 
deal with?
Charlotte: Well, it should be more straightforward this time, 
at least.
Head Noble: Now! Let us begin... the wargame...!
As we approached our destination, a familiar face 
came into view.
Norde: How did the banquet go?
Pup: Norde, there you are. And here I was hoping we’d 
gotten rid of you.
Norde: I’m inclined to assume it went poorly.
Pup: Hmm... feels like home again already.
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Pup: I knew you’d be on my side.
Jakson: *Unsure whine*...?
Jakson shifted his head back and forth, like he was 
unsure of what stance to take.
Pup: Ah, you’ll come around.
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Charlotte: It went better than I imagined, but worse than I’d 
have hoped.
Kara: From my understanding, despite some hiccups, it 
has been a net positive endeavor.

Best to continue that momentum, yes?
Norde: Noted and considered.

The Crows are fully prepared to assist with the next 
stage of this event.
Pup: Well, I wouldn’t get your hopes up that it’ll be 
something fun.
Charlotte: I imagine this part will play more to your liking.

passages.name: CH7 - Place Event
passages.content:
I tried following the prompts that were given to 
me.
And again...
And again...
And one final time...

passages.name: CH7 - Pup → Reagyn
passages.content:
Pup: You know, the Crows are pretty great if you get to 
know them.
Reagyn: A noble’s responsibility is to serve their people.
Reagyn: Yours is to make money.
Pup: I’ve... I could stand to be more involved in those 
meetings.
Pup: It doesn’t mean we all do it out of greed, though.
Reagyn: Yet that conflict of interest remains as the core 
tenet of your approach to life.
Pup: Really, a noble of all people shouldn’t throw stones 
in glass-
Suddenly a burst of applause interrupted my words.
Head Noble: And that is the end! The result... It is a... tie?
As we had talked, I had been able to mirror 
her movements.
Reagyn: Hmph. You could’ve been worse.
She turned away in a bit of a huff.
Pup: See what a battle hardened warrior can do?
Charlotte: Wow, you actually kept up.
Kara: Quite the potential with finesse.
Pup: Hm? With what?
Kara: Ah... It isn’t so important.
+1 Diplomatic Points

passages.name: CH7 - Start
passages.content:
Kara: ...and the crop production was up about 5% this 
year.

The farmers’ delegate surmised it was due to 
weather pattern timing.
Avalina: Excellent. I am pleased to hear such positive results 
from our nation’s hard work.
The rays of light peppered a sea of stars across the 
marbled floors of the palace.

Above that cosmic starscape stood a pair of 
black heels, and further up still a graceful visage 
of a face.
Kara: The delegate did wish to pass along a sentiment.

One of pride for the work the farmers of Cartenan 
had put in this last season.
Avalina: Ah... that is...
Avalina: Hmm...
A finger of consideration went to the chin of 
another figure. This one was raised above the tide 
of light by a throne.
She was cloaked within a flowing, elegant ensemble 
of green and white, with it emblazoned with 
striking accents of gold and royal purple.
She was Avalina. The Queen of Cartenan.
Avalina: If you’ve the chance, do please return my 
agreeability to the sentiment.
Kara: Of course, your majesty.
Kara shuffled through her papers to move onto a 
new topic.
Kara: As for movement of bandit activity, there are some 
developments from our international scouts.

In Rabaneau, the bandits were seen moving toward 
the northern border.

In the Empire, the movement was towards the 
capital.

In New Aureria, they were-
Avalina: Yes, yes. Make a note to increase the scout corp.’s 
bonus fund.

We wouldn’t want them to get too demotivated in 
such boredom filled days.
Kara: Noted.
Kara then straightened out her papers and lowered 
them.

Her gaze shifted so she was addressing the Queen 
directly.
Kara: The trend seen in the reports is of bandits moving 
northward.
Avalina: Indeed? Then that really only points to one place.
Kara: Under conventional wisdom, I would agree.
Avalina: Oh~ I wonder if the Empire is reaching their 
breaking point, then?
Avalina: That tiresome, endless war they have with the 
Republic is becoming too much?

To think they would need to hire reinforcements

passages.name: CH7 - Story start
passages.content:
Pup: ...just volunteered for?!
The switch from the banquet into a mini-arena was 
fast as servants zoomed about.

Reagyn was standing across from me, seeming to 
be prepared for a fight.
Pup: What is...? Didn’t someone say the word “Knight” 
somewhere?
Pup: Ah! Are we finally going to actually duel?!
Reagyn: I can’t imagine you standing much of a chance.
Pup: Let’s see how much you actually know about 
proper swordplay, then!
Kara: No, Anton. It is a ceremonial fight. It is more akin 
to ‘dance’.
Pup: Huh...?!

The Goddess’s underwear, you’re ruining duels, 
too?!
Reagyn: You should watch your tongue in these esteemed 
halls.
Charlotte: Pup, I’m... Yeah, I didn’t mean for this.

One thing led to the other, and the Lord 
misinterpretted what I was saying.
Kara: Just try to follow the rhythm.

This is a sport unto itself, and you’re aiming to get 
“points”.

We can act as support, but not participate directly.
Pup: Ugh... Fine. I’ll try to figure this out.

passages.name: CH8 - New Event
passages.content:
Win Condition: Defeat all enemies
Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan, Charlotte, Kara die

passages.name: CH8 - Avalina appears
passages.content:
Queen Avalina and her dispatched knights entered the
village from the mountain trails nearby.
Avalina: Good. Now move the package to-
Avalina: ...?!
She stared down our group with a look of surprise and
anger.
Kara: ...
Avalina: Men, focus on dispatching the Imperial riffraff.
Knight: Yes, your majesty.
Pup: (Hm...? Those guys look different...)

passages.name: CH8 - New Event
passages.content:
Bandit: Argh!
The bandit fell to the ground.
Villager: T- Thank you!
She said as she bolted away.
Pup: Well, at least she's safe.
Rowan: This town is one housing a royal vacation home? 
Your queen must enjoy the tranquility.
Kara: ...

It is... a cover.
Pup: Cover for... what?
Kara: It is not my place to say. But if she is here for why I
believe she is... then she will need the assistance.
Charlotte: Hmm... Is that so?
Norde: Then we'll hear it from the horse's mouth, I imagine.
Norde opened his medicine and downed the liquid.
Pup: ...
I felt around in my gear for my own.
Pup: (Not yet... I don't need it. Not yet.)

Let's not waste anymore time!

passages.name: CH8 - Place Event
passages.content:
Fancy Man: Thanks for coming to our rescue!

I recently saw a gryphon knight flying over the 
mountains... didn't look like one of the Queen's 
soldiers... 
She might have something to do with all this... but 
maybe I am just paranoid. 

Again, thanks for saving us.

passages.name: CH8 - Kara → Reagyn
passages.content:
Reagyn: ...
Kara: It is your decision to make.
Reagyn: I didn't say anything.
Kara: I asked Charlotte to help because her allies are less
likely to be beholden to those feelings of loyalty.
Kara: But I will not blame you for acting on them.
Reagyn: ...

Acknowledged.

passages.name: CH8 - Flynn → Rowan
passages.content:
Flynn slashed away at a bandit, and they fell down
seemingly dead.
Flynn: *Pant* ... *Pant* ...
Flynn: T- They're... dead...?
Rowan: Do not dwell on it.
Flynn: Oh- ... Prince Alexei, you...?!
Rowan: Do not dwell on it.

Look to the next target. Remember they wish to 
kill you.
Flynn: But...
Rowan: Remember what they wish to do to you, your 
loved ones, and your country.

Do not let yourself get distracted.
Flynn: O- Okay... I'll try.

passages.name: CH8 - Mariel → Jakson
passages.content:
Jakson: *Notifying Bark*!
Mariel: I'll be right there!
Mariel jumped towards the direction of the bark and
quickly started her healing magic's process.
Mariel: It'll be okay...
The injured villager there slowly gained their vitality
back.
Jakson: *Vigilant growl*...
Villager: T- Thank you...!
Mariel: Just get to safety.
The villager did as they were told, and headed off.
Mariel: Good job, boy. Let me know if you find any others.
Jakson: *Determined bark*!

passages.name: CH8 - Satia → Otis
passages.content:
Otis: Tsk! These scabs can just die.

What sort o' deplored souls would take on this sort 
o' job?!
Satia: I can't imagine it as that different than you 
sinking ships.
Otis: Heh. I knew what scum I was targettin'. None of 
'em lot didn't deserve their fate.
Satia: I wonder.
Otis: Wonder all you like, momma bird. Will be true til my
timely death.
Satia: No. I more wonder if these bandits have those 
among them that think the same as you.

That they're just attacking people who deserve it.
Otis: Eh. Why'd ya gotta bring that gray area mishmush 
into this?
Satia: Perhaps it's a matter of the mood I'm in.

Not everyone will have sparkling memories of this
country.
Otis: Ya don't say...?

passages.name: CH8 - Charlotte → Norde
passages.content:
Norde: You know, correct?
Charlotte: I don't know what you're talking about.
Norde: Why that Kara women believes the Queen came here.
Charlotte: I don't know what you're talking about.
Norde: Then you are also compelled to silence.
Charlotte: I'm not about to spill a potential state secret if it
isn't relevant. Even if it isn't my own.
Norde: ...

Understood.

passages.name: CH8 - Story
passages.content:
Pup: ...
I stared at the sight of soldiers mobilizing.
Regiments were forming their units, and orders 
were barked all about.
But...
It was silent.
The clamor of the hustling scene was overwhelmed 
by the indomitable silence of my own thoughts.
Pup: ...
Pup: *Exhales*...
I felt the pressure flow away as I breathed out.
And I hesitated, if just for a second, to breathe
again.
Pup: (We can do this.)
Some time before...
Avalina: ...You DARE set foot here as such?!
Kara: Your majesty...
Avalina: This is a sacred place of authority and history.

It is not to be disrespected without expectation of
capital repercussions.
Kara: I do hope you understand that I wouldn't have 
done it if the security of the Kingdom didn't 
depend on it.
Avalina: ...!

You make such a claim... over bandits...?!
Rowan: Sigh

... As said, it is but a ploy.
Rowan: You do not know the minds of those whom wish 
your reign disturbed.
Avalina: And when does the plea of a con artist ever not 
appeal to the ignorance of a target?

You act as though you have no motivation to drag 
my peace into the frenzy of war.
Charlotte: We want to help you save your kingdom. Then 
we can figure out if you'll help Lockhart.
Mariel: We've already seen enough death... We wouldn't 
want more.
Avalina: ...
The Queen stood in perfect composure as her 
silence betrayed her antagonism.
Avalina: Then make your case.

But to waste the court's time will be considered 
the crime it is.

Do remember that.
Kara: Of course, your majesty. 

I wouldn't have brought them here if such an 
end result was in the cards.
Charlotte: Well, we're happy to have your cooperation for the 
time being, then.
Kara: As noted, the belief is that the Empire is 
attempting a similar gambit as they did with 
Lockhart.
Under the guise of bandit raids, they transition the
drama of the endeavor into a proper military attack.

It allows them to dictate the strategy of the early
moments of conflict and place the target on their
heels.
Charlotte: It happened

passages.name: CH8 - Closing Story
passages.content:
Avalina: Burn to ash.
Bandit: Rraghh!!!
Avalina: Good riddance.
Knight: Your majesty, I believe that was the last of them.
Avalina: Thank you. Prepare the container for transport to 
the capital.
Knight: Yes, ma'am.
Several knights joined the queen by her side. One 
of them was holding a heavy metal case.
Pup: *Pant* ... I can... I'm okay.
Pup: Hm...?

(That case? Is that what they're here for?)
Avalina: Move with me.
Queen Avalina started on her way out of 
the village as though we weren't there.
Kara: Your majesty.
Avalina: ...
She stopped.
Avalina: How dare you?
Kara: Y- Your majesty, I only-
Avalina: I can be lenient... if the punishment leads to the
proper reform.

Will it?
Kara: I am... 

I only wished to support you...
Avalina: Then we will speak again later. Return your forces 
to their assignments.
The Queen began forward again.
Kara: ...
Kara: Then I will stop pretending.

Did you secure "it"?
Avalina: ...?!
Her forward march had come to an abrupt stop.
Avalina: What?

What did you just say?
Kara: Is "it" inside that case? Was it secured before it was
too late?
Avalina: My dear Kara... You are a wonderfully bright young
woman.

But to try and manipulate your regent into 
providing you information you have no right to 
know...
Queen Avalina raised her hand as though she was 
about to have the knights attack.
Pup: W- What the...?! What's happening?!
Rowan: Ah, so she was pulling on that string.
Rowan: *Sigh*... What a sour note to come from that 
pluck.
Pup: String?
Kara: The fan.
Avalina: ...!?
Avalina: How do you...?!
Kara: I can assure you. I only wish for the best for the
Kingdom and the world.

Hiding it in the capital is a risk too great for your
plan. The empire could already have infiltrators 
ready to destroy it.
They know you'd want to bring it there.
Avalina: ...

Men. At arms.
Knight: Ma'am!
Pup: W- What?! Why are you...!?
The Queen and Kara stared at each other, as 
though an execution was prepared to go off on a 
hair trigger.
Kara: ...
Avalina

passages.name: CH9 - Jude (Pup)
passages.content:
Pup: You...! You again?!
Jude: ...
Jude: Ah, you’re that... uh...
Jude: ...farmer...?
Pup: What are you talking about?!
Jude: Should I recognize you?
Pup: You tried to kill us!

Twice!
Jude: Huh...

You don’t... look like a princess...?
Jude: I thought those Lockhart girls were
blonde?
Pup: We’re the ones protecting Lockhart!
Jude: Argh! I’m not paid enough to remember all that!

passages.name: CH9 - Jude (Active)
passages.content:
Jude: Enemies from the flank...?
Jude: Ugh... This isn’t what we’re here for...

I’m not paid nearly enough for this
sort of pain...

passages.content:
Elliot: Return the Oathbreaker.
Kara: ‘Return the what’...?
Kara: Is there some sort of confusion to be had here? 
You work for the Covenant?
Elliot: I saw your group take it.
Kara: ...
Kara: Actually, aren’t you Elliot Elvanus?
Elliot: Huh...?
Kara: I have a fiancé named “Cainan DeClares”...
Elliot: You... know Sir Cainan...?
Elliot: N- No... I need to focus on retrieving the relic.

passages.content:

I’m sorry Goddess, but I need to retreat.

...
Elliot: Sir Cainan’s fiancé, though...?

passages.content:

passages.name: CH9 - Map 1
passages.content:
Kara: It is truly a pleasure to see you all still safe.
Satia: Especially you, my little Pup! I was so worried!
Satia had burst forward and grabbed me 
from behind.
Pup: Argh!
Up on my feet a bit too quickly, a slight dizziness
threw off my balance.
Pup: Y- Yes. All fit as a fiddle.
Pup: Now...
I slipped out of her grip.
Pup: We need to keep moving.
I looked down ever so slightly and saw the main 
source of my balance problems.
Satia: Aw...
Pup: We shouldn't stand around for too long.
Rowan: Do we have a plan of where to go?
Rowan: Shoot me for being the voice of reason, but 
perhaps it'd be best to stop to catch our breath?
Rowan: Between planning and... members of our group 
likely needing a slight adaptation period...
Pup: You, too?
Pup: It's fine. I won't let it be a distraction.

There are more important things to worry
about over something too far in to stop.
Rowan: That's not quite what I meant.
Rowan: A long trek through mountains with two newly 
endowed allies with you...
Rowan: I imagine one of our more well equipped ladies can
speak to the nature of such a journey, even for 
those well adjusted to it.
Kara: ...
Charlotte: ...
Rowan: Alas, am I wrong? Shoot me for being the voice of
reason, not for being the messenger of it.
Otis: Aye. There's likely gonna be trouble it brings at
first.
Pup: I already figured out some ways to support them 
from when I was trying to hide it before.
Norde: Hmm...
Pup: Unless, Rowan, you were hoping they'd be jiggling 
out of my shirt.
Rowan: ...
Rowan: ...
Pup: You know what, if it gets us out of here quicker, 
feel free to stare all you want.
Pup: I'm personally more concerned about the scattering 
of bandits and soldiers in the area.
Kara: True... Though, they do not look to be pursuing 
us, at least.
Pup: It'll probably be difficult to get all of us through
here without engaging them, though.
Norde: Yes, let's move with the intent to clear the way as 
the front line. Then the rest of our forces can 
follow.
Pup: Let's do

passages.name: CH9 - Map 1 to 2
passages.content:
Pup: There we go.
Tatiana: Eh, now what? Just walk through the mountains?
Charlotte: Where does that leave us for next steps? Just keep
walking?
Kara: There is a village at the true border to the empire.

As predictable as it may be... so long as we stay
moving then we can take advantage of it for a 
short resupply.
Norde: Then we-
Pup: We can do that then. No time to waste.
Norde: ...
We moved across the foot of each mountain 
as we found our way to a nearby village.
On the outskirts of the village...
Reagyn: Finally, someplace with walls.
Reagyn: This snow and cold is... so very inefficient...
Charlotte: A village with walls... and warmth? Thank the 
Goddess.
Kara: We should move quickly to resupply and get going.
Norde: What are the chances they are lacking in supplies 
for us to purchase?
Kara: Too many unknowns to say for sure.
Mariel: H- Hopefully they have some underlayers we can stock up
on for warmth...
Kara: Though if the cold is getting to those of us less used
to the climate, they may have options.
Pup: (Well, she's not wrong...)
After a slight chill ran through me, I looked around
and saw some of the people that had joined us.

A few were clearly not handling it well.
Those from Cartenan or the south seemed 
particularly flustered.
Kara: Anton, do you also wish to partake?
Pup: Me...?
Pup: I... No, this coat is plenty.
Rowan: It would give you the opportunity to revitalize your
wardrobe.
Charlotte: Yeah, that thing hasn't fit well since Lockhart. And
now...
Pup: I...
Pup: No, that's unnecessary.
Charlotte: As a girl myself, all I can say is that thing looks
especially uncomfortable to move around in.
Pup: W- We're talking about warmth for a trek through 
the mountains.
Pup: We don't have time to be worrying about irrelevant
things now.
Norde: ...
Pup: In fact, let's just keep moving. I can check the
southern buildings and-
Norde: No, I imagine horseback would be quicker.
Pup: Well, it'd be quickest to just start-
Kara: Wait.
Kara: The village is in dang

passages.name: CH9 - Map 2 to 3
passages.content:
Pup: *Pant*... There we go.
The last of the beasts went down and the villagers 
were safe.
Villager: T- Thank you! You've helped avert a tragic end for 
our friends and family.

Is there anything we can do to express 
our gratitude?
Pup: Y- Yeah. You're welcome.
Norde: We were actually looking for a chance to resupply.
Pup: R- Right. Could you possibly help with that?
Kara: Most importantly, we were looking to acquire 
thermal layering that our group could use.
Villager: Aye, we do have our share of that. Follow me.
The mayor introduced us to a local shop that 
stocked what we needed, and we gladly paid full 
price for the supplies we wanted.
Pup: Thank you.
Pup: We can't spend too long here, so we'll be off 
sooner over later.
Villager: You'd be welcome back here at any time!
And with that, we continued on into the mountains.
We moved deliberately through the mountains.
Kara: Taking less traveled paths will make it more difficult
to follow us.
Or so had been said prior.
Pup: (It does mean that the path is not as well 
maintained, though...)
Pup: (Which... can make it more difficult to traverse...)
My own idle mind looked down to my body's recent
changes.
Pup: (Needing time to adapt, they said...?)
I looked back towards the others and the rest of 
the Nightless Crows with us.
Pup: (I really can't afford to let it distract me.)
We were slowly exiting a mountain pass into a 
valley, and there were more than a few that were 
handling it differently.
Turning to some of the others worn out 
by the hike...
Pup: Hey, can you switch places with...
Pup: ...Yeah, I think it'll help pace out the...
I started to direct the Crows in a way I thought 
could mitigate their fatigue.
Rowan: Hmm...?
Rowan: Oh, Pup, what initiative you take.
Pup: Huh? What does that mean?
Rowan: I mean it as a sincere compliment.
Kara: It is true you have been much more proactive than 
I had seen previously.
Charlotte: This isn't some side effect of the curse, is it?
Pup: I... I mean...
Pup: ...

I'm j

passages.name: CH9 - Liebra recruitment
passages.content:
Ah...?! What's this?
A faint light came from the heirloom on them.
The ground beneath our feet slowly rose and 
collected into a humanoid form.
With a flash of a greenish magical aura, it melded 
into a form more resembling a person.
Liebra: ...
Liebra: ...
Pup: W- What just happened there?!
Kara: It appears a summoning occurred...?
Pup: The green magic thing?!
Kara: It must've reacted to a capable heirloom? 
Though...

Acting on such a hair trigger is a surprise unto
itself.
Pup: So, who is...?
Liebra: ...
The woman stretched out like she had awakened 
from a long and deep sleep.
Liebra: To traverse a world in this form...
Liebra: Hmph. To think of that even being possible...
Pup: (Uh... something about her presence is 
intimidating...)

Hello. Who are... you...?
Liebra: I am Liebra.
Liebra: I suspect, more specifically... Liebra... NOT of this
land.
Liebra: How have you created my image in a way that walks
within this world?
Pup: You were... summoned via green magic?
Pup: I'm probably not the best person to ask...
Liebra: Ah, what a cute flustered face you have.
Pup: What's that supposed to mean?
Liebra: Nothing to dwell on. Simply...
She raised her hands and flames flickered on her
fingertips.
Liebra: Would you like some assistance with the beasts 
that place you in peril?
Pup: I'm not going to say no to help...
Pup: But what do you want in return?
Liebra: Nothing too complicated.
Liebra: I wish for entertainment.
Liebra: So do put on a good show~

passages.name: CH9 - Map 3 to 4
passages.content:
.........
...........!
Crow: Anton! Norde! Everyone!
Pup: Ah!?
I turned to see the Nightless Crows breaking 
through the mounds of snow that had blocked the 
path.
Pup: You've broken through?!
Norde: Excellent. Now we should have enough man power 
to scare them off.
Crow: Right! We're on it!
Pup: Now...
Norde: ...everyone...
Pup: ...attack!
Norde: ...attack!
Flynn: Thank the Goddess... What sort of animals can live 
in these conditions?
Charlotte: Thank the Goddess... That was exhausting...
Rowan: Mayhap this is a time to seek a warm place to 
sleep?
Norde: Finding somewhere warm might be difficult.
Charlotte: At this point I'm more concerned about the animals
getting hungry again.
Kara: It is certainly advisable to move from this area 
before bunkering down.
Pup: Night will fall soon, so let's be quick about it.
The rescue efforts had identified a few missing 
people, but each of those men were found safely 
in the snow by the end.
With that sigh of relief, our exhausted group 
moved again to find a better place to make camp 
for the night.
We moved from the most recent mountain pass 
into another valley.
Kara: This area appears to have promise.
Charlotte: Goddess do I hope you're right.
Norde: It looks defensible, at least.

We can-
Pup: The site over there is good for the main tent, we 
can-
Norde: We can set the shift guard posts over there and...
Pup: ...
Norde: ...
Crow: ...

Thank the Goddess you two at least agree on 
WHAT to do...
Rowan: I think we should take care of the imperial troops
first.
Pup: What?!
Jude: ...
Charlotte: Yeah, I recognize some faces and armor styles over
there.
Norde: I suppose that it was only a matter of time since 
we crossed the border.
Kara: We could go around.
Rowan: Ah, well, there is an addendum I'd like to make to 
my observation.
Rowan: I may have noticed them because I saw a soldier
frantically running in the direction opposite of us.
Pup: One more fight then...

passages.name: CH9 - Elliot Rec1.5
passages.content:
Elliot: ...

What is that noise...? It isn't thieves, is it?

passages.name: CH9 - Elliot Rec2
passages.content:
Elliot: Huh...?
Elliot: Wait, no, that isn't yours to take!
Elliot: Return it, now.

passages.name: CH9 - Jude 1/2 hp
passages.content:
Jude: *Sigh*... I am not paid enough for this.
Jude: Imperial summoner, you're in charge.
Summoner: I have a name, you know?
Summoner: ...And he's gone.

Pfft. He was an amateur anyways.

This will be the perfect opportunity to show why I
should be in charge!

Summoning magic...!

...?!

I think... I got... a big one...!
Summoner: Haha~! That'll show 'em.

passages.name: CH9 - Map 4 Fin
passages.content:
Pup: *Pant*... that... has to be the last of it...
Kara: The area appears clear, at least.

Just in time for...
Charlotte: *Sigh*... Morning already...?
Norde: No rest for the weary.
Norde: This area is also compromised. We need to find 
another place for camp.
Rowan: *Siiiigggghhhhhh*........
Elliot: ...
Kara: Elliot, was it?
Elliot: My name is Elliot Elvanus of the holy country, 
Aureria.

I am here as a representative of the Covenant.

I wanted to request that you return the 
Oathbreaker. The one I assumed was picked up 
by... accident.
Pup: So you're still on about that? That we picked up
something like that?
Pup: It wasn't like you were asking before.
Elliot: I mean the coin that one of you picked up before.

It was given to me as part of my Covenant
responsibilities.
Pup: Heh... a coin? As an Oathbreaker?
Kara: It is possible.
Charlotte: I have heard myself that Oathbreakers "could be
anything", technically.
Elliot: That is true.

I am an Oathkeeper acting as a squire to the 
Covenant auditor Cainan DeClares.

I've been traveling the Imperial north as he covers 
the southern regions.
Elliot: I was... surprised to hear that you may be his
fiancé...

Despite those doubts... too much in my memory 
seemed to confirm it for me to deny it.
Kara: It was a pleasure to meet you before in Oadthine, 
even if it was for a short time.
Elliot: So that was you.

What... What brings you here? And you're fighting 
the Imperial troops?
Charlotte: What, have you not heard about the war with 
Lockhart and Cartenan?
Elliot: The... what?
It turned out that Elliot was isolated enough from
world news to only now hear of these events.
We explained as best we could.
Elliot: What a predicament to be roped into...
Kara: We do what we must, after all.
Elliot: Indeed. It is a worthy cause.

May I join it?
Kara: I... wouldn't want to pull you from your duties.
Elliot: It would be irresponsible of me to turn a blind eye
when presented with such a dilemma and a chance 
to help.
Elliot: There
