passages.name: CH9 - Place Event
passages.content:
Pup: There we go.
Tatiana: Eh, now what? Just walk through the mountains?
Charlotte: Where does that leave us for next steps? Just keep
walking?
Kara: There is a village at the true border to the empire.

As predictable as it may be... so long as we stay
moving then we can take advantage of it for a 
short resupply.
Norde: Then we-
Pup: We can do that then. No time to waste.
Norde: ...
We moved across the foot of each mountain as we found
our way to a nearby village.
On the outskirts of the village...
Reagyn: Finally, someplace with walls.
Reagyn: This snow and cold is... so very inefficient...
Charlotte: A village with walls... and warmth? Thank the 
Goddess.
Kara: We should move quickly to resupply and get going.
Norde: What are the chances they are lacking in supplies 
for us to purchase?
Kara: Too many unknowns to say for sure.
Mariel: H- Hopefully they have some underlayers we can stock up
on for warmth...
Kara: Though if the cold is getting to those of us less used
to the climate, they may have options.
Pup: (Well, she's not wrong...)
After a slight chill ran through me, I looked around
and saw some of the people that had joined us not
handling it well.
Those from Cartenan or the south seemed 
particularly flustered.
Kara: Anton, do you also wish to partake?
Pup: Me...?
Pup: I... No, this coat is plenty.
Rowan: It would give you the opportunity to revitalize your
wardrobe.
Charlotte: Yeah, that thing hasn't fit well since Lockhart. And
now...
Pup: I...
Pup: No, that's unnecessary.
Charlotte: As a girl myself, all I can say is that thing looks
especially uncomfortable to move around in.
Pup: W- We're talking about warmth for a trek through 
the mountains.
Pup: We don't have time to be worrying about irrelevant
things now.
Norde: ...
Pup: In fact, let's just keep moving. I can check the
southern buildings and-
Norde: No, I imagine horseback would be quicker.
Pup: Well, it'd be quickest to just start-
Kara: Wait.
STAGE DIRECTION> BEAST ENEMIES TO DEFEAT AND VILLA

passages.name: CH9 - Place Event
passages.content:
Villager: T- Thank you! I don't know what has those beasts 
all riled up lately...

Here, maybe this will help on your travels...

passages.name: CH9 - Place Event
passages.content:
Villager 1: Argh, those damned beasts again. Thanks for 
saving my shop. Even if I think one ate my secret 
stash.
...Fuck it. The wife will be happy with flowers this
anniversary, anyways.
He walks off, but we stay behind and noticed that 
one of the slain beasts spit out a small sack in the 
fight.

passages.name: CH9 - Place Event
passages.content:
Villager 2: Thank the Goddess you lot were here.

I've been taking care of another mercenary that 
got hurt as they passed through...

Hmm... Oh, are they one of yours?

"Nightless Crows"... I can check.
Received a Merc Token Rank 2!

passages.name: CH9 - Pup → Mariel
passages.content:
Mariel: Hey... Pup... Do you... want to talk?
Pup: Sorry, but... We're a bit busy, right?
Pup: You want to stay alive long enough to retake 
Lockhart, right?
Mariel: ...
Mariel: ...

I'm sorry about what happened to your father.

I know what it's like to... to...
Pup: ...
Pup: We've got more important things to focus on.
Mariel: Just... let me know if you want to talk about it.

I'm not going anywhere.

passages.name: CH9 - Charlotte → Kara
passages.content:
Charlotte: Hey, Kara. I just wanted to say that I'm happy that
you're sticking around with us.
Charlotte: Leaving your country like that can't be easy. I'd
understand if you turned around and went back 
now, but...
Charlotte: I appreciate it. Truly.
Kara: A lovely sentiment. Thank you for saying as much.
Charlotte: I do mean it that I'd understand if you turned 
around right now...

I wouldn't want you coming with us out of some 
sense of obligation.
Kara: I can assure you that isn't the case.
Kara: What I see is the greatest opportunity to make a
difference in this conflict.
Kara: The Kingdom cannot be changed from its fate 
unless something more fundamental is solved.
Kara: I guess I would phrase it as...

"All roads lead to Lockhart"

...and I rather be in a position to have a hand in 
that fate than struggling in a losing battle.

It is the most I can do for Cartenan now.
Charlotte: You've put a lot of thought into this.
Kara: There are few decisions I make lightly.
Charlotte: Then let me double the appreciation I gave before.
Thank you.

passages.name: CH9 - Satia → Norde
passages.content:
Norde: Satia... I need to ask..
Satia: You want to know my opinion on Pup's recent 
change?
Norde: At least it's obvious enough to draw your interest.
Satia: Then I'd ask... which change?

Norde: Anton has never been one to try and be a leader 
of the Crows.

I'll ask you... Why haven't you taken up the 
leadership of the company?
Norde: I regularly take on responsibilities with the
organization of it all.
Satia: And everything else?

Why did you never try and be THE leader of the 
Crows?
Norde: Because there was always-
Norde: ...
Norde: Because Ivan was always there.
Satia: I do not know if Pup really wants to step up like
this... Time will tell...

For now, I think it helps to keep his mind off of it...

...while also trying to fill the shoes that were lost.
Norde: Hmm...

Just look at you. Pile o' muscles and fat.
Jakson: *Bragging bark*...!
Otis: Tsk. Damned mutt...

passages.name: CH9 - Tatiana → Reagyn
passages.content:
Tatiana: Brr...
Tatiana shrunk to within her armor like a turtle.
Tatiana: Much better...
Reagyn: How well does that work?
Tatiana: Hm?
Tatiana: Ah, is the little noble girl jealous?
Reagyn: No, I-
Reagyn: Nevermind, this isn't worth it.
Reagyn: After everything in Cartenan recently, I don't have 
the patience.
Reagyn: I can't imagine you'd understand, so you can focus 
your attention elsewhere.
Tatiana: ...

Nah, I get it.

Waking up with everything you cared about fallin' 
to pieces around you...
Tatiana: My best take on it all would be simple...

Sometimes you gotta rebuild or find a new place to 
find some warmth.
Reagyn: I... appreciate the thought. Though I'm not sure 
you entirely get my family's situation and obligations 
to-
Tatiana: Sure I do.

Here, I'll even let you use my armor to warm up 
out here if ya need it.

You're small enough that the both of us could fit.
Reagyn: I...
Reagyn: I honestly can't tell if you're trying to antagonize 
me or be nice.

I'll be optimistic and assume the latter.
Reagyn: But... I'm not going to share your armor with you...
Tatiana: We'll get that noble stuffiness out of ya at some
point.

passages.name: CH9 - Castel → Flynn
passages.content:
Castel: I must say, I am surprised you've followed this 
group this far.
Flynn: Uh... Sorry?
Castel: I mean no insult. I mean no compliment either.
Castel: I simply expected a noble of the Kingdom to be 
more hesitant to leave it behind.
Castel: My own birth was across the continent, so that
patriotism amongst the nobles was always an 
enigma to me.
Flynn: I don't think it's too complicated.

The kingdom was... is... a bastion worth 
protecting. It is a people worth protecting.

I was always taught that I, as a noble, have an
obligation to protect it.
Flynn: If the best option I have to fix my country's 
problems is outside of the country, I have no qualm 
doing so.
Castel: Hmph. I guess I must have simply misjudged how 
that patriotism was directed, then.
Flynn: Maybe it is... a bit.
Flynn: But... as scared I am of the responsibility of being a
Lord one day...

I do truly want to do right by their happiness.

Even if we all moved to another country... I'd want
them to thrive.
Castel: Hmm...
Castel: I think that is wonderful. I can see the value.

It must be comforting to have that sense of 
purpose.
Flynn: "Terrifying"... That's the word I'd choose.
Castel: I think by your words alone that I know you'll do
wonderfully.
Flynn: I hope you're right...

It was not fine.

IT
WAS
NOT
FINE
Soldier: Y- Your majesty, I simply meant-

Take him to the deepest dungeon.

If he resists, slit his throat there and then.

The soldier's vision was blanketed in darkness.

Alexei IV, the emperor of the Nolvanus Empire,

And he sat there.

Silently.

It does not take a tactician to see the thread of

He even returned to serve his country after his

Ruslan: He was under no obligation to... and he did so in its

Even as a child...

...was he plotting against me?

passages.name: CH9 - Story OP 2
passages.content:
Avalina: Haven't you done enough?!
Steel Wolf: ...
The two exchanged blows once more, with the 
Queen being driven back without much effort on 
the Wolf's part.

Queen Avalina fell to a knee, panting for any 
breath she could get.
Avalina: You... that dragon... Where did it even go?

What...  *pant*... are you planning...?

With a slight tilt of his head, the Wolf looked at the

A glistening patch of bloody red from the recent
exchange of blows.

Steel Wolf: ...
But, he simply... sheathed his sword.

He simply turned and start walking away.
Steel Wolf: The seed is sown.
Avalina: You can't-
She started to rise to her feet to chase after him.
But a select number of guards blocked her path.
Nora: Not another movement.
What remained of the Queen's guard managed to 
pull her back into safety from Nora and the others.
Avalina: No... No no no...
Steel Wolf: She is of no threat.

She is weak.
The Steel Wolf turned back to Nora.
Steel Wolf: You may continue your own task. It aligns with

Nora: You mean...?
Nora: Thank you.
Steel Wolf: ...
The Steel Wolf didn't stick around to listen.
He had turned his back to the scene and was

*Drip*
*Drip drip*...

My eyes fluttered open like I had awoken from
hibernation.
Everything felt new to me from my surroundings

......

Okay.

My gaze slowly scanned the area, until I saw...

passages.content:
With the last of our conflicts sorted, we were able 
to move slightly off course to find an opening to 
setup camp in.
It was open enough to have strong sightlines if an
attack was about to happen, and with escape 
routes to all directions.
So we went about setting up camp.
As we did, a conversation spurred from our 
unanswered questions.
Charlotte: Of course we had to run into imperial troops in all
this mess.
Rowan: When in Nolvanus, you'll see Nolvanans.
Charlotte: Sure. And welcome home... Alexei.
Rowan: I always did prefer the eternal spring of the 
kingdom. Truly a tragic loss.
Charlotte: Crown prince of the invading empire here, folks.
Kara: Alexei, are you aware of notable defensive 
structures along the border?
Rowan: Alas, no. Cartenan never posed a realistic invasion
threat.

Many imperial generals would likely question if 
they'd die in these mountains before reaching the 
empire proper.
Elliot: I was also surprised to see troops in the area.

I've been here for some time, and they've been 
few and far between.
Reagyn: Lady Kara, are you suggesting that as where the 
man retreated to? A military outpost?
Norde: You are suggesting that swordsman retreated to a
military outpost?
Kara: It was what I was hoping for.
Pup: You want there to be a military outpost nearby?

Kara: Elliot, the man ran off farther into the mountains.

I assume that rings a bell for you?
Elliot: Hm...?
Elliot: Oh... The Vault?
Elliot: You think the empire is tampering with a local 
Vault?
Kara: That man ran off farther into the mountains...

I've only heard rumors, but some say there is a 
Vault deeper within.
Pup: A Vault... that sounds familiar.
Rowan: It is where the Covenant seals away Oathbreakers 
to stop misuse of them.

They are scattered and often hidden for said
safekeeping.
Pup: Right... I think that Cainan guy said something 
about them before.

trip.

passages.content:

Soldier: No...!

the pillars and the blood of Jude's allies.

Despite the hair that covered parts of it, there was 
a third of his head that appeared petrified, and it

book.

I assume that's the result of your Dralleus?
Jude: Or... No, Oathbreaker. That's what you'd call it.
Atticus: I'd have thought the Emerald Empire was too busy
fighting the crusades to attack a vault on the other
side of the continent.
Jude: Nope. Just a lost son and cast off.
I'm here to do a job.
Jude unsheathed his sword.
Jude: We can do this the easy way, or the hard way.
Atticus: ...

passages.content:

We should regroup and make our way there.

Let's move there and we can regroup to help the

Pup: (No. I can’t let a craving overcome me.)
As I continued on, the thoughts crept into my 
mind and became stronger, shifting between 
cravings until...
Pup has aquired a Sweet Tooth!
...the curse worked its magic without me even 
noticing.

passages.name: CH10 - Captain Dead
passages.content:
Soldier: The captain is dead!

Damn it! 

 Kill them all!!
Atticus: I came here as soon as I could.

passages.name: CH10 - Active → Jude
passages.content:
Jude: Argh, more of you. I'll just have to take you out 
and-
Jude: Huh...?
A delectable aroma wafted into the area.
Jude: ...
Pup: ...
Jude: ...
Jude: ...
.........
Pup: Do you...
Pup: Do you want this food?
Jude: Of course not.
Jude: Raise your weapon.
Pup: ...
Jude: ...
.........
...*Groooowwwlllll*...
Pup: Any chance you'd retreat for it?
Jude: ...
Pup: Wait, might you?
Jude: O- Of course not.
Pup: You know, you're not exactly fighting for a just 
cause.
Jude: I don't care.
Pup: A mercenary following the money.
Jude: You couldn't afford me.

What I seek isn't simple to just buy me with.
Pup: ...

Is it... the food?
Jude: I said to raise your weapon.
.........
...*Grrrooowwwwllllll*...
Pup: Such a shame.
Pup: We're a mercenary company. We're well traveled 
and know lots of recipes.
Pup: Not to mention there's this bard in our group. He's
well traveled across the continent.
Pup: And also a noble from Cartenan. She always seems 
to know the best place to eat in any town she 
visits.
Pup: Best of all? THE heir to the Lockhart Stewart
mercantile group. She can bankroll it all.
Jude: ...
Pup: So how well has your current arrangement been 
going?
Jude: ...
.........
Pup: One nice meal for you a month. Anything you want.
Jude: ...
Jude: One fine dining meal a day.
Pup: 1 every week.
Jude: 4 a week.
Pup: 2 a week.
Jude: 3.
Pup: 2 a week and I'll throw in this meal that caught your
eye.
Jude: ...
Jude: Deal.
Jude joins the party!
Jude: My name is Judais Cato Gaius del Aeneus Tiberius...
*munch* ...
 
But you are free to call me Jude.
Jude: I am a mercenary from the Emerald Empire out in 
the east...  *munch*... and have no loyalty to the 
Nolvanus Empire here.
Jude: We'll be good friends so long as our deal is satisfied.
Pup: Good to have you on board with us this time, Jude.
Pup: (I hope Charlotte won't be too mad about me 
making this deal...)

passages.name: CH10 - Pup → Charlotte
passages.content:
Pup: There you are!
Charlotte: Great, you all made it through safely.
Pup: Was there ever a doubt?
Charlotte: So many.
Pup: Ack. This curse hasn't slowed me down, you know?
Charlotte: Keep talking like that and it might do so in overdrive
instead.
Pup: F- Fine...
Pup: Let's just do what we came here to do.

passages.name: CH10 - Rowan → Mariel
passages.content:
Mariel: Rowan...! You all are alright.

How about Pup? Are they okay?
Rowan: I do feel your care and love.
Rowan: Even if not for me.
Mariel: That's now what I...
Rowan: Our dear Pup seems to be putting the nature of 
their situation to the side.

For better or worse, it is an attempt to delay and
refocus on the task at hand.

And... I would say the effort seems sincere, as we 
were worried about.
Rowan: I can say less on if that effort will bear fruit.
Mariel: Also as we feared.
Mariel: Well... we'll just do what we can to support Pup.
Rowan: I am in full agreement.

I would not care for the sight of them to feel...
unrecognizable, after all.
Mariel: Same~

passages.name: CH10 - Elliot → Atticus
passages.content:
Elliot: Atticus. You are still alive.
Atticus: Hm... You again.
Atticus: Did you not leave for Cartenan after the inspection?
Elliot: I ran into this mercenary group on my way.
Elliot: Atticus, it sounds as though Oathbreakers are being
abused.
Atticus: Hmm... So nothing new.
Elliot: At the very least, I want to stop the opportunity 
for another to be subjected to that.
Atticus: Heheh, you did seem like a good kid before.
Atticus: Very well, be sure to keep up. Your form there 
should help.
Elliot: I'll do my best.

passages.name: CH10 - Kara → Atticus
passages.content:
Kara: Mr. Atticus Ranasseur. It is good to meet you.
Atticus: Excuse me, young miss. Who might you be?
Kara: Kara Lyons, of the Cartenan Lyons household.
Atticus: I... cannot say I am aware of them.
Kara: Nor is there any need to be.

I've followed your work through the historical 
tellings of the Crusades and beyond.

I simply wish to say it is a pleasure to meet you
properly.
Atticus: Hmm...
Atticus: Ah, same in return, then.
Atticus: Though I wish it could be under better 
circumstances.
Kara: I will delight in the meeting regardless.

passages.name: CH10 - Jude → Reagyn
passages.content:
Reagyn: You! Prepare to fall, fiend!
Jude: Hmm...
Jude: Aren't you with the Crows?
Reagyn: ...
Reagyn: Yes?
Jude: So am I.
Jude: Well, now I am.
Reagyn: ...
Reagyn: Are you attempting to bamboozle me?
Jude: Attack me, if you like.
Jude: It's starting to feel like it'd be less of a pain if we
need to go through all this "switching sides" drama.
Reagyn: ...
Reagyn: I'll be watching you. Carefully.
Jude: Yay.

passages.name: CH10 - Satia → Castel
passages.content:
Satia: Mr. Castel Balreig. I have a question.
Castel: Oh, so formal.
Castel: What does our fair Crow have for me today?
Satia: Anton. Pup.
Satia: How far are you from helping with this curse?
Castel: ...
Satia: You did experiments when we were in the 
Kingdom's capital, no?

Surely you have lead enough to mitigate it and give
peace of mind for a little bit.
Castel: ...No.
Castel: I wish I did. It would be a great help with my own
status.
Castel: But I've no intention to give up.
Satia: ...Alright.

...
Satia: Alright.

passages.name: CH10 - Norde → Tatiana
passages.content:
Tatiana: Eh... So that Atticus guy. He's a taikolyn, yeah?
Working with the Covenant.
Norde: So it seems.
Norde: I am not distinctly aware of many, let alone all
crusaders...
Norde: Non-homlyns do receive the honor it seems.
Tatiana: Honor? Working with the Covenent of all things?
Tatiana: Seems more like a sellout to me.
Norde: ...

He is our ally. Treat him with respect.
Norde: At least for the time being. I am not here to tell 
you what to think, after all.
Tatiana: Hmph...

passages.name: CH10 - Flynn → Otis
passages.content:
Flynn: So... the Covenant was hiding an Oathbreaker... so
close to the kingdom?
Otis: Heh. Expect it, lad.

That's what that lot does. All secrets and shit.
Flynn: But... so close to the kingdom.
Flynn: The empire theoretically could've grabbed it before
even attacking.
Otis: But they didn't.
Flynn: And... that's a good point. Why is that?
Otis: Eh, probably just isn't as useful as you'd think.

Shite is an Oathbreaker, not Zened himself.
Flynn: But isn't your... current state due to one?
Otis: Yeah, well, not all of 'em are gonna be like that.
Otis: They lock the things away cause they break the
Goddess's laws, not cause they all will break the
world.
Flynn: Right... that makes sense...
Flynn: Though, why do they want it now, then?
Otis: I really have no idea, lad.

passages.name: CH10 - New Event
passages.content:
Blood dripping to the ground, muffled footsteps
haphazardly sounded out from the wounded
warrior.
Defeated Soldier: *Pant*... *pant*...

Need to get back to... *pant*... camp...

I need to... Huh?
Jude: *Pant*...  *pant*...
Jude: Need to... fuck... this is a deeper wound than I
thought...
Jude: Huh...?
A sound from a distance caught his attention, and 
he slipped behind a nearby tree.
Soldier?: Here it is.
Other Soldier: Excellent.
A small trinket was handed from one to the other.
Other Soldier: I'll be sure to get this to our shared acquaintance.

Do you have an excuse prepared for why the 
Imperial garrison failed to get it?
Soldier?: Yes, that mercenary that was in charge. We'll place 
the blame on him.

By the time anyone confirms that it really was
retrieved, it'll be too late.
Defeated Soldier: W- What...?
*Snap*...!
Defeated Soldier: H- huh?!
Jude: What? Aren't those some of the soldiers from my
command...?
*Snap* ...!
Jude: ...?!
A twig snapped beneath his foot.
Soldier?: Hm? Is that...?
Other Soldier: Heh. Better take care of that loose end.
They turned to approach.
Defeated Soldier: W- Wait, I can... I can...!
Jude: *Pant* ... Crap... I don't stand a chance... in this
condition.

After all this bullshit... am I really gonna... like
this...?
Jude: F- Fuck it.... I...!

passages.name: CH10 - New Event
passages.content:
We Nightless Crows pushed forward through the
mountainous pass.
Once outside of the more treacherous path, we 
setup camp away from the well trodden trails.
Despite this, an inkling of danger became quite
clear...
There was strange movement by the imperial 
forces.
Strange movement that may indicate a play at...
Pup: ...a Vault?
Elliot: To the north, there is the Border Mountain Vault.

If there was a target in the area, it would be that.
Kara: To our north lies a Covenant Vault.

I am unaware of any other potential targets in the
area.
Pup: A Vault specifically being...?
Rowan: A Covenant stronghold.
Rowan: One with a dangerous treasure within...
Charlotte: An Oathbreaker, right?

Cainan... Kara's fiancé... He was a Covenant auditor,
right?
Elliot: Correct. I am his assistant in that endeavor.

We are the quality control for protection of
Oathbreakers. We check each Vault to ensure it is
secure.
Elliot: My recent visit did not indicate any issues... but an
army attacking, especially if they catch Atticus off
guard...
Kara: He is, indeed. He travels between Vaults and 
ensures they are secure.
Kara: Though, an army assault on a none- the-wiser Vault
is...
Pup: That means that they're protecting an Oathbreaker
there?
Pup: What... What sort of one? Is it like that... You 
know, the sword?
Kara: Not necessarily. There isn't a known limit to the
potential effects of an Oathbreaker.
Rowan: Like my own being a 'master key' of sorts.
Pup: Right...
Flynn: More importantly, it should be secure, correct? The
Covenant leaves no stone unturned to protect
Oathbreakers.
Norde: More importantly, is this Vault properly secured? I
can't imagine the Covenant would leave it without a
defender.
Elliot: The defensive mechanisms were operational when I
checked last.

And Atticus, the Guardian, was as diligent as the
protection plans expect of him.
Kara: Most likely they have it well maintained and with a
Guardian stationed there.
Norde: A Guardian... All Vaults have one, correct?
Pup: Gu

passages.name: CH10 - New Event
passages.content:
The travel was not lengthy, and we approached 
the hidden Vault.
Soldier: ...
Otis: Ugh... They did come this way.
Rowan: Imperial soldiers.
Charlotte: Yeah... Are they doing patrols?
Kara: Ah... So you are recognizing militaristic patterns 
now? That is a good skill to have.
Charlotte: Y- Yeah...?
Charlotte: It's just a matter of experience.
Pup: The patrol seems stationary.
Norde: That, or they are segmenting their coverage.
Kara: In an area this isolated, would they be able to 
sustain that cadence?
Pup: I mean... if they have enough people, then sure.
Rowan: Or if they have any beasties to cover the gaps.
Rowan: Not a dragon in sight... yet.
Pup: They're not gonna have a dragon... again...
Pup: (No, that'd be crazy...)
Reagyn: Assuming the dragon didn't stop here.
Norde: Assuming the dragon's retreat didn't lead it here.
Our conversation stalled.
.........
Rowan: A patrol means they're organized and here with intent.
Kara: Yes. That is true, Alexei.

Meaning they're executing an operation, or... have
already done so.
Charlotte: We should hurry.
Kara: Despite us acting as a scouting unit ahead of the 
other Crows...

We'd be best served to get through the holes in 
the patrol by splitting up.
Norde: Are you sure? This is a heavily forested area.
Norde: The poor sightlines stand out. As though the 
location was chosen... or designed... for that 
purpose.
Norde motioned to the trees, and a brief look did 
make it clear that seeing anything from a distance 
would be difficult.
It was a big part of why we could get as close as 
we did without the Imperial troops detecting us.
Norde: I would doubt anyone's ability to improvise should
things not go to plan here.
Pup: Then, our patron Ms. Stewart...

How do you want to approach this? How should 
we split up?
Charlotte: Oh, that'd b- be simple.
Charlotte: I...
Charlotte fidgeted around.
Charlotte: Wait, maybe...
Her hand had landed on her pack, and slipped in to 
pull out something I had not seen before.
Charlotte: How a

passages.name: CH10 - New Event
passages.content:
Splitting into multiple groups, I found myself with a
few familiar faces.
The plan was straightforward.
We'd each approach from different directions and 
use the flare gun to coordinate our attack.
Outside of our advanced party...

The other Crows were securing an escape route in 
case things went south quickly, along with stealthily 
thinning out the patrols.
Deliberately, we made our way to our designated 
spot.
Pup: Guard is at 5 o'clock.

If we're right about the timing, he'll move in...
5...4...3...2...

Go.
We each shuffled as stealthily as we could through 
the thick forest.
Otis: We movin'. Not a sign of the next one.
Crow: No sign of a new patrol yet.
Pup: Good. Let's not stop here.
We weaved deliberately for a while longer, keeping
track of our foot placements to make sure we
were headed in the right direction.
Crow: And... adjust now.
Pup: ...
Rowan: So... Pup... you are ready for this, yes?
Pup: Yes.
Rowan: Well, when it was mentioned that your father was 
a Guardian, I thought that maybe...
Pup: H- Hey Elliot. I was meaning to ask you something.
Rowan: ...
Elliot: Yes?
Pup: How do you transform yourself when you're fighting?
Pup: No one is making a big deal out of THAT, but 
you're literally changing entirely.
Elliot: Ah, my gray magic?
Elliot: It isn't... anything uniquely complicated.
Elliot: It is gray magic. Which is a combination of red, 
blue, and green magic.

The Covenant teaches that the prayers of our 
ancestors are held deep within our heirlooms...
Elliot: And you can use the three branches of magic to 
create an echo of that lineage to envelop yourself 
in it.
From the energy of red magic, the divine 
manifestations of blue, and the creation nature of 
green magic...
You can extend that legacy to face the challenges 
of today.
Rowan: And such an act transforms you into a woman?
Elliot: ...

Yes.
Rowan: Well, it is a blessing of your familial heritage, so
perhaps you can indulge in-
Elliot: A- And to answer a likely additional question...
Ell

passages.name: CH10 - New Event
passages.content:
Atticus: ...
Soldier: Argh!
Pup: That's...  *pant*... I think that's all of them?
Kara: At least amongst those that did not flee...

We should reinitiate contact with the rest of the 
Crows to see how well our net caught those in 
retreat.
As Kara said the words, the stone faced man 
turned towards us.
Atticus: ...
Norde: ...
Norde: I will reconnect with the rest of the Crows, then.
Norde stepped away, but the space he occupied 
was not long left unattended.
Atticus: Hmm...
A tall older man stepped towards us, towering 
above me.
He was clearly taikolyn, with scales like I had seen 
on Norde, including a beard like formation of them.
Most strikingly...
Elliot: Atticus Ranasseur. Guardian of the Border Mountain
Vault and Ashen Fox of the Crusades...
Atticus: The Covenant's man... Elliot, was it?
Elliot: It seems we were in time to help.
Charlotte: So you're this Vault's Guardian? I've heard about you
lot.
Atticus: Hmm...

Atticus. Atticus Ranasseur.
Charlotte: Please to meet you. I'm happy we made it in time.
Atticus: Hmm... I thank you for it.
I could see it through the swaying strands of hair
across his face...
A stone eye.
Pup: H- Hello...
Based on the movement of his body and what I 
could see, it looked like the better part of his  
right side was turned to stone.
Charlotte: Hello. I am Charlotte Stewart of the city state of
Lockhart.
Mariel: I'm Mariel Stewart, of the same.
Charlotte: The others with me are the Nightless Crow mercenary
company.
Atticus: Including him?
A familiar yet unfamiliar man walked up 
alongside us.
Jude: ...
Atticus's hand leaned onto his hilt.
Jude: *Sigh*... the battle's over. Could you calm down?
Charlotte: Why is... he here? And alive?
Pup: Uh... I might have made an offer?
Pup: Y- You know mercenaries can be bought, right?
Charlotte: ...

How much?
Jude: I'm not a cheap date.
Charlotte: Mmm...
Pup: Haha... hahaha...
Atticus: And your loyalties?
Jude: Never had any loyalty to them. I'm from the 
Emerald Empire.
Atticus: Normally bein

haphazardly sounded out from the wounded
warrior.

Need to get back to... *pant*... camp...

I need to... Huh?
Jude: *Pant*...  *pant*...
Jude: Need to... fuck... this is a deeper wound than I

Jude: Huh...?
A sound from a distance caught his attention, and 
he slipped behind a nearby tree.
Soldier?: Here it is.
Other Soldier: Excellent.

Other Soldier: I'll be sure to get this to our shared acquaintance.

Do you have an excuse prepared for why the

Soldier?: Yes, that mercenary that was in charge. We'll place 
the blame on him.

By the time anyone confirms that it really was
retrieved, it'll be too late.
Defeated Soldier: W- What...?
*Snap*...!
Defeated Soldier: H- huh?!
Jude: What? Aren't those some of the soldiers from my
command...?
*Snap* ...!
Jude: ...?!
A twig snapped beneath his foot.
Soldier?: Hm? Is that...?
Other Soldier: Heh. Better take care of that loose end.
They turned to approach.
Defeated Soldier: W- Wait, I can... I can...!
Jude: *Pant* ... Crap... I don't stand a chance... in this
condition.

After all this bullshit... am I really gonna... like
this...?
Jude: F- Fuck it.... I...!

passages.name: CH10 - New Event
passages.content:
Charlotte: *Yawn*...
Charlotte pulled herself up from her bedding.
Charlotte: Is stone better than dirt below the bedding...?
Charlotte: *Sigh*... Neither.
Her head turned and eventually laid her eyes on a
figure approaching her.
Atticus: Charlotte Stewart.
Charlotte: Huh?
As Atticus continued to talk, Charlotte went to
pull herself to her feet.
Atticus: I have a request to make of you...
Charlotte: *Yawn*... Good morning.
Charlotte: What do you need?
Atticus: ...
Atticus's hand moved to rest on his weapon.
Atticus: I wish to accompany your group.
Atticus looked away a bit meekly. His hand rubbed
around where he had been wounded.
Atticus: I need you to add another goal to your journey.
Charlotte: W- What? Why?
Atticus: ...

The Oathbreaker is gone.
Atticus joins the team!

passages.name: CH11-1 - New Event
passages.content:
Rowan: Beasts...?
Pup: Be on guard!

I don't think this is a wild animal.
Win Condition: Defeat all beasts
Lose Condition (Optional): Pup and Rowan get

passages.name: CH11-1 - Turn 1
passages.content:
Rowan: M- More...?!
Pup: Yeah, these are definitely scouts.

passages.name: CH11-1 - Win con 1
passages.content:
Rowan: *Pant*... Is that all of them?
Pup: Yeah... Yeah, I think so.
Charlotte: W- What happened?!
Rowan: Just in time, my good friends.

passages.name: CH11-1 - Win con 1
passages.content:
Rowan: This... did not go how I hoped...
Pup: Shit... I need to... to...
Charlotte: Duck!
Pup: ...?!
I jumped to Rowan, pushing him down to the ground with
me.
Charlotte: Got 'em!
Kara: Are you two okay?
Pup: Better now... thank you.
Rowan: Let me just... use this chance to cast some healing
magic.

passages.name: CH11-1 - Story Intro
passages.content:
Breathe.
Breathe.
...BREATHE!
Pup: *Gasp* ...!
I breathed in deeply and desperately tried to 
fill my lungs with air.
It was like I hadn't breathed for an eternity.
Pup: ...Where... am I...?
The thought crept through my mind as my 
breathing slowed.
Slowly, but surely, my eyes drifted through 
the area.
Pup: (It's like... a mine?)
Pup: (No, it's more like... tunnels. Like the sort built to
move through a building...)
Pup: (Half finished, but...)
I stood there for a moment.
I didn't know why, but...
Pup: Have I... been here before?
So I took a step.
And in that moment... from around a corner...
I saw them.
Nikolai: Haha~
Anton: ...
Two figures burst from the cavernous corridor,
sprinting around the corner and out of view.
Pup: That is... That was...

...
Pup: That was...
That was...
Anton: ...that was me.
In the blink of an eye, I was the figure that
I saw running about before.
Anton: (Wait... why am I... a kid again?)
Estella: Anton! Nikolai!
Anton: That voice...
Estella: Come back! It's too late for this.
Anton: Is that... really...

...mom?
As the thought passed through my head, I felt a 
hand on my wrist.
Nikolai: C'mon, Anton!
Anton: Nikolai...
Nikolai: We gotta keep moving!
Anton: But, what about...
Estella: Where are you?! It's dangerous down here!
Anton: It's... dangerous down here?
Nikolai: Heheh~ Don't worry.

I'll protect you.
Anton: You...?
Nikolai: Of course. It's what a big brother does, isn't it?

I'll protect you, Anton. No matter what.
Anton: ...
Anton: Okay...
I felt a tug on my wrist.
Nikolai: Heheh~
Anton: Ah...!
And I was pulled along into the corridor.
Nikolai and I ran through the tunnels, passing all
sorts of strange structures and unfinished
construction.
It felt like an eternity.
An eternity of our play.
Anton: Haha...
But as we turned one more corner...
Anton: Nikolai...?
My brother disappeared.
Anton: Nikolai... where are you...?
My heart began to beat faster and faster, and my 
walk picked up into a run.
Anton: Nikolai!

...

MOM...!
Turn

passages.name: CH11-1 - Story
passages.content:
Pup: *Pant*... *pant*...
Rowan: Might I ask what that was?
Otis: Ya two still alive? Can't have been too bad.
Norde: You two should be more careful around wild animals/
Pup: No, I think those are scout beasts.
Kara: Tracking animals?
Pup: Yeah. They were too... organized for wild animals.
Pup: They had to be trained.
Charlotte: So what does that mean?
The chatter died down, as people 
became thoughtful.
Kara: So we've lost much of our lead.
Norde: You think it's that flier woman?
Charlotte: The mercenary that was chasing us from Cartenan?
Nora: ...
Kara: Even if we're being paranoid, we should act on it.
Charlotte: You're not wrong, but... that does mean that we 
can't do what we discussed.
Pup: What?
Kara: Yes, that option is off the table.
Kara: It would be much too time consuming to deviate 
from the roads and keep ourselves supplied, 
unfortunately.
Kara: We must traverse through Crekskia.
Pup: ...
Pup: ...

...Okay.
Pup: Okay.
[Choice]:  / 
What do you remember?
I sat against a rock, and my legs curled up a bit
towards my body.
Pup: What do I remember?

...
Pup: It can be hard to tell... what is memory and what is
imagination anymore...
Aegis: You do not need to rush it.
Pup: I guess...
I calmed myself down, trying to scour my mind
for what scraps of it remained within.
Memories.
Memories of Crekskia.
Memories of my family.
Pup: There was this one time... I think...
Pup: My brother was playing hero. And I was... the 
damsel in distress.
Pup: Not literally. I was like a villager or something.
Aegis: 'Hero'...?
Pup: Yeah, based on old fairytales and bedtime stories 
my Mom told us.
Aegis: It gives a warm feeling to the heart.
Pup: One of my favorites was about Tuvae the 
Shepherd.

The story of a simple shepherd who was able to 
hold off an army, and guide his people to safety.
Pup: Ah... I always wanted to be Tuvae but Nikolai 
wanted to play that too...

I often was the one shepherding the 'townsfolk' to
safety.
Aegis: It appears to give you warm memories as we

passages.name: CH12 - Story Start
passages.content:
After spending the morning training up our advance
unit, we arrived on scene.
As we did, we found the Fort approach to be a
combination of the plains and hills we had seen so 
far.
The mines weren't readily apparent, but we could 
see a scattering of beasts and remnant soldiers.
Pup: (They're still probably around from previous fights in
the area...)

Hmm...
I turned to our group.
Pup: We're as prepared as we can get for this. Be ready. 
Be vigilant.
The group I had assembled nodded back.
And that included...
Charlotte: ...
Pup: You know... I said it before, but you don't need to
stick your neck out for this task.
Rowan: It is... a dangerous affair.
Kara: And one that is important to pick the right 
personnel for.
Pup: Yeah...
Mariel: Yeah, sis. We have Lockhart to save, right?

I get why you may feel the urge to now, but... 
You don't need to take this risk.
Charlotte: Thank you, Mariel. You know me so well, but... 
that also means you'll get why I need to say this.
Charlotte: I agree with Kara.
Charlotte: I am the most experienced person here with 
bleeding edge technology. These landmines are 
something I've seen before.
Pup: You're not... wrong.
Charlotte: And... what would it make me if I was equipped to 
help and decided to throw the task onto someone 
else for the sake of my safety?
Pup: ...
Kara: ...
Rowan: *Sigh*...
Charlotte: I'm happy you all understand.
Mariel: ...
Pup: (I'll... try to keep an eye on if her needing sleep
puts her at risk...)

passages.name: CH12 - First Third
passages.content:
Pup: ...

.........
Pup: (What's that feel-)
Pup: ...!
Pup: (An earthquake...?)
Pup: (Well, there's no volcano this time... I think...)
I looked around at the others, and no one seemed
perturbed by it enough to retreat.
Not yet.

passages.name: CH12 - Second Third
passages.content:
Pup: ...?
Pup: ...Again.

(Maybe we should retreat...?)
I turned to Charlotte.
Charlotte: ...
She was stone-faced. She was determined.
Pup: (We've come too far to stop now...)
So I turned forward again.
Crow: Another rumble.

Watcha think it was?
Other Crow: I swear to the Godess if there's another one 
of those exploding mountains...
Both were fixated out towards the battlefield.
Behind the two...
Imperial: .........
...were a couple of the captive Imperial soldiers and
hired mercenaries that had been interrogated.
Crow: I sure hope not. I can't imagine the Goddess would be
that-
Other Crow: Huh?!
Other Crow: Ugh!
And the two fell to the ground.
Mercenary: Finally... they shut the fuck up.
He started messing with his bindings...
Imperial: I think I know where they were holdin' the rest of 
us.

passages.name: CH12 - Map End
passages.content:
Pup: Huh...? I can... feel that...!
Pup: (Maybe... we really should step back...)
Mercenary: There you go.
Nora: Thank you.
Mercenary: So, should we head over to the Imperial base?

I'm pretty sure there is at least one makeshift one 
in the town up north.

That... or we could go home to Lockhart and 
regroup.
Nora: ...No.
Nora: I won't let that woman drag Lockhart back into 
that hellish night.

Farmland mines are often not very kind to 
farm crops.

Red crops tend to be long lived. Meaning no
mines probably have gone off around them any
time lately.
...that means the mines are probably still there
around them. Red means unsafe.

Blue crops are shorter lived, so there's at least
a better chance the mines are already gone from
where you see them.
Don't go gettin' blown up, ya lot.

Jude: Only what might deteriorate your humanity.
Reagyn: ...
Reagyn stumbled for the second, but soon enough...
Reagyn: I was only offering idling thoughts.

I do not need the opinions of a man from the 
Emerald Empire.
Jude: As you say, ma'am.

passages.name: CH12 - Atticus → Kara
passages.content:
Atticus: You seem quite knowledgable despite being so far 
from Cartenan.
Kara: I can give full credit to the Queen's willingness to
let me travel.
Atticus: Is that so? I assume it was limited to political
missions?
Kara: Largely, though there were a few occasions I had 
free time.

I'd be happy to give your recommendations on
restaurants if you ever are planning a vacation.
Atticus: I'd appreciate that.

passages.name: CH12 - Tatiana → Castel
passages.content:
Tatiana: Why was I picked for the minefield mission?
Castel: Why was I picked for the minefield mission?
They said at the same time.
Tatiana: You too?
Castel: So it seems...
Tatiana: Well, let's at least make sure they don't regret
picking us.
Castel: Or... we could let them focus on the mines?
Tatiana: I though ya were supposed to be smart?
Castel: I am not equipped to disarm a mine while being attacked
by enemies...!
Tatiana: Then I'll watch your back.
Castel: Oh... thank you...
Castel: Wait, no, that's not the problem...!

passages.name: CH12 - Flynn → Elliot
passages.content:
Elliot: I wonder... if I target my bow just right...
Flynn: Please don't try it.
Elliot: You're right. One wrong move and I could activate 
a different one.
Flynn: You... listened...?
Flynn: Thank you.
Elliot: Good advice comes from good sources.

passages.name: CH12 - New Event
passages.content:
Nora: Mm...
Nora sat on a rudimentary chair with her hands 
and feet securely bound.
The hot light of a magical lamp shone down onto
her, creating the main light source in the room.
Norde: Name, homeland, occupation.
Norde sat across from her.
Nora: .........

Nora Nicollet. Lockhart. Mercenary.
Charlotte: Mercenary for the Empire.
Charlotte stepped into the edges of the light.
Nora: Mercenary for liberating Lockhart.
Charlotte: Because Imperials are the epitome of freedom and
liberty.
Nora: They've done it before.
Norde: Yes, from the Emerald Empire.
Norde: The same can be said for most of the continent.
Charlotte: Lockhart, included.
Norde: What we need to know...

...is what the Empire is planning.
Nora: ...
Norde: We can wait.
Nora: ...

I'm not an Imperial.
Charlotte: Heh. So they didn't trust her enough to tell her.
Nora: I won't betray Lockhart.
Charlotte: Too late.
Nora: .........

For which of us is it too late, Princess?
Charlotte: ...
Nora: ...
The two stared at each other, daggers pointed at 
each others' souls.
Norde: The question we want answered isn't-
Charlotte: What did they offer you?
Norde: Stewart, we don't need to engage in-
Charlotte: It's fine. I'm used to her random jabs at this point.
Norde: That's not...
Charlotte: So... what was the price of selling out Lockhart?
Nora: You mean, "what was the price of the traitors' 
heads?"

The price of the cretins who stomp all over an 
entire city to line their pockets with gold?
Charlotte: ...?!
Norde: Stop. We aren't trying to-
Charlotte: Who are you to try and speak for the people of 
Lockhart after you brought war to its streets?!
Nora: What do you think those streets are paved with?

It's the blood, sweat, and tears of everyone BUT 
you.
Nora: You've never seen a friend go to work one day and 
not return, have you?
Charlotte: What...?
Nora: An "accident".

At the docks. The factory. The proving grounds.
Nora: Swept aside, and the next desperate soul steps up 
to fill their place.
Charlotte: What?

passages.name: CH12 - Story
passages.content:
Heyzus: ...! Where... did...
Imperial: Just go down, you swine!
Heyzus: Wait... aren't you the-
Nora: ...
Nora burst forth on her griffin, speeding past the
clash between the Crow and Imperial.
Heyzus: Crap...! They're the prisoners...!
Mariel: *Pant*...  *pant*...
Mariel: Hey... Heyzus...!
Heyzus: Don't worry about me, I've got this!

They went after your sister!
Mariel: ...
Mariel looked back between Heyzus and 
the path forward.
Heyzus: Go!
Mariel: ...Thank you.
And she sprinted off.
Imperial: Maybe you should pay attention to the blade in 
front of you...!
Nora and a few of the other imperial mercenaries
swiftly made their way through the minefields.
Their self-preservation be damned...
Nora: ...
But they managed through with little damage 
thanks to the path paved by the Crows.
It wasn't long until they were on top of us.
Pup: We've made good progress, all things considered.
Charlotte: I agree.
Mariel: I'll always be impressed by your technical 
skill, sis.
Charlotte was near me, and I turned towards 
her only to see her still stone-faced.
Pup: (It's probably best that she's... focused...)
Pup: (She has done nothing but a good job so far.)
I turned towards where we were heading.
Pup: Ya know... we're not in that much of a hurry.
And I turned back towards Charlotte.
Pup: Maybe we can take a break and-
Pup: ...!?
Nora: ...!
From the corner of my eye, a blur came into frame.
The blood red armor triggered my fight or flight, 
and I stepped forward.
Charlotte: ...?!
With one arm, I pushed Charlotte to the side...
Nora: ...
Pup: ...!
...and I drew my sword with the other.
The clash pushed me back, and I managed to 
keep my footing.
Pup: The fox eared mercenary...
Mariel: Her...
Charlotte: ...but how?
Charlotte had fallen to the ground, and she looked 
at the two of us with blades pointed to each 
other.
Nora: There's been enough talking.
Charlotte: But... we... I...
Charlotte: Argh...!

So be it!
From her prone position, Charlotte reached for her
holster and her gun.

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Jude (Dead)
passages.content: Jude: Ngh! ...That's my limit. Falling back.

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Jude (Pup)
passages.content:

Jude: You guard is weak to your right.
Pup: What?

J- Just shut up and fight!
Jude: That, I can do.

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Start of Battle
passages.content:
Norde: Enemy troops litter the cityscape.

Many citizens have fled here for safety, but many 
still are trying to make the voyage.
Pup: The soldier we met before is leading the effort to 
thin the herd of enemies, right?
Rowan: And when they reach a breaking point, then comes 
the grand finale?
Norde: I am surprised that you are still here.
Rowan: The best way to pen the chorus of glorious victory 
is to storm the enemy myself, no?
Ivan: No storming, charging, or singing of any kind.
Rowan: Very well. It will wait for a better time.
Norde: To note, the enemy appears to be hiring  
mercenaries of their own, and they may have 
some aces up their sleeve.
Norde: Avoid them if possible. There is little more to make 
a mercenary dangerous than not yet having 
their paycheck for the day.
Ivan: Our mission is to shepherd the people to safety and 
keep those within covered. Be vigilant.
Win Condition: Survive until sentry arrives. 
Lose condition: 3 villagers die, Pup, Ivan, Rowan die

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Charlotte Joins
passages.content:
Female Voice: ...not going... wait around...
Another Voice: ...too dangerous... guards handle...
Civilian: Stage one complete.
Mariel: Y- You shot him!
Charlotte: Serves him right, the 3rd rate assassin from a 3rd 
rate country.
Charlotte holstered her smoking pistol.
Charlotte: I'm tired of cowering in fear. Sis, how about we 
take-
Murmurs arose from the crowd of Lockhart citizens 
around the two girls.
Civilian: Is that... Did she just...?
Civilian: The princess?! Did something happen in the 
estate?!
Charlotte: Ah- Uh... Well...
Mariel: Charlotte, we should head back inside. It's 
dangerous out here.
Charlotte: You don't need to follow me, but I'm
not going to stand idly by.
Charlotte: I rather find the person I need to grind under my 
boot to make this stop.
Charlotte: Who is in charge out here?!
Ivan: The Lockhart princess and her younger sister?

You do know we are trying to keep you and yours 
safe, yes?
Ivan: *Sigh*... But you'd be safer helping us than 
running off on your own, too...
Charlotte: Such pleasantly expedited negotiations. I'm sure 
we'll work well together.
Charlotte: Mariel, if you want to stay away from the fighting, 
then go back inside with Mother and Father or help 
heal the people gathered here.
Mariel: I mean... I...
Mariel: I'll help, too! J- Just tell me what I need to do!
Charlotte and Mariel were recruited!
Win Condition: Survive until sentry arrives. 
Lose condition: 3 villagers die, Pup, Ivan, Rowan die
Charlotte or Mariel die.

passages.content:

Ivan: Hm?

It looks like the Lockhart soldiers are regrouping 
around the mansion. Let's fall back and join them.

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Charlotte → Rowan
passages.content:
Rowan: Why, hello there. How have you fared on this 
waning day, young miss?
Charlotte: We've got a jokester now? Whoever you are, 
there is a fight to focus on.
Rowan: Oh?
Charlotte: Heh. Unless you're offering to be a human shield.

We've never tested if this prototype pistol could 
shoot a round through two bodies, after all.
Rowan: As tempting as the offer is... Alas, I do require this 
body should I wish to sing the song of victory.
Rowan: I will step aside.
Charlotte: Good.
Charlotte: Stay alive, will you? I want to hear that song when 
we're done here.
Rowan: I will do my utmost.

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Pup → Mariel
passages.content:
Mariel: H- Hello?
Pup: Oh, one of the Lockhart girls.
Pup: No need to fear. I- ..I'll protect you.
Mariel: Protect? You?
Pup: Sorry?
Mariel: N- Nothing!
Pup: Just stay behind me when you can. I can take 
these rabble no problem.
Mariel: You'll be a great protector, I'm sure. Just lead the 
way.
Pup: Of course.
I ran off to the next fight.
Mariel: I got to make sure he stays safe.

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Jakson → Mariel
passages.content:
Mariel: Aw~ A cute puppy. Are you lost?
Jakson: *Confused whine*?
Mariel: I suppose you're not quite a puppy, but a grand ol' 
beautiful furball.
Mariel: Where are your owners? We should-
Mariel: Huh...?!
An enemy soldier appeared from behind a corner
Mariel: N- No!
Jakson: *Angry bark*!
Jakson leaped at the enemy, quickly disarming him 
and knocking him out.
Jakson: *Angry growl*...
Mariel: ...C-... C- Cute puppy...
Jakson: *Happy bark*!

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Pup → Ivan
passages.content:
Ivan: How are you holding up, Pup?
Pup: I'm... *Pant*... good.
Ivan: Fall back if you start to lose momentum.
Pup: Right, right...
Pup: Let's go! We can do this!
I started off ahead of my father and back into the 
fray.
Pup: (We can do it. I can do it. We're strong. I'm... 
going to be strong.)
Ivan: ...

passages.name: CH3 Battle1 - Norde → Satia
passages.content:
Satia: Ah, this almost makes me nostalgic
for Belven.
Norde: What? You mean that warzone?
Satia: A crossroads of three nations... A city at their 
center?
Norde: If the Republic shows up now, the city will truly 
burn to it's foundation, you know?
Satia: Hehe~ ...Perhaps.
Satia: Ivan and Pup weren't even with the Crows back 
then. A lot of time has passed.

You and I were closer to fresh recruits around 
then, too
Satia: That's nostalgia for you, I guess.
Norde: Hmph. I suppose I can understand... a little.

passages.content:

In the Deployment/Battle Prep Menu you will be 
able to choose your units and manage their 
inventory. 
Select or deselct units in the UNIT menu.

Manage their inventory in the MANAGE Menu. You

passages.name: CH3 Pre Battle - Cont
passages.content:
Rowan: Watch out!
Pup: Huh...?
Pup: I- I... shit...
Pup: That flew right by my head!
Lockhart Sentry: Imperial scum.
Lockhart Sentry: You. Targets of this bandit. Are you friend or foe?
Pup: Who are-
Norde: We are the Nightless Crows mercenary corp. We 
were hired to help protect the city.
Lockhart Sentry: In the city itself? Bloody gold fingers had no faith, 
did they?

*Sigh*... Though I could hardly blame them at this 
point.
Pup: W- We want to help the civilians!
Lockhart Sentry: Good enough.

The people have been evacuated largely to the 
north around the governor's mansion.

If your group could reinforce that position, it would 
do a lot to let the rest of us clear out these cretin.
Ivan: Understood. We will head to the mansion, then.
Pup: R- Right... Thank you!

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Nora (Ivan)
passages.content:
Ivan: You've not the look of an Imperial soldier. Are you 
another hired mercenary?
Nora: I'd put up your guard, if I were you. You're not 
close to dropping mine.

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Nora (Norde)
passages.content:
Nora: You'd stand with these... monsters?
Norde: Are those ears just for show? I stand with those I 
trust, of course.
Norde: Besides, I see only one monster in front of me. The 
one fighting for this atrocity.
Nora: Tsk... Self-destructive fool.

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Nora (Mariel)
passages.content:
Nora: Target 2 acquired.
Nora: I'd say it's nothing personal, but... well...
Mariel: I'm not afraid... I'm not afraid of you b- bullies!

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Nora (Charlotte)
passages.content:
Nora: Target 1 acquired.
Charlotte: Oh, are you part of this too? Are you another 
assassin?
Charlotte: I'll gladly use you as target practice for the damned 
"Wolf" later.
Nora: As self serving as one would expect.
Nora: For Lockhart!

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Nora (Active)
passages.content:
Nora: Mercenaries fighting for the "princesses"? Fine, you 
will share their fate.

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Nora (Dead)
passages.content:
Nora: It's no good. I have to retreat... This isn't the end 
of this!

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Steel Wolf (Ivan)
passages.content:
Steel Wolf: Death... would suit you well.
Ivan: I know.

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Steel Wolf (Pup)
passages.content:
Pup: Everyone keep going!
Pup: I- I can hold him off!
Steel Wolf: What an... empty visage.

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Steel Wolf (Rowan)
passages.content:
Rowan: The "Steel Wolf", is it? You've fought on the front 
lines of the crusades, too?
Steel Wolf: ...

No exceptions.
Rowan: Crap... it's no use trying to ask questions.

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Sat Alive
passages.content: Satia: What's the rush for?

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - SatDed
passages.content: Norde: Why are you hurrying?

passages.name: CH3 Battle2 - Battle start
passages.content:
Norde: That... man...
Ivan: We're evacuating ourselves and these two girls to 
outside the city.
Norde: "The Steel Wolf"...?
Rowan: You know who that man is?
Charlotte: Do tell.
Norde: His armor looks similar to a man I've read about fairly 
recently.

A crusader that was extremely deadly and gained 
the nickname "Steel Wolf".
Rowan: Crusader? From out in the-
Ivan: There is no time for this!
Ivan: Norde, can we escape to outside of Lockhart?
Norde: They've created a perimeter, but it is thin.

It appears more meant to take the city than to 
entrap those within.
Norde: We'll have to break through their line, however.
Ivan: Then that's the plan. Break their line and get out.

Do whatever you can to stay alive, everyone.
Win Condition: Escape
Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan, Charlotte, Mariel,  Ivan 
die

passages.name: CH3 Inter - Lockhart Sentry (Steel Wolf)
passages.content:
Lockhart Sentry: How... wretched! I will end that stain you place on 
existence itself!
Steel Wolf: ...

passages.name: CH3 Inter - Lockhart Sentry (Dead)
passages.content: Lockhart Sentry: How... How did- did...?

passages.name: CH3 Inter - Opening
passages.content:
Lockhart Sentry: My ladies, are you alright?
Mariel: We've been... managing.
Charlotte: Let's just get to the point. What's the situation? 
How are we faring?
Lockhart Sentry: Very well, then.

The invading force inside the city has only stragglers 
remaining.
Ivan: I do believe I saw some of the soldiers retreating 
for the city limits.
Pup: Victory, then? We won?
Rowan: I do wonder...
Lockhart Sentry: Mercenary, are you suggesting what I think you 
are?
Ivan: Hm... The amount of men they'd have to hire to 
supplement the Nolvanus regiment would be 
absurd.
Ivan: That, and the soldiers they'd need to divert from 
their war with Rabaneau...
Pup: Wait? What would they need those sorts of 
numbers for?
Rowan: Surrounding the city, no?
Pup: S- Surrounding... What? How?!
Charlotte: Could they actually manage that?
Lockhart Sentry: Well... If they focus on strategic points, then it's 
not unfeasible.
Ivan: Even then, their numbers couldn't be enough to 
manage it.
Rowan: Or they simply wished to project such intent onto 
our weary minds?
Mariel: M- Maybe they were just retreating? It doesn't 
need to be some dastardly plan, right?
Charlotte: We're not about to just imagine up an answer.
Charlotte: You said we've just stragglers left? Dedicate some 
men to scout the outskirts of the city.
Lockhart Sentry: That would be most wise, my lady. For such a bold 
move as invasion, this has felt too... simple.

It would be best to-
He was cutoff by the approach of marching feet.
Rowan: It was only a matter of time.

passages.name: CH3 Inter - After march
passages.content:
Charlotte: Speak of the devil.
Pup: Is that guy a Nolvanus general?
Ivan: Yes. Do not interfere.
Ruslan: Am I speaking to a representative of the current 
Lockhart government?
Mariel: "Current"...?
Charlotte: Whatever you want to say, you can say it to me.
Ruslan: Charlotte Stewart? Heir to the Stewart Works 
conglomerate that runs the Lockhart government.

And Mariel Stewart? 2nd child of the Stewart 
Works leading family.
Charlotte: Out with it, or get out of our city.
Ruslan: Hmph...
Ruslan: Charlotte and Mariel Stewart. You and others of 
the Stewart Works group are under arrest for 
treason against Lockhart.
Charlotte: What did you just say? Choose your next words 
carefully.
Ruslan: I, as representative of the Nolvanus government, 
act as a patron to the Lockhart City Council.

Hearing of the havoc your family has caused with 
it's duplicitous dealings with the Republic...
The general motioned to the damaged cityscape 
around him.
Ruslan: ...the Emperor had no choice but to intervene 
when requested by the council itself.
Lockhart Sentry: How dare you besmirch the good name of Lockhart 
and the Stewarts!
Mariel: That's... why would they...?
Charlotte: What a bunch of- of...! ...of catshit!

When I get my hands on the necks of those 
backstabbing, scheming bastards...
Rowan: To go to such ridiculous lengths...
Pup: No one's ever going to believe that story.
Ivan: They don't need to.
Ivan: Now calm down.
Pup: Grh...
Ruslan: What say you? Will you cooperate peacefully?
Charlotte: I... will never...
Charlotte: *Sigh*...
Charlotte: We Stewarts will never bow to your invasion. Of 
that, I can say sincerely from the heart of every
one of us.
Ruslan: Very well. By force, then.
Ruslan: Best of luck, young stewards of Lockhart.
Charlotte: Get back here and die like the pitiful coward you 
are!
Charlotte stood with a smoking pistol at the end of 
her outstretched arm.
Charlotte: Goddess... damn it!
Mariel: Th- They're going to attack again?
Pup: There's no way he thinks

passages.name: CH3 Inter - Wolf Appears
passages.content:
The ill-defined shadow stepped forward, where 
dulled metal met the flickering lights of the 
moonlit city.
The figure stopped. He was trailed by a sword 
dragged haphazardly across the ground.
Ivan: ...

Friend of yours?
Mariel: He's not one of the guards.
Rowan: What? Then... is he associated with the Empire?
Pup: Huh...?
Something had caught my eye.
Charlotte: Another 3rd rate assassin?
Charlotte raised her pistol.
Charlotte: Who are you?
Pup: (What is that? It's almost like... a trail?)
Steel Wolf: ...
Charlotte: Talk. Now.
Steel Wolf: ...
Steel Wolf: You've already sent away the one willing to 
negotiate.
The voice was muffled and echoed through the 
helmet. It felt far away, in both sound and spirit.
Pup: (A trail of... something... It's like footprints. That 
and more coming from where the sword 
was dragging.)
Pup: ...?!
A flicker of the candlelight reflected a color more 
clearly than before.

Crimson.
Pup: Blood?!
Several heads turned my way with the declaration.
Charlotte: What?
Steel Wolf: ...
Charlotte's eyes dotted towards what I had 
noticed.
Charlotte: What... What did you do inside?
Steel Wolf: ...
He did not respond, as his gaze was still fixed in the
direction of me and my father.
Pup: (He... Did he...?)
Charlotte: What did you do!?
Steel Wolf: ...
The helmet turned towards her, with a creak to 
pierce the silence.
Steel Wolf: You know what.
Charlotte: You... YOU-!

passages.name: CH3 Inter - After battle
passages.content:
Mariel: What... just... happened?
Charlotte: He just...
Pup: Even more blood...
Rowan: Who are you?!
Steel Wolf: ...
Ivan: This isn't good.
Ivan: Everyone. Retreat. We'll head to the exterior of 
the city.
Pup: But that guy just-
Rowan: As much as I wish otherwise, he is right.
Pup: D- Dammit!
Mariel: Y- You... You... What did you do... i- inside?
Charlotte: ...!
Charlotte still had her pistol raised. Her arm shook 
without relenting.
Ivan: RUN!
Mariel: ...
Charlotte: ...
Steel Wolf: ...
The man lifted his sword off the ground.
Steel Wolf: Run.
Mariel: Charlotte, w- we should go.
Charlotte: Don't think this is the end of this. You will pay for 
this.
Steel Wolf: ...?

I wonder... is it the years, or...?
Ivan: ...
Steel Wolf: ...or have I found you?

passages.name: CH3 Post - Lockhart Soldier (Steel Wolf)
passages.content:
Lockhart Soldier: How... wretched! I will end that stain you place on 
existence itself!
Steel Wolf: ...

passages.name: CH3 Post - Lockhart Soldier (Dead)
passages.content: Lockhart Soldier: How... How did- did...?

passages.name: CH3 Post - Opening
passages.content:
Charlotte: Dammit!
Norde: Anton.
Pup: Right!
Mariel: Thank you.
Pup: (Already?!)
Ivan: Let's keep moving!
I turned my head toward my fellows.
Pup: (Are we going to make it at this rate?)
My head about faced.
Pup: (Maybe I could distract-)
Pup: ...?!
Pup: That... That was close.
Steel Wolf: ...
Pup: You... You picked the wrong person to die to...
I grabbed my sword and landed on my feet.
Pup: Fall!
Pup: ...!
My sword clattered against the stone beneath our 
feet, and I had fallen to a knee.
Pup: I won't let you-
Steel Wolf: Weak.
His arm raised to pierce forth one final strike.
Pup: Crap...!
I clenched my eyes shut and braced myself for 
what seemed like an eternity.
And with eternity and a second came the stinging 
pain of steel unto flesh. It buried itself within my 
shoulder.
Pup: Grh!
Pup: ...

Is that... Is that it?
Through the pain, I grabbed onto the blade of the 
sword and it cut into my hand...
Pup: You...
...and pulled the shallow dearth of steel from 
my flesh!
Pup: Is that all you-
Pup: ...have...?
Pup: Father?!
Steel Wolf: Oh...?
Pup: W- What are you doing?!
Ivan: Pup... Flee...
Footsteps accompanied the desperate growls from 
my father.

Step by step, he was driving the Steel Wolf back 
with a grip on the sword itself.
Steel Wolf: Do you wish to die?
Ivan: Pup, now!
Pup: I can help!

(Where's my sword, I can-)
Pup: ...?!
My vision blurred and wavered.

Thoughts dispersed as pain struck through my 
mind.
Pup: I... can...
Ivan: Ngh!
The sword twisted ever so slightly.
Steel Wolf: So I am to be ignored, 'hapless' crow?

All these years since Crekskia, and not even a 
word?
Ivan: Crekskia? How could you know... about that?
Steel Wolf: Am I to be forgotten, as well? After being thrown 
aside?

It seems the worth of our memory is much the 
same.

Let me shepherd you to your existence as one.
Ivan: Ah- ...Argh!!!
Ivan: Pup... go...
Pup: No, I can... I...
Pup: I can... I... I...
A stinging headache wrapped itself around my head 
and what energy I had drained to

passages.name: CH3 Post - After card
passages.content:
Nameless Voice: Another story? It's not even nightfall yet.

Ah, okay, okay. What story have I not told you 
two, then?

What about... the legend of Thame and Raiga? Of 
more heroes from before the Emerald Age?

Thame was a prince of nowhere, exiled to the 
farthest reaches of civilization.

He spent his days in peace until a messenger landed 
before his gaze. A messenger that told of war.

He was called to action, but refused it. He simply 
wished for a quiet life.

War would not give it to him, though. His quaint 
village of exile burned away from the march 
of conquest.
In his anger, he reclaimed a sword of royal 
succession, and led an army through many battles 
to the doorsteps of the perpetrators.
And so they burned as well.

Thame had struck at the heart of the villains. Every 
weakness was an untold story to unravel the 
enemy.
His army continued its march to his land of origin, 
where he found his brother Raiga sitting on the 
throne.
But Raiga created a shield against Thame's strikes. 
A shield that would not crack.

With every failure, Thame's desperation grew 
and grew.

It grew until the sword thrust once more into the 
shield, only to crack itself.

So desperate to find a weakness of his brother, 
Thame had succumb to his own.

And the world knew peace, for a time.

A peace where the resilient shield glimmered in the 
sunlit sky from sea to shining sea.

From these legends came two Oathbreakers... 
Eul'raiga and Eul'thame.

One a symbol of ideals. The other a warning, like 
a double edged sword.

That even the greatest of us have cracks that can 
consume our very being.
Light filtered through the morning sky to awaken 
me.

My eyes opened, though my vision was fleeting in 
such stupor.
I forced myself out of the bed.
Pup: (What was that... dream? That memory? It's so 
hazy now.)
My arm leaned against the wall to assist my sore 
body.
And as if by instinct, I looked.
Pup: ...
Pup: ...!?
Pup: What?
I grabbed both sides of the mirror as I saw a new 
image

passages.name: CH3 Post - Enemy convo
passages.content:
Imperial Soldier: General, sir, the remaining resistance has been 
taken care of.
Ruslan: A shame. So much unnecessary bloodshed.
Ruslan: What about the Stewart Works group?
Imperial Soldier: Only the two daughters are unaccounted for.

After... well... the... t- the events of last night.
Steel Wolf: ...
Ruslan: Fled among a retinue of mercenaries, have they?
Ruslan: They won't get far with three of their number 
crippled and cursed.
He looked over to the Steel Wolf, as if expecting a 
response.
Ruslan: Hmm... "Steel Wolf"...
Ruslan: I need to mediate the transition process here in 
Lockhart.

Are you up for a hunt?
Steel Wolf: ...

Yes.
Ruslan: Then I'll leave you with some soldiers and two of 
the better mercenaries we've recruited. It should 
help you think like them.
Ruslan: You two. Get out here.
Nora: I'm ready to move out.
Jude: Yo.
Steel Wolf: ...
Nora: Wait up! Shouldn't we discuss a plan of action?
Jude: Eh, so noisy.
The three had quickly paced themselves away from 
the scene.
Imperial Soldier: Sir, are you sure you want to let... him take care of 
such an important mission?
Ruslan: Honestly, I'm not sure if that man could lose in a 
fight. He may even be excessive for this.
Ruslan: Besides, I've never seen the man speak so many 
words as what was reported.
Ruslan: Call me curious... and perhaps a little selfish.
Ruslan: With Lockhart in tow, I'd like to spend a little time 
enjoying it, after all.

To bask in the glow of the light from the end of 
the tunnel.

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Start-Story
passages.content:
Charlotte: I imagine they're treating all the towns like they're 
just some strategic objective.
Mariel: Or... worse.
Norde: Unfortunately there is little we can do bar 
continuing to move.
Rowan: We could liberate them.
Pup: Quiet.
Pup: But why couldn't we help them?
Norde: Giving ourselves up would likely not stop them from 
taking advantage of the town. Especially in the 
other towns around the area.
And it would be recklessly dangerous to try to take 
them on directly.
Pup: (I wonder...)
Mariel: The ones in the villages are likely to be on high 
alert, too.
Don't get spotted! Unless you really want to.
But the question becomes how to know where
is safe and where is not?
If you left click on an enemy, a red aura will appear. 
This means that the unit can attack any one of 
those squares. 
If you right click anywhere on the map, a yellow 
aura will appear on all enemies. This is all 
enemy's ranges combined.
The red and yellow auras can be set at the same 
time to track both "all dangerous areas" and a 
specific enemy's "dangerous area".
Use this liberally! Knowing the attacking options of
your opponent can be the difference between 
life and death!
In this map, some enemies are on high alert and 
could call for reinforcements if you are spotted by 
them!
Norde: We should keep moving. Head south to the border 
to Rabaneau.
Win Condition: Escape!

Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan or Charlotte die.

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Weakness Activate 1st
passages.content:
Pup: Crap... that feeling again...
Norde: I... am...

Try... to not faint from it again.
Norde said as much while his fist tightened to the 
point of shaking.
Pup: I... won't...

I won't faint.
Pup: (This will pass... I just... need to concentrate and 
avoid danger until it does.)
Feeling weak? That familiar feeling might become
all to common of a companion for Pup and co.

Those struck by a particular person's sword are
afflicted with a state of being. A state of being
that can bring on bouts of feeling weak.
It isn't a mechanic that will impact you on every
map, but rather specific maps during the story.

With that, each of these map's exact impact 
on Pup and others will change with unique
mechanics to fit the story.
In this map, you will receive a debuff. 
     -2 to speed 
     -2 to skill.

passages.name: CH4 Battle - All Vill safe NH TF
passages.content:
Pup: Was that all the villages around here?
Charlotte: There may be more to the south, but that's 
everything in the immediate area.
Norde: How unnecessarily reckless.
Mariel: Thank you for letting us make the effort, though.
Mariel: Thank you for letting us make the effort, though.
Charlotte: Thank you for helping these places.
Norde: There was quite literally no way for me to resist at 
a point.
Charlotte: A little less of a load to put on the shoulders of 
everyone is a good thing.
Pup: Plus it makes for some good practice for me to put 
some hair on my chest.
I chuckled away at my thought and I felt a surge 
of pride from my strength in this task.
Pup: Uh...
Then I felt something weird.

I felt itchy.
Charlotte: Did I just see something fall out of your jacket?
Pup: What the...
I pulled off my jacket and saw a rain of hair 
fall out of it.
Pup: Why? What is this?
Pup: I...?!
My eyes gazed down on a set of smooth arms. The 
hair had fallen out.
Rowan: Your body hair...?
Rowan: "Put hair on your chest", was it? This disease has 
fantastic comedic timing.
Pup: Why...?!
Norde: That is... concerning.
Norde: All the more reason to keep moving, however.
Pup: I just don't... have the words...
The event had caught me off guard, and I couldn't 
do much more than follow the group again.
"No Body Hair" TF Aquired!?

passages.name: CH4 Battle - WinCon2 w Cainan
passages.content:
Cainan: Let's not dawdle. The town isn't too far away.
Charlotte: I could definitely stand to get some rest after all 
this.
Pup: You said you were with the Covenant? Could 
you...?
Cainan: All in good time. First let's settle at a safe haven.

passages.name: CH4 Battle - WinCon2 wo Cainan
passages.content:
Pup: A town?
Charlotte: I could definitely stand to get some rest after all 
this.
Cainan: Ah, the group that passed near the village I was 
at?

It seems we have headed the same way.
Pup: Who are you?
Cainan: Cainan DeClares of the Covenant.
Cainan: If you need a place to rest, I have been to this 
town before.
Pup: That sounds...
Pup: ...nice, to be honest.
Cainan: Then follow me.

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Village discovered
passages.content:
Imperial Soldier: I found the enemy!
Pup: Damn... Well, we might as well save the villages 
now.
TUTORIAL: Villages

Approach the entrance of a village to interact with 
it. You might get some goodies!

passages.name: CH4 Battle - App Rabaneu Scout
passages.content:
Pup: Who is that? He doesn't look like one of the 
Imperial soldiers?
Norde: That may be a scout. The outerwear is reminiscent 
of Rabaneau soldiers.
Charlotte: Perfect. We can get an escort the rest of the way.
Pup: Hello! Are you from the Republic?!
Rabaneau Scout: Did I hear something...?

...?!

Mercenaries? The report must be right, Nolvanus is 
hiring mercenaries to bulk up their numbers.
Pup: If you're from the Republic, we have some guests 
you might want to meet!
Rabaneau Scout: I need to fall back and let the main force know...

You'll never get away with this treachery, you 
Imperial scum!
Charlotte: Did he just yell at us like we were part of the 
Empire?!

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Continue Midpoint
passages.content:
Geoffrey: There it is. The Imperial Army. They've really done 
it.
Nora: Now Rabaneau makes their move? I won't let you 
near Lockhart.
Geoffrey: I see the scout was right about hired mercenaries.

Let us get to know each other, then.
Pup: It... It's turned into a battlefield?!
Charlotte: They think we're an enemy?!
Rowan: With the path to Rabaneau blocked off.
Pup: What now?
Norde: There must be another escape route.
Cainan: Of course. It was my pleasure to help.
Cainan: I really must move to my next mission for the 
Covenant.
Cainan: Hm... Are those troops in the distance?
Oh hey, look. Another person not fighting in 
either of the armies? Wonder what that's about?
Some units out and about have special conditions 
to be recruited to your cause.

Those conditions could be simple, like talking to
them. Or they could be complex like... let's
not get to into right now.
Either way, keep an eye out for possibilities!
Pup: Maybe we could force our way through...?

(I don't want to go somewhere my father might 
not follow, but... what choice do we have?)
NEW OBJECTIVE: Find a new way to escape!

Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan, Charlotte or Cainan 
die.

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Place Event
passages.content:
Unknown_4294967295: There we go. Their commander is down.
Villager: Thank you! They were threatening my daughter 
and... and...
The villager dumped a pile of money in our hands.
Unknown_4294967295: You don't have to...
Villager: I insist! It was a bribe amount I was already willing 
to part with. I much rather see it go with saviors.
Unknown_4294967295: T- Thanks...?

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Place Event
passages.content:
Villager: Oh thank you! You've saved us! You are our daring 
heroes!
Unknown_4294967295: It was the least we could do. Don't worry about-
Villager: Here, take this! And this!
Bits of random stuff started to fill all the hands 
available.
Unknown_4294967295: I- I... What do I...
And it continued. And continued...
Villager: Oh thank you so much our heroes! Go along now 
with your hoard of treasure!
So we were hurried along and out of sight.
Unknown_4294967295: ...

This is just that guy's garbage...
Unknown_4294967295: *Sigh*... Maybe there's something useful in here?

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Place Event
passages.content:
Unknown_4294967295: Down that one goes.
Villager: Where they at!? I'll... I'll...

Oh, the soldier is already down.
Unknown_4294967295: No problems here.
Villager: Guess I don't need this anymore...
The villager tossed the weapon he was holding 
into our hands before nonchalantly pivoting 
back into his house.
Unknown_4294967295: Wait, is he grateful or not?

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Place Event
passages.content:
Villager: Why'd you have to kill the guy?! They're probably 
just going send another and blame us!
Unknown_4294967295: We're just trying to help and-
Villager: Get out! You've caused enough trouble!
Random objects started getting thrown in our 
direction.
Unknown_4294967295: Okay! We're leaving!

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Active → Cainan
passages.content:
Cainan: Fleeing the violence, are you? It does appear quite 
senseless here.

I've just set off on my way myself, so perhaps I can 
escort you?
Pup: Well, we're not exactly going to say "no" to the 
assistance in all this chaos.
Cainan: I know of a nice town to the west. It should be 
out of the crossfires of this battle.
Cainan: Ah, but where are my manners?
Cainan: I am Cainan DeClares, an arbiter for The Holy Oath's 
Covenant to the Mother Soul.

I am at your service.
Cainan was recruited!

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Active → Cainan
passages.content:
Cainan: Fleeing the violence, are you? It does appear quite 
senseless here.

I've just set off on my way myself, so perhaps I can 
escort you?
Unknown_4294967295: Well, we're not exactly going to say "no" to the 
assistance in all this chaos.
Cainan: I know of a nice town to the west. It should be 
out of the crossfires of this battle.
Cainan: Ah, but where are my manners?
Cainan: I am Cainan DeClares, an arbiter for The Holy Oath's 
Covenant to the Mother Soul.

I am at your service.
Cainan was recruited!

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Pup → Charlotte
passages.content:
Charlotte: I need to ask... What did you see when you 
climbed that wall?
Pup: It... It was two people standing together like 
they were about to fight...
Pup: That... "Steel Wolf" along with my father.
Charlotte: So he really was there.

passages.content:

Rowan: If I am not mistaken... you were struck by that 
Steel Wolf as well back in Lockhart.

When you were creating an opening for your leader 
to flee.

Be sure not to push yourself beyond any limits.

passages.content:
Pup: Grk...! Gotta keep... going...

Pup: And weak in the hands... and legs...
Pup: I'll be fine.

need to, yeah?

passages.name: CH4 Battle - Rowan → Cainan
passages.content:
Cainan: What brings you here, Al-
Rowan: Ah! No need to say anything unnecessary.
Rowan: I go by my birthname these days. You may call me 
Rowan.
Cainan: Hm... Then, "Rowan"... What brings you here? Are 
you with them?
Rowan: I've been wandering for a time. For now, I follow in 
the steps of an intriguing image.
Rowan: You see it too, no?
Cainan: Perhaps. There is a certain resemblance to be had 
there.
Rowan: You should have seen him a few days before. After 
Lockhart and the strike of that sword...
Cainan: Strike of a sword?

...
Cainan: I suspect the continuation of this conversation best 
be had when we arrive in a safe haven, no?
Rowan: Of course, of course.

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Otis (Pup)
passages.content:
Otis: Hahaha! You kittens ain't half bad, ya know?
Pup: How the hell are you swinging around that big 
axe?!
Otis: Decades of experience, kid. Decades of experience.
Pup: But... Y- You don't look any older
than me...
Otis: Hey, sometimes girls like us got to make ends 
meet.
Pup: Again with that nonsense...
Pup: Ack! It doesn't matter if you mistake me for a girl.

passages.content:

Otis: I can figure out anything I feel like when we're 
done.

passages.content:

kids!

Otis: Wonder what set them on this course?

passages.content: Bennett: You owe me... like 6 bushels of apples!

passages.content:
Bennett: Aw dammit... I knew that crap alcohol would be 
the death of me...
Her body started to disintegrate.

Charlotte: Sort of... sort of like a summoned ally?
Pup: Dammit, they're still coming. We can work through 
that later!

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Start
passages.content:

Otis: That Lockhart lass is wanted dead or alive!

Whichever one of you dirtbags sacks her gets the 
prime cut of meat tonight!

movement is reduced.

passages.content:

...found a local lottery ticket?

Unknown_4294967295: ...for only a little money.

passages.content:

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 3
passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!

passages.content:

together.

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Alley Ev 5
passages.content:

Bennett: YEAH?! How do you like- like... them apples!?

beer!

Bennett: You... owe me... like... zzzzz...

Bennett: ...!

Give me my apples!

passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!

passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!

There's a store at the end of the hallway.

passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
Nothing.

Unknown_4294967295: There should be something here?

They didn't find anything.

Our forces entered the alleyway and...!

Unknown_4294967295: That can't be good...
Pirate: YOOOUUUU.....?!!?!

Magnificent bastard!

passages.content:
Our forces entered the alleyway and...!
Nothing.

Expectations are a double edged sword.

Unknown_4294967295: Isn't this one is pretty rare?
