Unknown_4294967295: I feel like you're referencing something I don't

passages.content:

Bennett: And don't! That crap is the worst.
Bennett: Soothing, smooth... it's all just a trap.
Bennett: A delicious... intoxicating trap...
Pup: (Is this what they call a relapse?)
Bennett: Thanks again, though.
Bennett: I just sort of showed up here randomly. Not sure 
what's going on.
Bennett: You guys give me an excuse to get my bearings in 
relative safety, and I'll gladly help you out 
with... whatever is happening here.

passages.content:
Norde: Careful. They'd be after both of you, after all.
Mariel: R- Right.
Mariel: Well... maybe. Charlotte is the proper heir, after all.

Norde: ...

Mariel: Oh...

passages.content:
Tatiana: Man, this place is a dump.
Satia: Oh? But the noble presence is basically non-
existent.
Tatiana: Eh, at least they make it fun. This is just anarchy.
Satia: Hmm... An interesting thought.
Satia: Maybe you just need to find the fun in anarchy?
Tatiana: Never took you for an anarchist.
Satia: Oh, I wouldn't say I am.
Satia: Only that I don't think it is worse than a noble

Satia: Plus, a wild ride can be fun here and there.
Tatiana: Heh. I guess I'll have to try it some time.

passages.name: CH 5 Battle - Active → Bennett
passages.content:
Pup: Calm yourself!
Unknown_4294967295: Calm yourself!
Bennett: WHERE ARE THE FUCKING APPLES?!

Unknown_4294967295: We'll... We will buy you some apples!

Bennett: Thank you~

I really need to sober up.

Unknown_4294967295: Would you prefer to retreat to safety?

She barfed again, and the two deposits shimmered

Bennet has joined the team!

passages.name: CH 4 Post battle - Scene 6
passages.content:
Cainan: So Lockhart has fallen into Imperial hands?
Cainan: I imagine the High Seat in Oadthine must be 
panicking as we speak.
Pup: Who exactly were you again?
Cainan: As before, I am Cainan DeClares. I am an arbiter for 
The Holy Oath's Covenant to the Mother Soul.
Pup: "Arbiter"?
Cainan: It would take some time to discuss in detail, but...
Cainan: You may think of me as a hand of the Covenant. I 
travel the lands to ensure that our operations in 
towns, Vaults, and the like go well.
Cainan: While I am not one to handle political affairs, this 
has certainly had it's tendrils go beyond that benign 
of a topic.
Charlotte: I've met a few Covenant arbiters in the past. 
They're like a fancy auditor.
Cainan: That we are.
Pup: So you're an expert on all things the Goddess and 
such?
Pup: How about stuff like... the Oathbreakers?
I eyed over to Rowan, who was sitting somewhat 
to the side of the main group.
Rowan: ...?
Rowan: ...
...who only took the opportunity to smile 
in response.
Cainan: I certainly have a significant knowledge base to pull 
from, yes.

I assume you ask because of that sword from your 
story in Lockhart?
Pup: Uh... no. Wait, what about a sword?
Cainan: You were struck by sword with a diamond shaped 
hilt, yes? Then have felt bouts of weakness 
through your body since?
It matches a phenomena I know of.
Pup: Wait, wait... This is some sickness I picked up. My 
father and Norde didn't have the same symptoms 
as me.
Norde: I... should note that I have felt dizzy and 
lightheaded at times myself.
Cainan: "Eul'thame, the weakness cursing sword". 

Have you heard of it?
Pup: Eul'thame...?
???: Thame had struck at the heart of the villains. Every 
weakness was an untold story to unravel the 
enemy.
So desperate to find a weakness of his brother, 
Thame had succumb to his own.

From these legends came two Oathbreakers... 
Eul'raiga and Eul'thame.

One a symbol of ideals. The other a warning, like a 
double edged sword.

That even the greatest of us have cra

passages.name: CH 4 Post battle - Scene 7
passages.content:
Ivan: ...
Steel Wolf: ...
Ivan: ...
Steel Wolf: Hm...?

You've lost your gray, old man.
Steel Wolf: Is this the core of your demise?

Your wanting... spinning in futility.
Imperial Soldier: Sir! We've had a report that the targets have 
cleared the battlefield.
Steel Wolf: I do not care.
Imperial Soldier: But sir, we-
The soldier fell into ground, blood pooling 
around his body.
Steel Wolf: I. Do. Not. Care.
Ivan: ...?!
Seeing an opportunity, Ivan rushed towards his 
target with his lance angled for a killing blow.
And it...!
Ivan: ...!

...
Ivan: I...
The lance stopped mid flight. The tip of steel 
served only to tap the armor of the Steel Wolf 
with the lightest touch.
Ivan: I... can't...

I've already killed you once.
Steel Wolf: Hmph.
A metal clad hand raised to grab the shaft of the 
weapon.
Steel Wolf: Even as you become a phantom of those days, you 
waver on these regrets.

Your gray took your wounds with it, but not your 
weakness.
Ivan let go of the lance, leaving only one hand 
to remain with a grip on it.
The lance broke in two as the Steel Wolf's grip 
shattered the shaft of it.
Ivan: I... I can't...
Ivan faltered backwards before falling to his knees.
Ivan: I can't... be the one to kill you... not again...
Steel Wolf: Weak.
The Steel Wolf turned on his heels to face 
the defeated Ivan.
Steel Wolf: Of your folly, that is among the least.
Ivan: I failed you. I failed all of you.

I only ever wanted...

...for you all to be happy.
Tears streamed down Ivan's face as he watched 
the Steel Wolf raise his sword.
Steel Wolf: No phantoms of your past will save you this time.
Ivan's eyes closed.
Steel Wolf: For those sins you've conducted.

And the sins you've created.

Let you be excised.

And a better world composed from your ashes.

...

Goodbye.

passages.name: CH 4 Post battle - Scene 7.1
passages.content:
Pup: ...
I laid on the bed, and drifted to sleep with my 
hand tightly grasping the locket.
Even as my mind lost its grip on the world around,
my own grip only tightened more.
My blurry vision focused on a sight that seemed 
dream like.
Pup: What is...?
Around me stood a sea of darkness.

Stars glimmered and faded.

Islands among the abyss were barren and 
incomplete.
Pup: Am I dreaming?
Pup: Hm...?
A the sound of whooshing air turned my attention 
to my backside.
Aegis: ...
A silhouette had appeared from nowhere. 

It was as if it wasn't even fully formed without 
hands or feet to speak of.
Pup: Who are you, now?
Aegis: ...
It's mouth opened, but it didn't seem capable of 
finding the words.
Pup: Can you not speak?
Aegis: ...
It gritted its teeth out of frustration.
Pup: Do you want something from me?
Pup: I- I don't know... Maybe you could mime an 
answer?
Aegis: I...
Pup: Oh?
Aegis: I wish to...

I wish to protect you.
Pup: ...
I didn't know what to make of it, so I rubbed my 
eyes.
Pup: ...?
The silhouette had disappeared as quickly as it 
appeared.

Bewildered, I rubbed my eyes again.
But this time... 

...I woke up.

passages.content:

*Tick*

*Tick*
Pup: ...
My heart beated to the tick of the clock.
Ivan: ...
Quiet breaths formed the chorus to stand beside it. 
It was a calm and peaceful chorus.
Pup: ...
For my part, I stared at the ceiling with my

*Tick*

At least since that first change after Norde

She quickly jotted down the numbers on a sheet 
of paper.

Mariel: Along with healing magic, I learned the 
fundamentals of medicine when I was at the 
academy.
Pup: "Academy"
Mariel: Theodal Royal College. I attended there as a 
student.

I've actually been considering going back for a 
couple years of advanced courses in the field.
Mariel took the tape measure and wrapped it 
around my waist.
Mariel: That's about the same, too...
Pup: So that's... like a school, or something?
Mariel: Yeah... do you not...?
Pup: I've not been to a school since Sunday school.
Pup: Even back then it was just when I could. We were 
always on the move.
Mariel: I...
Pup: I'm not stupid or anything. I was given plenty of 
lessons by Norde, Satia, and... my father.
Both of our eyes drifted to the side.
Pup: How's... he doing?
Mariel: Much better, I think. Miraculous given what all
happ

I popped up back to my feet.

Mariel: And an active mind and body means a healthy mind

We turned into the main lobby of the inn and some

Pup: Hwhhh! Stwww ki!
(Hey! Stop it!)
Mariel: Whatever was going through his system seems to

Mariel: We we're actually going to buy some

Satia: You know... With you being a little smaller and with

I pushed away from Satia and freed myself.
Pup: N- No time for all that. We need to not spend too

Satia: But-

Princess, let's go.
Satia: ...
Satia: *Giggle*

Pup: ...
Pup: (That does sound like a pain)

I got back up to my feet.

We we're actually going to buy some

I've never shopped here before, but it's not that

Mariel: Me neither, but I heard from-
Pup: I- Please don't over complicate this.

It's just some better fitting clothes.

We need to not spend too much time, money, or

passages.content:
I turned the corner towards the door to make my 
way out of the Inn.
Pup: I said I didn't need anymore help.
Charlotte: You said for the "princess" to follow you. You didn't 
say which.
Charlotte: Plus, it sounds fun.
I was about to say something when a figure 
carrying several bags turned the corner in front 
of us.

Should I assume your health is improved, Anton?

Norde: Supplies. You can acquire the 2nd batch while

The others should be able to supplement your loss

Norde just walked by me without an additional

Pup: Plus, what help are you two? I need to try on stuff

Nora: It's a shame the tunnel collapsed. Perhaps it was
because of the minefield...?
Charlotte: Are you even listening?
### if mariel alive
Mariel: I don't think she is...
### if not
Pup: She isn't.
STAGE DIRECTION> ##############
Nora: ...

I can hear your blathering. But it doesn't matter.

After all the pain Lockhart was put through... to
weaponize us.
Charlotte: I already said-
Nora: I've seen it with my own eyes.

These tunnels. Your parents' involvement.
Charlotte: ...what?
#### if mariel alive
Mariel: Our parents wouldn't...
STAGE DIRECTION> ########
Nora: As though I'd believe your crocodile tears of today.
Nora: It's only a shame we couldn't repurpose this atrocity
into a tool to save the city.
Charlotte: How dare you-
Pup: Stop. She really isn't listening.
Nora: ...
Charlotte: But... I want to... help Lockhart.
#### If mariel alive
Mariel: Yeah, me too.

She's a part of Lockhart.
###  if not
Pup: Including her?
STAGE DIRECTION> ###########
Pup: ...
I settled into a fighting stance.
Nora: ...
As did Nora and her allies.
#### If mariel is alive
Pup: I'll do what I can so neither of you need to "hurt
Lockhart", at least.
#### If not
Pup: I'll do what I can so you don't need to "hurt
Lockhart", at least.
STAGE DIRECTION> ###################
STAGE DIRECTION> #################

passages.name: Ch 5 Post Battle - Scene 3
passages.content:
Otis: Hahaha!

Full recognition to ya gents and ladies.
Otis: Argh... I do miss back when I was more sturdy.
Pirate: B- Boss?! You holding up?!
Pup: "Boss"?

Weren't you just some serving girl at a tavern?
Otis: Eh? Not the brightest one, are ya?
Pup: S- Says the girl insulting the one still holding a 
weapon.
Otis: Hah. Touché, lassie.
Pup: (More of this?)
Otis: Name's Otis Grayson. Unifier of the pirates of 
Ranakstown.
Charlotte: Unifier? No. No way.
Charlotte: Wait..."Grayson"...?
Otis: Believe what you want.

But it was a fine bout. Mayhap you be happy with 
that stiff drink proper this time?
Rowan: A merry ol' time does sound appealing.
Norde: She just tried to kill us.
Rowan: Hmm... I suppose...
Otis: It's no worry. I figure after that I ought to give you 
a head start 'til morning.
Otis: A good drink goes a long way.
Rowan: Then...?
Norde: ...
Rowan: Mayhap it still be... inadvisable?
Cainan: It could be a ploy to let our guards down, after all.
Cainan, Norde, and others were still at the ready.
Otis: Do what ya please. Can't say I didn't offer.
Otis slumped back, still hurt, into leaning on the 
large axe.
Pup: She said she "unified" the local pirates?

So... if we take this nekolyn out now, then we'd 
be free to negotiate with any pirate ship in the 
bay?
Otis: Ah. That'd probably work, lassie.
Otis: Alternatively, just get one of them drunk enough 
to say yes, hahaha!
Pup: ...
Pup: Stop calling me that.
Otis: Call you...? Did I call you something?
Pup: "Lassie". I'm no girl.
Otis: Ya don't say...?
Otis: I feel ya. Can hit ya in the gut, but have ya 
considered the option of... ya know?
Otis made a chopping motion around the hair to 
signal "cut it".
Otis: I've... uh... got a blade if ya need one.
Otis smiled and leaned more into the axe as a 
crutch.
Satia: I'd appreciate us not breaking our last pair of 
scissors on that like before.
Norde: Ah. Yes. The ever inflating scissors budget after it 
just broke last time.
Otis: Heh? Now you've got me confused.

passages.name: Ch 5 Post Battle - Scene 4
passages.content:
Otis dragged us to a nearby tavern.

I found myself sitting there, water in hand, as Otis 
gulped down another shot.
Otis: Ah~! That really hits the spot.

I'll gladly ferry ya lot across the bloody sea. You can 
have my axe at your side, too.

Would love a chance at revenge. Figured that 
sword had disappeared entirely!
Cainan: It truly is a small world.
Charlotte: I thought the name Grayson sounded familiar.

The Grayson Maritime Shipping company? Based out 
of Lockhart?
Otis: Formerly the boss of that sorry bunch, yep.

Feels like a lifetime ago.
Charlotte: Not that they're even a large company. I've only 
ever heard of them in passing.
Otis: Heh. So they fell out of the success I created? 
Suppose the punishment suits the crime.
Otis: It was... oh, about a decade ago when that 
blasted sword changed me.
Pup: ...
I just stared at the glass of water in my hand and 
didn't move a muscle.
Otis: Not a soul of friend or family believed I was even 
me. Forced me out onto the streets.
Charlotte: A nekolyn as a player in a notable Lockhart 
company would be... a sight to behold.
Otis: Ha! That it would. You can give credit to that 
blasted curse for the ears on my head.
Otis: Used to have a beard longer than my ship hand 
down below, even.
Cainan: That would mean you were not originally a nekolyn 
or a woman, yes?

The curse of Eul'thame is to be consumed by your 
greatest weakness.
Otis: So the blade has a name and a little fairy tale to go 
with it?
Otis: It all tracks, I guess. A decade ago I was... a bit of 
an asshole about nekos and the fairer folk.
Otis: A brilliant asshole, but a bloody asshole nonetheless.
Rowan: Such sounds... unpleasant.
Pup: ...
Ripples began forming in my glass's water from my 
shaking hand.
Otis: Then, lass-
Otis: *Clears throat*
Otis: Then... laddie. How far along are ya?
Otis had slumped down in a stupor and turned my 
way.
Pup: I don't know... far enough.
Satia: He shrank some. Plus the hair growth.
Pup: I said... far enough.
Otis: Hmm..

passages.name: Ch 5 Post Battle - Scene 5
passages.content:
Soldier: And introducing the guests to Lockhart!

I present, of the Nolvanus Empire, Emperor Alexei 
IV and Empress Inessa.
Ruslan: My lord and lady. Welcome to Lockhart.
Alexei IV: ...
Inessa: Hm?
Inessa: Ah. What is that smell? Are you trying to kill us?
Simon: My dearest apologies.

We've yet to find the time to fumigate the 
residence from the previous rodents that had lived
here.
Inessa: Rodents? How vile.
Alexei IV: Who is this man?
Ruslan: Let me introduce Simon Evanston, proprietor of the 
Evanston Trading Company.

He is the man assigned to managing the city after 
the liberation.
Simon: Of which I must offer my highest levels of gratitude 
for!
Simon: The mismanagement of the Stewarts before I... 
Well, it had left us with an air of disrepair.
Simon: We welcome the Empire with open arms!
Inessa: So he was the rotting thing I smelled.
Simon: I'm... sure you'll find my skills quite invaluable.
Alexei IV: Then... the Stewarts... They are no more?
Ruslan: Unfortunately, a couple of them initially escaped our 
raid.
Jude: The Republic showed up before we could take the 
daughters into custody when searching for them.

Scouts were still trying to confirm their heading 
when I left to report the situation.
Alexei IV: Then that means...
Alexei IV turned towards a figure standing in the 
corner of the throne room.
Alexei IV: It means you failed.
Steel Wolf: ...
Alexei IV: What little difference a fancy title from the 
Crusades makes.
Steel Wolf: Did you expect any different?
Alexei IV: ...
Simon: Ah! If I may interject?
The emperor swiveled his head to the man, but 
the Steel Wolf stayed locked onto the emperor.
Simon: This may be a blessing in disguise.

You see. Rodents as they were, the Stewarts 
always had sway and support enough to keep them 
in power.
A transition without that is inevitable to be... 
messy.

With the princess still alive, we have an opportunity 
to leverage it.
Alexei IV: And how do you propose such a measure be done?
Simon: Marriage, of cour

passages.name: Ch 5 Post Battle - Scene 6
passages.content:
A familiar visage came before my sight.
Pup: This dream again...?
I turned around to catch the sight of what I
expected to see.
???: ...
Pup: And you again, too?
Pup: Who are you?
Pup: I mean... What are you?
???: I... do not know.
Pup: How could you not know who or what you are? 
Amnesia?
???: Such does not feel right.
???: I simply know... I wish to protect you.

No more. No less.

Other thoughts are fleeting instincts.

I simply wish to protect.
Pup: Fat load of good you're doing there.

*Sigh*...
Pup: ...

It... does sort of remind me of a story I once 
heard, though.
???: A story...?
Pup: A bedtime story about an old warrior called "Aegis". 
A mythical protector of the downtrodden.

He had a selfless instinct like no other.

He was a wall that none could ever climb.
A shining shield atop the hill.
???: How... familiar.
???: Such a thought feels... nostalgic... and right.
???: If you wish to call me a name, "Aegis" will do for 
now.
Pup: Well, that's a lofty expectation you're taking on 
with that name.
Aegis: I will...
Aegis: No, I must live up to it.
Pup: What a weird... whatever you are.
Pup: (I wonder... if this is a dream... is he my imagination 
or...?)

If you don't know what you are... could you be 
connected to this curse I have?
Pup: Might... this be your fault?
I briefly motioned to the new weight on my chest.
Aegis: A curse...?
Aegis: For all the words and sentiments of yours that have 
rung a nostalgic tune...

That one does not.
Pup: *Sigh*... Maybe I'll be able to remember this dream 
a bit better when I wake up this time, at least.
Pup: Not that you've helped me understand it any 
better.

Hmm...
I looked at his ethereal body. Bits and pieces of it 
were transparent or non-existent.
Pup: (It's like he's not entirely there?)
Pup: In many ways... you're sort of like a child. A 
newborn, even.
I had blinked.
Pup: ...?
I blinked again.

But this time, the stirring of awakening took me.

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Simon (Rowan)
passages.content:
Rowan: Welcome, welcome~

I see you are the delightful 'would be' fiancé of my 
dear friend?
Simon: What an annoying sound. Has the princess fallen so 
low as to spend time associating with such 
paupers?
Rowan: But wait until you see my wedding gift before you 
demean my station!

It shall be a exquisite meal of 'Flambé of Simon'.

The chef's recommendation? Well done. Allow me 
to add some char to our cooking time~

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Simon (Mariel)
passages.content:
Simon: Oh, the lovely Princess Mariel?

I am happy to see you've survived this long.
Mariel: No.
Simon: I did not even...
Simon: Princess Mariel. Many said you were a better 
candidate as an heir.
Simon: Perhaps...
Mariel: No.
Simon: You are a smart young woman. Don't
simply just-
Mariel: No.
Simon: Hmph... Very well. You were disposable anyways.

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Simon (Charlotte)
passages.content:
Simon: Heheh... What shall I make you do first?
Charlotte: Oh, I can think of a few idea.

Most having to do with you begging me for mercy.
Simon: Ah, that arrogance. I only wish I could've seen it 
get cracked when your intolerable parents died.
Charlotte: ...

Even when they're dead... you still can't rise above 
them, can you?
Simon: Heheh...

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Simon (Active)
passages.content:
Simon: So you're the little gnats that stopped the Lockhart 
plan from working to perfection.
Simon: Heheh... I'll have fun getting some revenge.

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Simon (Dead)
passages.content:
Simon: Urgh... That hurt, you damned gnats!
Simon: I cannot see this to it's end, can I?

Fine, I will fall back. Finish this you sorry lot!

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Jude (Pup)
passages.content:
Pup: (This guy... we've seen him before... He was in 
Lockhart, wasn't he?)
Jude: ...
Pup: (And he's quick and dangerous, too... Though a bit 
much on the pretty boy spectrum to be 
too dangerous though.)
Pup: (Maybe if I was able to get a larger burst to strike 
quicker? Like if my legs were a notch stronger...)
Pup: (Actually, I wonder... This 'curse'... could I use it to 
my advantage? To get my sea legs under me?)
I prepared my sword as the enemy swordsman and 
I locked eyes.
Pup: (Now, watch his movements... I'll fight 
methodically. Maybe... Maybe to an extreme 
extent. To force this curse to work for me.)
(If it's my "weaknesses", maybe I need to really 
convince myself in a moment that it is a 
weakness?)

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Jude (Active)
passages.content:
Jude: So you all are still up and running smoothly, are 
you?

...
Jude: Can anyone else do their job for once?

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Jude (Dead)
passages.content:
Jude: Nrgh... This is... not going well.
Jude: This is a lost battle, isn't it?
Jude: Ah, whatever, strategic retreat then? Not like that 
guy is the one paying me.

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Story Intro
passages.content:
Charlotte: What are these people doing here at this hour?
Otis: Merchants attacking pirates?

Not the sight ya want to see with a hangover.
Simon: What? Why isn't their ship set aflame?
Summoner: Well, we could only rush so many people to get 
here for the daybreak attack...
Simon: ...
Simon: Then finish the job.
Simon: Or would you like to see what I do to failures? 
Being paid would be the least of your worries.
Charlotte: Ugh... Oh no. Him.
Pup: You know him?
Norde: He appears to be leading this attack.
Charlotte: Simon Evanston. Rodent extraordinaire.

He's been worming his way into getting influence in 
Lockhart for decades.
Simon: Ah, my dearest Charlotte! There you are.
Simon: I have come to save you, my dear.
Charlotte: Huh? Did you actually break your brain?
Simon: Do be careful how you speak. Your words are to 
the one who runs your beloved Lockhart after all.
Charlotte: You've finally lost it.
Simon: Would you like to test that theory?
Charlotte: The empire can't be that stupid...
Simon: I come, my dearest, to offer you a hand of 
salvation.

For both yourself and the city of Lockhart itself...

Take my hand in marriage, and I will guide us to the 
peak of the world!
Charlotte: This shit again.

I'm already too tired of declining politely to relish 
this chance to kick you in the throat for it.
Simon: Oh, do not answer yet.
Simon: Do try to hold it in until your entourage is on the 
verge of the abyss.

Think of their screams of agony as vows to our 
eternal bliss.
Charlotte: ...
Simon: I do like that face. I will look forward to years of 
painting it on you, my dear.
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte: Hmph.

You know, you only ever tried to marry me before 
out of desperation. You had no other option that
was even remotely viable.
How bad must things be going to make you feel 
like you still need me for your goals?
Simon: We... We will see what tune you sing when your 
allies speak their final words.
Charlotte: And I'll thank you for the extra motivation. To keep

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Boat 1
passages.content:
Pup: Another boat!?
Pup: Everyone, be ready!

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Boat 4
passages.content:
Norde: Crows! Crew! Be wary of both sides! We have 
another ship arriving!
Jude: Hmm... Wasn't this ship supposed to be on fire by 
the time I got here...?
Jude: Let's get this over with.

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Jude Leaves
passages.content:
Jude: Hmm...
Jude: This is a lost battle, isn't it?
Jude: Ah, whatever, strategic retreat then? Not like that 
guy is the one paying me.

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Silky Hair TF
passages.content:
Pup: Yeah, run away, pretty boy!
Pup: (I'm happy my efforts there paid off. Slow, 
methodical, and...)
I made an effort to test if I did manage to get any 
extra burst to my sea legs.
Pup: *Sigh*... Oh well. That'd have been too easy.
I went back to rub my neck as I made the 
comment only to get a brush of my hair along my 
hand and neck.
Pup: Huh... That felt... different...?
Pup has manifested "Silky Hair TF"!
Pup: Fuck... did that backfire?!

(Why did that happen? Because I was
fighting that pretty boy while trying to...?)
Pup: Fuck...!

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Otis → Norde
passages.content:
Otis: Argh! No! Stop dem biters!
Norde: ...?!
Norde saw multiple enemies converging on a set of 
boxes and barrels that Otis was around.
Norde: I can assist!
Norde: There we go. Are the supplies okay? The last thing 
we need is-
Otis: Ah~ My beloved rum. You're safe~
Norde: ...
Norde: It is... okay. The supplies are... safe.

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Tatiana → Jakson
passages.content:
Tatiana: C- Careful!
Tatiana held back her attack as she noticed Jakson 
burst forth from her blind spot.
Tatiana: I'm gonna hurt you, stupid dog.
Jakson: *Confident bark*!
Tatiana: Fine! Then don't cry when you get stomped!
The two continued their fights, and Jakson deftly 
leapt through the gaps that Tatiana's slow armor 
created.
Tatiana: ...?! From behind?!
Jakson: *Bark*!
Jakson: *Victory bark*!
Tatiana: ...Not bad.

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Rowan → Charlotte
passages.content:
Rowan: Shades... and these are more well formed than 
you'd expect.

Does Lockhart employ such skilled summoners?
Rowan: Charlotte, did Lockhart-
Charlotte: Headshot~
Charlotte: What was that?
Rowan: Ah, never mind me. Mayhap when you are... 
enjoying yourself less later.
Charlotte: What's that supposed to mean?
Charlotte: Whatever. I'll just make a mental note to punish 
you later.
Rowan: How fun...?

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - Satia → Mariel
passages.content:
Satia: ...!
Mariel: A- Are you okay?!
Satia: I... No, that's what I should be asking. Are you 
okay?
Mariel: B- But that attack... Are you okay?
Satia: I stepped in to protect my ally... Are you okay?
Mariel: I can't just ignore you if you're hurt. Are you okay?
Satia: I chose to protect you... so are you okay?
Mariel: Are you okay?
Satia: Are you okay?
BOTH: Are you okay?!

passages.name: CH 6 Battle - End
passages.content:
Simon: Why have you not killed them yet?!
Summoner: Argh!
The last of the enemy commanders fell to the 
ground.
Simon: What do I pay you simpletons for?!
Simon: What now...? Maybe if I sent the ships' crews at 
them...?

No... We have to retreat entirely, don't we? Argh!

Next time, then... Next time!

passages.name: CH6 Post Battle - Story
passages.content:
Swords clashed between crow and shade.
Shade: ...!
Pup: And...!
The shade, a summoned being, dissipated into ash.
Pup: (Even for something made with creation magic, 
they put up more than a little bit of a fight!)
Turning my head to my next foe, I see...
Pup: (Nothing? Are we done?)
My head went on a swivel to look around, only to 
see the ships that had attacked us sailing away.
Pup: Ah! They're getting away!
Charlotte: After those bastards!
Otis: Eh, not in the job description, lass.
Otis: If he don't want no prolongated fight, I'm not one 
to lose my ship over it.
Pirate: We... probably shouldn't. If they're not going to 
pick a ship-on-ship battle, especially.

We only have the one ship to their two, after all.
Charlotte: Grh!
Pup: Who was that guy, again? He had some imperial 
troops with him.

Not to mention all that marriage talk...
Charlotte: That man is Simon Evanston of the similarly named 
trading company.

His family's company is like... I don't know, the 6th 
or 7th most influential in the city.
Norde: Or was. If he's working with the Nolvanus Empire,
then his status has likely risen.
Charlotte: He's always been trying to merge our companies via 
a marriage.
Charlotte: Ugh... I remember that shit from when I was a little 
kid.
Mariel: Sis, if he's working with the Empire, you don't think 
he was involved in... that, do you?
Charlotte: He's just the sort of desperate that could've helped 
set that invasion up...
Mariel: But if he's in charge of Lockhart now, then... He 
still wants to marry you. He's even more dangerous 
now.
Pup: So he got Lockhart but still wants to marry you? He 
sounds dangerous.
Charlotte: It should be... fine.

He's in control, but if he still needs me then it 
means they haven't fully converted public opinion 
on my family.
All that crap about us being an enemy of city will 
only get eaten up by some of the factions in 
that place.
Charlotte: At least it's good to hear things haven't gotten 
completely out of hand there.
Rowan: He

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Reagyn (Pup)
passages.content:
Pup: Now we’re in my battlefield.
Reagyn: You think we’ve not trained diligently?

A noble must be able to protect their people at any 
minute.

We must lead the people of our domains to a 
better life. A safer life. A happier life.
Reagyn: You truly understand nothing.
Pup: Tsk. You act like you’re some hero just for being 
born.
Pup: Well, let’s see how well you handle this.

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Reagyn (Rowan)
passages.content:
Reagyn: You are... Prince Alexei Volkov?
Rowan: Also known as... Entirely different names. At times.
Reagyn: ...
Rowan: If you find yourself suspicious of the assertion, do 
not force yourself.
Rowan: Treat Rowan as Rowan, and happiness shall follow.
Reagyn: This reminds me of a salesman’s scam.
Rowan: A scam you say? Such a wound to bear...

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Reagyn (Dead)
passages.content:
Reagyn: Argh! I... You really managed to beat me.

Fine. I won’t deny it.

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Flynn (Dead)
passages.content:
Flynn: Ugh... I... Of course I...
Flynn: Good job. Much respect to you.

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Flynn (Pup)
passages.content:
Pup: Uh... h- hello.
Pup: We haven’t talked much properly, have we?
Flynn: Sorry about that. My twin sister can come across... 
a bit strongly.
Pup: You think?
Flynn: Though... I can’t say I disagree with her.
Pup: Then I’ll just have to prove myself to you, too.
Flynn: I guess so.

I hope you do.

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Flynn (Rowan)
passages.content:
Rowan: Good day to you.
Flynn: Oh, uh... H- Hello.

Y- You’re the imperial prince,right?
Flynn: Are you... Are you sure?
Rowan: So they say. So they say.
Flynn: And... what do you say?
Rowan: I also say.
Rowan: Do not fret. Have fun with our sporting event 
here.
Flynn: R- Right...

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Post setup talk
passages.content:
Pup: Uh... What are you doing here? Where is 
everyone?
Rowan: Ah, that is but a part of the game.
Rowan: We are split according to random lots.
Pup: Lucky me.
Rowan: Indeed. It must be the guiding hand of the 
Goddess~
Pup: Can that also be said about..
Reagyn: ...
Flynn: ...
Pup: ...those two?
Rowan: Mayhap it can.
Pup: What other weird rules have we got this time?
Rowan: Uh... Do not kill?
Pup: That it?
Pup: Yeah, I can work with that.
You have 10 rounds to defeat as many enemies as 
possible. 

Each arena will have a winner and a loser. 

The winner is the one that wins 2 out of 3 battles.

If you can't reach other combatants, wait the 
remaining turns.

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Give immortality
passages.content: Your units will not permanently die in this battle.

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Charlotte show
passages.content:
Crowd: So Lady Stewart is here... why? It’s got to be 
about Lockhart.

Does she think she can just show up and make 
everyone do what she wants?
Charlotte: You bet your ass I will.

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Kara show
passages.content:
Crowd: Ah, Lady Lyons is fighting with Lady Stewart’s 
group? I don’t think I’ve ever seen her fight 
before.
You know, she’s actually... I didn’t think she’d be 
so capable there.
Kara: It is good to hear I’ve developed a quality 
reputation.

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Norde show
passages.content:
Crowd: Ugh... to think the Lockhart princess would employ 
such a creature.
Norde: Hmph. The usual.
Norde: Then I’ll show you truth through my actions.

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Jakson show
passages.content:
Crowd: Why is a dog on the field...? Wait, did that dog 
just...?! My Goddess!
Jakson: *Happy Bark*!

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Mariel show
passages.content:
Crowd: Oh, that’s Lady Charlotte’s sister. The rumors used 
to say that she might make a better...
Mariel: Just... Just ignore them.

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Otis show
passages.content:
Crowd: A little nekolyn woman with a... Woah, how did she 
swing it like that?!
Otis: Bwahaha! Let’s make this fun!

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Tatiana show
passages.content:
Crowd: T- That armor... That isn’t... No, it couldn’t be.
Tatiana: Yeah, gawk in awe at my awesomeness, you 
creeps.

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Start
passages.content:
Pup: W- Wait?! We’re actually fighting?!
Pup: We’re finally doing the thing?!
Head Noble: Thank you, friends and family, for joining us today.

Today we commemorate the hard work of our 
recent graduating fellows.

To rise from the Royal College to join us in nobility 
proper.

Ah, look at me ramble on. I can see the excited 
faces of everyone here.
Reagyn: ...
Flynn: ...
Head Noble: Without further delay, the results of the Knight’s 
Roundtable set the lots for today’s fight to be...

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Win all battles
passages.content:
Head Noble: It looks like we have a winning group! Lady Stewart 
and the Nightless Crows!
Flynn: Thank you for the excellent match. You really 
overwhelmed our side.
Reagyn: To think a mercenary group would be so...
Pup: “So...”? So what?
Reagyn: I applaud your efforts. I underestimated you all. All 
of you.
Reagyn: Not that there isn’t room for improvement.
Flynn: Sis, even I can see we don’t have room to say 
that.

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Win, beat reagyn
passages.content:
Head Noble: It looks like we have a winning group! Lady Stewart 
and the Nightless Crows!
Flynn: An excellent match.
Reagyn: Indeed. I may have underestimated you.
Pup: Wait, you really...?
Reagyn: You still have a lot to learn, but...
Pup: Heh...
Flynn: Uh...

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Win,  Flynn alive
passages.content:
Head Noble: It looks like we have a winning group! Lady Stewart 
and the Nightless Crows!
Flynn: Thank you for the excellent match. Your side did 
quite well.
Reagyn: Indeed. I share the sentiment.
Pup: Being like that...
Reagyn: I withdraw my complaint. Perhaps your group has 
enough strength in its numbers to serve Lady 
Stewart.
In... some of its numbers.
Flynn: Sis...
Pup: ...

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Lose, beat reagyn
passages.content:
Head Noble: It looks like we have a winning group! The Kingdom 
nobles! What a wonderful match!
Reagyn: You...
Pup: A loss is a loss...
Flynn: But you did beat us...
Reagyn: ...

I apologize for my shameful display. It seems I 
underestimated you.
Pup: I... I didn’t expect that.

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Lose,  reagyn alive
passages.content:
Head Noble: It looks like we have a winning group! The Kingdom 
nobles! What a wonderful match!
Reagyn: ...
Pup: Urgh... Goddess dammit...
Flynn: Uh... thank you for the match.
Reagyn: Thank you for the match.
She turned towards her brother.
Reagyn: Lord Flynn, would you like me to schedule a 
meeting with Lady Charlotte after the match?
Flynn: Uh.. well... I don’t think...

passages.name: CH7 Battle - Continue
passages.content:
Bandit: ...
Pup: (Who is that? They look out of place with the 
nobles. Are they...?)
Bandit: ...!
Pup: What!?
Noble: Ah!!!
The axe swung down, narrowing missing the noble 
as they scampered away from the scene.
Bandit: Tsk...
The crowd started dispersing, and more bandits 
started to become visible in the stands.
Kara: Bandits? They got past the facility's security?
Head Noble: What is this nonsense?! Where are the guards?!
Noble: S- Sir... I think the guards are... dead!
Head Noble: P- Preposterous!
Kara: Sir, I do believe you would be best served escorting 
your guests away from the danger.
Charlotte: Yeah. We got this. Keep everyone else safe.
Head Noble: Y- Yes. Of course...

My friends and family...!
The leader of the noble group’s voice became 
muffled as he ran off to do as much.
Flynn: Reagyn, should we...?
Reagyn: ...I think...
Reagyn: Sir... Lord Flynn Coslett... This is an emergency. I 
am at your command.
Flynn: W- Wait, but...
Reagyn looked at her brother with a determined, 
dutiful expression.
Flynn: R- Right... we can... uh... follow his lead for now?
Reagyn: I think we should help him.
Reagyn: But... Lord Flynn Coslett... This is an emergency. I 
am at your command.
Flynn: W- Wait, but...
Reagyn looked at her brother with a determined, 
dutiful expression.
Flynn: R- Right... you’re right. We should follow his lead.
The two Coslett twins scattered off in a similar 
direction.

This left our group and a select few of the noble’s 
group to deal with the ever growing bandit threat.
Pup: A bandit raid? I thought this was an “uninvadable” 
country?
Kara: A heavy rarity, but not unheard of.

To attack a facility like this, though...
Norde: I imagine the nobles would be grateful to have this 
taken care of.
Rowan: What a wonderful opportunity to sweep them off 
their feet.
Charlotte: For once I agree with you.
Charlotte: Let’s clean this up, then, shall we?

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - Start
passages.content:
Pup: (A bandit raid? It’s been a while since we’ve had to 
deal with that.)

(Not since...)

...
A thought creeped upon my mind, but I shook my 
head and dismissed it.
Pup: (No, that’d be ridiculous...)
Win Conditon: Kill the enemy leader
Lose Condition: Pup, Charlotte, Kara or Rowan die.

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - REcluittwins
passages.content:
A distant voice could be heard vaguely.
Flynn: ...are you sure? We could... guard the...?
Reagyn: ...leave them to their fate...?
Flynn: ...right... can’t just abandon...

...

...alright, I can give the order...
Reagyn: Yes, my lord! We will repel this bandit incursion!
Flynn: W- Wait, you didn’t let me finish...
Kara: It is good to see you two.
Flynn: Yeah... I’m happy to see you all still alive and well.

We’d like to help, if you’ll have us.
Pup: How nice of you to ask.
Reagyn: Not you.
Reagyn: Lady Kara? Lady Stewart?
Kara: *Giggle*, I certainly have no objections.
Charlotte: The more the merrier.
Flynn: Thank you. Both of you.
Reagyn and Flynn joined the team!
Win Conditon: Kill all bandits. 
Lose Condition: Pup, Charlotte, Kara, Rowan or 
the twins die.

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - Start
passages.content:
I took a deep breath.
Pup: Come on, you bandit scum! Let me show you how 
a real swordsman fights!

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - Curse
passages.content:
Pup: These bandit raids are getting silly.
Kara: Have these been common for you to deal with?
Pup: Well... not really. We’ve been focused on helping 
Charlotte.
Charlotte: True, the closest we’ve gotten has been in the 
pirate infested town.
Otis: Heh. Don’t forget we live there, princess.
Norde: Though... There was a bandit raid before we met 
you in Lockhart.

It was on the outskirts of the Western Auran 
Alliance.
Charlotte: Really?
Mariel: I do remember bandits being the first people to 
attack.

Weren’t people saying it was a bandit raid at first?
Charlotte: Actually, I think I remember people saying that was 
a bandit raid at first...
Kara: ...
Pup: Norde, didn’t those bandits start with-
Pup: Ugh...!
A wooziness overtook me suddenly.
Norde: Anton, are you-
Norde: ...!
Pup: (This... feeling...?!)
Otis: Eh? Anyone else startin’ to feel a bit... seasick?
Reagyn: What is happening?
Reagyn: You don’t look alright...
Rowan: It is... a long story.
Pup: We’ll... We’ll catch you up later.
Pup: F- For now... We need to finish this quickly!
Rowan: It is happening again?
Pup: Yeah... I think so, yeah.
Pup: We need to finish this quickly!
Members with the "Weakness" Skill have the 
Weakness debuff.

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - Place Event
passages.content:
The chest opened with a ‘pop’.
Jenny: AHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!
Jakson: ...!?
Unknown_4294967295: ...!?
What looked to be a young girl sprung up from the 
chest, even breaking its hinges.
Jenny: ...Oh, hello there.
Jenny: I had the weirdest dream.
Jenny: ...
Jenny: Wait... Where am I?
Jakson: *Confuse whine*
Unknown_4294967295: You were... hiding in a chest...
Jenny: Well, I suddenly found myself summoned by this 
demon lady one day and I was like way girly for 
some reason.
Thank God that was just a dream or I might have-
Jenny looked down.
Jenny: Oh... flub it all... I...
Soon, Jenny shyly started to retreat into the chest 
like it was a turtle shell.
Jenny: Was that not... a dream...?
Jakson: *Happy bark*
Unknown_4294967295: No...?
Jenny: You’re not gonna... try to corrupt me, are you?
Jakson: ...
Jakson: *Confused whine*
Unknown_4294967295: No...
Jenny: You know, this place seems a lot more open than 
the last place...

I could just run away if they try that...?
Jakson: *Surprised bark*
Unknown_4294967295: Just be careful, there are a lot of dangerous people 
around.
Jenny: You know what? I’ll come with you and fight for 
you. You seem like you’re probably nice enough.
Jakson: *Confused bark*
Unknown_4294967295: Sure...?
Jenny: Is this is a recruitment scene?
Jakson: *Confused whine*
Unknown_4294967295: A what?
Jenny was recruited!
Jenny: Yep! Recruitment scene!
Jakson: *Reluctant happy bark*
Unknown_4294967295: Welcome...?

Jakson: ...

Okay...

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - Place Event
passages.content:
The chest opener found a letter.

“Your demon lord is in another
castle.”

Weird...

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - Pup → Reagyn
passages.content:
Pup: Of all the people to come back. I wasn’t expecting 
this.
Reagyn: I said before that I underestimated you.
Reagyn: But it’d be irresponsible of me to not try and keep 
that capability on an honorable track.
Reagyn: At least while you are in Lady Stewart’s employ.
Pup: Well, try to keep up. Maybe you’ll learn something.
Reagyn: The same sentiment to you.

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - Mariel → Flynn
passages.content:
Mariel: Flynn? Flynn Coslett? I haven’t seen you since 
school.
Flynn: Mariel. I hope you’ve done well since graduating.
Mariel: I’ve been well.
Mariel: Bar... recent events.
Flynn: O- Oh... I’m sorry.
Mariel: It’s okay. How have you been doing since you 
graduated? I heard about it at the banquet.
Flynn: Well... it’s been a week.
Mariel: That’s okay. I’m sure you have a bright future 
ahead.
Flynn: Y- Yeah... I hope so. Thank you.

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - Kara → Norde
passages.content:
Kara: What an odd thing to happen.
Norde: A bandit raid?
Kara: A bandit raid on a secured facility filled with trained 
fighters.
Norde: I imagine you’ve not dealt with underworld type 
tactics very often, then.
Kara: I have had my moments.

It would delightful to hear your thoughts over a 
cup of tea, though.
Norde: ...
Norde: I’ll consider it.

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - Charlotte → Tatiana
passages.content:
Charlotte: Just... checking, but... You didn’t..
Tatiana: No, I didn’t call no bandits here.
Charlotte: I didn’t think so, but you in particular don’t get 
along with nobles.
Charlotte: Get a big gathering of them and...
Tatiana: If I was gonna, I’d do it myself.
Charlotte: Yeah... sorry. Just wanted to be doubly sure.
Tatiana: Pft. I expect a nice charitable donation in my next 
“paycheck” for this gig, you know?
Charlotte: Yeah, yeah. At least I know you’ll put it to good 
use.

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - Rowan → Otis
passages.content:
Rowan: Float like a butterfly...
Otis: And sting like a bee!
Through Rowan’s more elegant distraction, Otis’s 
forceful strike came at the enemy like a surprise.
Otis: We should put on a show more often.
Rowan: A delightful proposition you have there.

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - Satia → Jakson
passages.content:
Satia: Hey boy. Are you also distracted?
Jakson: *Curious whine*...?
Satia: Oh, nothing actually important.
Jakson: *Insistent bark*!
Satia: Fine, I can vent to you about it later. But only if 
you agree to not chew on my stuff.
Jakson: *Undecided whine*...

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - AFterbattle w Twins
passages.content:
Bandit: ...!
The bandit fell down limp as my sword 
slice connected.
Pup: *Pant*... *pant*...

I think... that’s the last of them.
I deftly sheathed my sword, and turned to the 
group as a whole.
Pup: ...
I scanned the field of battle.
Pup: That’ll probably make a good impression on the 
nobles.
Flynn: I’d be lying if I didn’t find it impressive.
Reagyn: Do you normally make Lady Kara and Lady Stewart 
fight on the front lines?!

What sort of protection is that?!
Charlotte: It’s fine. It’s fine.
Charlotte: I wouldn’t be able to forgive myself if I could make 
a difference and didn’t even try, anyways.
Reagyn: You have a commendable noble spirit, Lady 
Stewart.
Pup: That’s a heel turn.
Kara: ...

I must ask on it. That discussion from before.
Pup: That discussion from before what-
Pup: Ugh...
The wooziness had another bout.
Pup: Right, from when this started again.
Kara: My apologies for needing to disregard that for now.

I meant the topic before it.

The last time you saw a bandit raid.
Norde: It was...
Norde was clearly speaking through some 
semblance of discomfort.
Norde: It was before Lockhart. We were hired to act as 
guards on the western border of the WAA.
Norde: The invasion of Lockhart started under the guise of 
a bandit attack.

It left the city guard playing catch up when real 
soldiers showed up.
Kara: ...
Flynn: I... I thought bandit raids were the norm around 
the world.
Reagyn: Even in the Coslett domain here in Cartenan, we do 
have to fend the incursions off.

Why suggest this is anything like Lockhart?
Kara: The target.

Bandits don’t raid notably fortified facilities.

Especially one specifically meant for armed and 
trained nobility to do sport.
Pup: I mean, they took out the guard.
Kara: Our intervention assuredly kept friendly casualties 
to a minimum.

But even if we were not here, it would have been 
a suicide run for the bandits.
Charlotte: So they attacked for what...? The armory?
Kara: That would still be a suicide run. I am not one to

passages.name: CH7 Battle 2 - Ending
passages.content:
Soldier: Sir, the first wave has made it through successfully.

Our troops are moving the strategic points we’ve 
planned for.
Steel Wolf: ...
Nora: And the path to the summit?
Soldier: Yes, we’ve seen no signs of them reorganizing to 
protect it.
Nora: Good.

“Uninvadable” will be a distant memory, then.
Jude: Oh, is that the plan?
Jude: It must be quite the Dralleus to make that big of a 
strategic swing.
Nora: You know we don’t call them that outside of the 
Oathless Empire.
Jude: Sure, sure.
Jude: But it does make me wonder.

Mr. Steel Wolf guy, how did you even learn of it?

It has to be a closely guarded secret. At least for 
the level of detail we were told about it.
Nora: Try to not speak out of turn. We have a job to do.
Jude: I am just curious.
Steel Wolf: ...
The Steel Wolf raised a sword.

That sword.

The cursing sword that had struck more than a few 
helpless souls over its existence.

Eul’thame... an Oathbreaker.
Steel Wolf: A former friend once told me of it.
Nora: ...
Jude: ...
Jude: He had friends?
The hushed whisper was directed to his comrade.
Nora: Shut up. Why are you-
Steel Wolf: Let us begin.
Soldier: Yes, sir! We’ll have the soldiers start moving at 
once.
Nora: Got it. I’ll lead the troops to...
Nora: Jude, go and start your mission.
Jude: Right, the Vault.
Jude: I’ll see you all after, then.
Nora and Jude each went in separate directions.
Steel Wolf: ...
Soldier: Sir, do you want to...?

T- To... head out, too?
Steel Wolf: ...

Yes.
The Wolf's grip on Eul’thame became tighter.
Steel Wolf: We shall see if weakness hides beneath that veil.

If this glorified kingdom can even survive... the 
coming winter.

passages.name: CH8-2 - Steel Wolf (Pup)
passages.content:
Pup: You...!
Steel Wolf: You.
Pup: You won’t... *pant*... win this time!
Steel Wolf: Stirring in the misery of ignorance, then?

You will see yourself as you are one day.

Weak.
Pup: RARRRGHHH!!!

passages.name: CH8-2 - Steel Wolf (Rowan)
passages.content:
Rowan: ...
Steel Wolf: ...
Rowan: You do not need to do this.
Steel Wolf: ...
Rowan: I do not know what you were told, or where you 
acquired that sword, but...
Rowan: You know you can be better than this.
Steel Wolf: ...

Stay out of my way.

passages.name: CH8-2 - Steel Wolf (Charlotte)
passages.content:
Charlotte: You show yourself after what you did to my 
parents...?!
Steel Wolf: The oligarchs? The world is better off.
Charlotte: You...! I’ll give you a clean bullet through the head!
Steel Wolf: Do it.

passages.name: CH8-2 - Steel Wolf (Kara)
passages.content:
Kara: So you are this monstrous “Steel Wolf” I have 
heard of.
Steel Wolf: It does not matter.
Kara: Indeed it doesn’t.

Crusades and the heroic titles they bestow? It’s all 
more a subject for a Covenant historian.
Kara: What matters is where you acquired that 
Oathbreaker.
Steel Wolf: ...
Kara: Who gave it to you?
Steel Wolf: ...
Kara: Is this silence a sign of loyalty... or...?

passages.name: CH8-2 - Steel Wolf (Otis)
passages.content:
Otis: Haha!

Ya really thought it be a good idea to stand in the 
way of my axe? With *that* sword?
Otis: I’ll gut ya like a fish.

passages.name: CH8-2 - Steel Wolf (Norde)
passages.content:
Norde: I... know what you did to Ivan. I won’t run away 
from it.
Norde: I will hold his honor high.

passages.name: CH8-2 - Steel Wolf (Avalina)
passages.content:
Avalina: Barbarian imperial lackey...

I do not care if you’re some Crusade hero or 
otherwise, you will fall just as all others have.

passages.name: CH8-2 - Steel Wolf (Active)
passages.content:
Pup: *Pant*... Be careful! That sword... Just one strike 
and... *pant*... this damned curse...

passages.name: CH8-2 - Nora (Charlotte)
passages.content:
Nora: Tsk. So you’re still alive to be a thorn in Lockhart’s 
side.
Charlotte: I don’t care about you. Just die and get out of my 
way.
Nora: I can say the same...!

passages.name: CH8-2 - Nora (Mariel)
passages.content:
Mariel: Y- You...! You’re one of those people that 
attacked Lockhart.
Nora: Liberated, more like.
Mariel: That... doesn’t make any sense!
Nora: As if you could even comprehend it!

passages.name: CH8-2 - Avalina (Dead)
passages.content: Avalina: I... I will not let myself fall here...!

passages.name: CH8-2 - Steel Wolf (Avalina)
passages.content:
Avalina: Barbarian imperial lackey...

I do not care if you’re some Crusade hero or 
otherwise, you will fall just as all others have.

passages.name: CH8-2 - New Event
passages.content:
Win Condition: Defend for 12 turns
Lose Condition: Pup, Rowan, Charlotte, Kara die. 
Avalina dies before the 12th turn

passages.name: CH8-2 - Story
passages.content:
Pup: ...

No...
Pup: No... no no no...!
Steel Wolf: ...
Pup: (It can't be. Not now!)
I pulled myself up from my prone position to my 
knees.
Pup: *Pant* ...!

(Shit...! The curse...)
As I caught my breath, I looked to my side for my
compatriots.
Rowan: ...
Rowan, without a emotion leaking through, stared
unblinking at the Steel Wolf.
Charlotte: There you are! Are you alright?
Charlotte had come running up after 
recovering from the chaos herself.
Charlotte: Here, let me just...
Pup: ...
Charlotte: What? What are you... looking...
Her head turned to parallel my eyeline.
Charlotte: ...
Nora: Sir, what's our next move?
Steel Wolf: ...

Do what you will.
Nora: F- Fine... We'll continue blocking the escape routes.
Avalina: Urgh... Who is that?
Rowan: The Steel Wolf.
Avalina: "Steel Wolf"? Like the titles that famous crusaders 
are given?
Kara: So this is him? The one with the Oathbreaker as a
weapon?
Pup: Y- Yeah...
Charlotte: The murderer who is going to die today, yes. 
That's him.
Pup: *Pant*...

(I think I'm reaching a point of... of no return...!)
A shaky hand of mine violently pulled the medicinal
glass vial from my gear pouch.
Pup: ...!
In a swift gulp, I downed half of it and stuffed the
rest back in storage.
Pup: *Exhale*...
My breathing settled. The oncoming panic settled.
Avalina: Steel Wolf!

What is it you want? What you wish for? What 
would bring you and the empire to the negotiating 
table?
Steel Wolf: Hmph.

Weak.
Avalina: You...?!
Pup: That's not... gonna work...
I stuck my sword in the ground and used it to help 
me get to my feet.
Pup: We... We'll have to just escape. Or win. 
Something... Something like that.
Kara: Escape blocked by ambush...
Pup: Right. Then we'll unblock it. Or win. Or... something.
Pup: WOLF!!!
Steel Wolf: ...
I tightened my sword grip as I entered my fighting
stance.
Pup: *Pant*...
Pup: No other choice.

passages.content: Steel Wolf: This is getting no where.

Welcome. I'll be right there. First I must finish
dusting this area.
Macy: Hm?
Macy: H- Hey?! Why do you have that?!
Charlotte: Wait, what is this?
Macy: It's a chip that I need to keep being an effective maid
and-!
Macy: Wait... why was I being a maid...? Last I remember 
I was fighting... Elaine?

...Where am I?
Charlotte: Uh... Crekskia?
Macy: Oh Crekskia! That's...
Macy: What is a Crek-shika?
Kara: Are you okay? What this... strange item doing something
to you?
Macy: I think I'm okay now. Just made me compulsive 
want to act like a maid for a while...
Macy: I don't think I did anything too bad before you got 
it off, like-
Macy: ...sign a contract.
Macy took out a perfectly maintained piece of paper.
Charlotte: Hm? A contract?
Kara: A "Notice of Debt"... Hmm...
Macy: I'm starting to remember signing this now... I'm
screwed now if I don't re-equip that chip and be a
super-maid again...
Charlotte: What? Why?
Kara: According to the paper, debt incurred at a 
restaurant and inn.
Macy: What am I supposed to do when I wake up buck 
naked in the middle of a snowy field?

I found an inn that offered me a good meal and a
night's stay...
Macy: Next thing I know I have a contract shoved in my 
face! One that would multiply my debt by 1000 if 
broken!
Macy: Between debt and my maid mind... of course I 
didn't think twice before signing it...
Charlotte: That's not a thing.
Macy: ...
Macy: What? I think I misheard you.
Kara: Indentured Servitude Contracts like this have been
illegal since the Covenant became the dominant 
cultural power.
Macy: Cove-what?
Charlotte: Goods that can't be reclaimed - like food or housing 
- are goods a merchant needs to get payment for 
upfront.
Real merchants want to get paid, not life debt 
people.
Macy: What.
Kara: This Imperial seal on the contract looks shoddily
forged, too.
Macy: Meaning I never needed to spend the last couple months
as a maid...

...
Macy: Well, I guess I'm happy I got skilled with these
knives~
Macy gr

passages.name: CH11-2 - Pup → Kara
passages.content:
Kara: Ah, you are alive.
Kara: That is encouraging.
Pup: Not gonna fall here.
Pup: Not then, and not now.
Kara: "Then"...?
Pup: Ah... it's unimportant. Especially in the middle of a
fight.
Pup: But it's good to see you, Kara. Thank you for what
you've done today.
Kara: ...Of course.

passages.name: CH11-2 - Pup → Charlotte
passages.content:
Charlotte: I'm gonna have you executed, Pup.
Pup: It's good to see you, too, princess.
Charlotte: *Sigh*... No more running off, yeah?
Pup: I'll try.
Charlotte: Isn't that comforting, haha...
Charlotte: Maybe I'll have to dock your pay next time?
Pup: H- Hey... Don't go that far...

passages.name: CH11-2 - Pup → Satia
passages.content:
Satia: Pup!
Satia ran up to me and quickly wrapped me in 
a tight hug.
Pup: S- Satia?!
Pup: W- What are you doing?
I blurted out the words and Satia nuzzled against
me in a happy bliss.
Satia: Quiet. I earned this. You earned this.
Pup: I- I...
Pup: *Sigh*...
Pup: It's good to see you, Satia. I'm happy you're safe.
I hugged her back quickly, and soon enough we 
swiveled to face any incoming enemy... back to 
back.

passages.name: CH11-2 - Pup → Norde
passages.content:
Norde: Anton.
Pup: Norde.
Norde: Did you find what you needed?
Pup: Hmm... Maybe. It may be a matter of time to really 
know though.
Pup: I... think so, at least. Or am nearly there.
Norde: Good.
Norde: Now, shall we take down these Imperials?
Pup: Yeah, I'm up for that.

passages.name: CH11-2 - Rowan → Charlotte
passages.content:
Charlotte: Huh?! Why are you here?
Rowan: Et tu, dear Charlotte?
Rowan: You should ask that question of the troops.
Charlotte: I know the answer to that already. They're trying 
to kill me.
Rowan: A fair answer...
Rowan: Then shall I protect you, my dear friend?
Charlotte: We'll see if you can.

Maybe I'll protect you?
Rowan: I look forward to being in your debt~

passages.name: CH11-2 - Mariel → Satia
passages.content:
Mariel: Satia! Are you alright?
Satia: Yes, dear. I am in good condition.
Satia: One ready to rid us of this threat to you, your 
sister, Pup, and...
Mariel: And to you!
Mariel: I'll do my best to keep you safe, as well.
Satia: Sweet as that is, they are after you and others. I 
am but a wall in their road to that.
Mariel: And a beautiful and valuable wall at that!
Mariel: I'm not afraid of these people not anymore. Not 
with you all around.
Satia: ...
Satia: *Giggle*... Very well, shall we fight them 
together, then?
Mariel: Yeah!

passages.name: CH11-2 - Jude → Otis
passages.content:
Jude: You were awoken as well?
Otis: Gah, yeah. That hollering bard screaming up and 
down the village.
Jude: Ah... same.
Otis: But ya actually came? Didn't think ya would fight 
your ol' crew.
Jude: It is... awkward.
Jude: Some of them still owe me a debt, too...
Otis: Heheh~

Maybe some lootin' will make ya lot even, then?
Jude: That's... maybe a bit much.
Jude: I'm not that sort of mercenary.
Otis: Ah, more loot for me, then. Maybe I'll buy ya 
somethin' tasty?
Jude: ...I wouldn't say "no" to that.

passages.name: CH11-2 - Jakson → Atticus
passages.content:
Atticus: This place... Yes, this is a Vault.
Jakson: *Whimper*...
Atticus: There, boy.

Well get your owner out of her safely.
Jakson: *Appreciative bark*
Atticus: Though you still look nervous...

Perhaps you can sense that this place was 
important to the Pup child...?
Jakson: *Determined bark*

passages.name: CH11-2 - Elliot → Tatiana
passages.content:
Tatiana: Eh, what a place for the Covenant to build. This is a
Vault?
Elliot: Technically.
Elliot: This place appears unfinished, though?

Perhaps they were building out a maze as a 
protective measure...? It is safer than a straight 
tunnel to the Vault.
Tatiana: What a damn waste.
Elliot: The Covenant takes the protection of 
Oathbreakers seriously.
Tatiana: Hmph. Clearly didn't work here.
Elliot: I... suppose not.

passages.name: CH11-2 - Castel → Reagyn
passages.content:
Castel: Intriguing... An entire labyrinth... just to protect an
Oathbreaker.
Reagyn: Shouldn't you be focusing on that at this time?
We've hostiles about.
Castel: Ah, such is true. But one cannot take my curiosity. 
I would not be me.
Castel: Do you not see these tunnels and rooms and have 
a rush of wonder for its nature? Its purpose?
Reagyn: Not particularly.

We're not here to gawk. We're here to do a job.

If we're not trying to work towards saving my 
homeland, it is not worth what time and resources 
I have.
Castel: Ah, but that is the key. To understand is to be able 
to achieve your goals more effectively.
Castel: See those wooden structures supporting the 
tunnel? What if we were to destroy them?
Castel: What if the enemy was to destroy them?
Reagyn: That is... true.
Reagyn: Then I'll leave such observations to you.
Castel: Of course.

passages.name: CH11-2 - Flynn → Kara
passages.content:
Flynn: This place is so dark and dank...
Kara: Be strong, friend. They are as blinded as we are.
Flynn: Lady Kara...
Flynn: I understand, but... they're organized. 
We just woke up.
Kara: They're also coming off a lengthy chase. They are 
tired and we are rested.
Kara: Do no fret. They do not have the advantage. We 
do.
Flynn: That's...
Flynn: Thank you, Lady Kara. As usual, you know just 
what to say.

...!
I breathed in deeply and desperately tried to fill my
air with lungs.
It was like I hadn't breathed for an eternity.
Pup: ...Where... am I...?
The thought crept through my mind as my breathing
slowed.
Slowly, but surely, my eyes drifted through the area.
Pup: (It's like... a mine?)
Pup: (No, it's more like... tunnels. Like the sort built to
move through a building...)
Pup: (Half finished, but...)
I stood there for a moment.
I didn't know why, but...
Pup: Have I... been here before?
So I took a step.
And in that moment... from around a corner, I saw them.
Nikolai: Haha~
Anton: ...
Two figures burst from the cavernous corridor,
sprinting around the corner and out of view.
Pup: That is... That was...

...
Pup: That was...
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE TO BLACK BG

That was...
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE TO BG DLC COAL_MINE_LIFT
(NIGHT/BLUE COLOR)

Suddenly, I was the image I saw run about in front of
me.
Anton: (Wait... why am I... a kid again?)
Estella: Anton! Nikolai!
Anton: That voice...
Estella: Come back! It's too late for this.
Anton: Is that... really...

...mom?
As the thought passed through my head, I felt a hand on
my wrist.
Nikolai: C'mon, Anton!
Anton: Nikolai...
Nikolai: We gotta keep moving!
Anton: But, what about...
Estella: Where are you?! It's dangerous down here!
Anton: It's... dangerous down here?
Nikolai: Heheh~ Don't worry.

I'll protect you.
Anton: You...?
Nikolai: Of course. It's what a big brother does, isn't it?

I'll protect you, Anton. No matter what.
Anton: ...
Anton: Okay...

passages.name: CH12-2 - Nora (Charlotte)
passages.content:
Charlotte: I won’t give up on Lockhart.
Nora: ...

passages.name: CH12-2 - Nora (Mariel)
passages.content:
Nora: Save your words.
Mariel: I wasn’t going to say anything.

I know you’ve closed off your heart.
Nora: I am not...

No. I’m not here to convince you.

passages.name: CH12-2 - Nora (Jude)
passages.content:
Nora: ...
Jude: Give up on trying to call me a traitor.?
Nora: You’re just another enemy.
Jude: I suppose so.

This is for the best.

passages.name: CH12-2 - Story Intro
passages.content:
Charlotte: I didn't have anything to do with it!
Nora: It's a shame the tunnel collapsed. Perhaps it was
because of the minefield...?
Charlotte: Are you even listening?
Mariel: I don't think she is...
Pup: She isn't.
Nora: ...

I can hear your blathering. But it doesn't matter.

After all the pain Lockhart was put through... 
to weaponize us.
Charlotte: I already said-
Nora: I've seen it with my own eyes.

These tunnels. Your parents' involvement.
Charlotte: ...what?
Mariel: Our parents wouldn't...
Nora: As though I'd believe your crocodile tears of today.
Nora: It's only a shame we couldn't repurpose this 
atrocity of a war machine into a tool to save 
the city.
Charlotte: You mean the Empire would use these to...

How dare you-
Pup: Stop. She really isn't listening.
Nora: ...
Charlotte: But... I want to... help Lockhart.
Mariel: Yeah, me too.

She's a part of Lockhart.
Pup: Including her?
Pup: ...
I settled into a fighting stance.
Nora: ...
As did Nora and her allies.
Pup: I'll do what I can so neither of you need to 
"hurt Lockhart", at least.
Pup: I'll do what I can so you don't need to 
"hurt Lockhart", at least.

passages.name: CH12-2 - Enemy 1
passages.content:
Nora's Merc: Argh...!

Just... Just finish me off.
Pup: Just stay down and you'll get to live.
Nora's Merc: Tsk... dammit. Now the Princess's goons want to
humiliate us.
Pup: We can't win this, can we?
Nora's Merc: My home of Lockhart is more important than your 
half baked gesture.

I know how this story ends.
Pup: With as many people alive as we can.

I'm not going to hurt Charlotte and your all's 
Lockhart anymore than necessary.

passages.name: CH12-2 - Enemy 2
passages.content:
Nora's Merc: Ah, s- stupid bitches.

Just end it.
Charlotte: ...
Nora's Merc: I'm not some bleeding heart from your cursed city.

End it now.
Charlotte: ...

Rowan's Empire deserves a good fate, too. 
The people included.
Charlotte swiftly took her gun and hit the man on 
the back of the head.
He fell, knocked out, and Charlotte turned towards 
the battle again.

passages.name: CH12-2 - Enemy 3
passages.content:
Nora's Merc: Dammit... at least we won't be the last...

We'll reclaim Lockhart for its people. No matter 
what!
Mariel: That's my line.
Pup: I think that's Charlotte's line.
Nora's Merc: What do any of the so called Princesses of Lockhart
know of it?

*Spits*...! Nothing!
Mariel: I know its my home.
Mariel: And I know everyone there deserves a happy 
ending to this all.
Mariel: You included.
Pup: It's not just your home.

Don't speak as though you are the only one to 
decide its fate.
Nora's Merc: ...
The Lockhart mercenary gritted his teeth...
...then passed out.

passages.name: CH12-2 - Enemy 4
passages.content:
Charlotte: *Pant*... *pant*...
Nora's Merc: T- Take that...

...I won't... give up... now...

...for my home, I need to...
Charlotte: *Pant*... *pant*...

Neither of us... speak for Lockhart.
Nora's Merc: I won't... give it up to you...!
Charlotte: And I won't give it up to invaders.
Charlotte: I hope we can talk one day... on the future of our
home.
Charlotte pulled back her gun, and she knocked 
out the enemy mercenary.

passages.name: CH12-2 - Nora First Defeat
passages.content:
Nora: *Pant*...  *pant*...
Charlotte: *Pant*...  *pant*...
The two stared at each other, but their stand-off 
was stained with the reality of their dwindling 
endurance.
Charlotte: Will you... listen... already?!
Mariel: We're trying to save Lockhart!
Charlotte: We want to save Lockhart!
Nora: ...

We need no saviors...
Nora: ...least of all from oathbroken demons!
Nora had a second wind!
