passages.content:
Nora: N- *Pant*... No...
Nora's armor rattled against itself as she fell to a
knee.
Pup: *Pant*... Did we... get her...?
Mariel: It's... over...
My stance was faltering, but we had won.
Charlotte: Are you finally... going... to listen...?!
Charlotte aggressively stepped past me and toward 
Nora.
Nora: ...
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte slowly raised her gun.
And it was directed straight at Nora's head.
Charlotte: Can you please... just... listen...?
Nora: ...
Nora looked back and forth, only to see her allies
being apprehended by the rest of us.
It was complete defeat.
Nora: I don't...

I don't... accept the word of traitors...
Nora had fallen down entirely as exhaustion had 
fully taken her.
She stared to the sky through the hole we created
above.
Nora: .........
Pup: That armor feeling a bit heavy now?
Mariel: After all that... it may be hard to even move...
Charlotte: I didn't know anything about these tunnels.
Nora: Trying to rewrite history as a victor already?
Charlotte: No... I...
Charlotte: Argh...!
Nora: ...
Nora's eyes shifted to the skies above.
The sky was painted in the hues of a sunset.
Nora: ...I'm sorry, everyone.

I'm sorry, Malcus.

I'm sorry, Kiolna.

Sis didn't manage it.
Nora: I entrust you all... with our future...
And she closed her eyes.
Pup: Are you asking for us to end it?
Nora: Do what you must to a non-homlyn that's worn out 
their use.
Charlotte: I do not want to kill you!
Charlotte stepped forward and kicked Nora's leg 
out of frustration.
Mariel: Sis... maybe not... the best time...
And the words stuttered out of Mariel.
Both seemed their most frustrated self despite the
victory.
Pup: Careful...
Charlotte seemed her most frustrated self despite the
victory.
Nora: ...

Spare me the tantrum.
Charlotte: I'm not...
Charlotte: *Exhale*...
Charlotte let herself calm down.
The seconds ticked by.
Charlotte: I want to... I want to save the same people you 
want to save.
Nora: You want to return to your posh life.

To continue trampling over us.

Even

passages.name: SP: PupxJak C - Talk
passages.content:
The sizzle of grilled sausages wafted through the 
air as a bundle was plopped down onto my plate.
Pup: (Those smell great. It's been a while, too)
Norde: You're lucky. Those were the last batch.
I looked down at the three pieces of meat I held.
Pup: Aren't they a little... burnt?
Norde: ...
Pup: Thank you for the food!
Norde: *Sigh*
Pup: This looks like a good place.
I dropped myself to sit against a solemn tree. It 
was peaceful away from the camp.
Pup: ...
Pup: (Did I hear something?)
A blink of the eyes and a turn of the head later, 
a new sight stood before me.
Jakson: *Pant*
Pup: Hey boy, what are-
Pup: H- HEY!
Jakson: *Munch*
A sausage was gulped down in one bite. 
He licked his lips and I jumped to my feet 
with two sausages still in hand.
Pup: Jakson! Bad!
Jakson turned to me, hungrily...
Pup: What are you looking at?!

YOU just stole from me! I'm not giving you another 
bite!
Jakson: *Whine*
Jakson turned his head, pleading innocence.
Pup: Not one nibble!
Pup: (Have I lost him? Does he think he's a hunter or 
something now?)
I hesitantly took a seat, readying myself to eat 
my meal.
Pup: ...
Pup: (The tall grass?! I'll be ready this time!)
The plate swiftly launched upwards as my arms 
extended it beyond the reach of the tall grass. I 
stared vigilantly for Jakson to make his move.
Pup: ...
A bird flew out of the tall grass.
Pup: ...
Pup: *Sigh*... It was just a bird... It was just a...
As my body relaxed, I had turned my head back 
towards the plate at the end of my outstretched 
arms.
Jakson: *Munch munch*
And then there was one.
Pup: Jakson! This is my meal!
I jumped to my feet and Jakson didn't move at 
first.
Pup: ...
Pup: Do not... follow me... Stay!
Pup: ...
Pup: Good boy.
With a single sausage left in hand, I sprinted as far 
as my legs could carry me.
Pup: *Pant*...*pant*...

(Did I finally lose the 'mighty hunter'...?)
I looked at the ever cooling sausage still on 
my plate.
Pup: (Cold or no, it's still mine!)
Through my ragged breaths, I caught

passages.name: SP: Satia x Ivan C - New Event
passages.content:
Norde: ...and they need to meet within the hour.
Ivan: Understood. I'll head out soon.
The two bid their farewells, and Ivan turned 
to enter a nearby tent.
Ivan: ...
The hum of a boiling pot matched the steam 
circulating around the tent.
Ivan's hand reached for the lid of the boiling pot.
Ivan: ...
Ivan: ...!?
Satia: Guess who?
Ivan: *Sigh*... Aren't you a bit old to be
doing this?
Satia: If you get it wrong, then you owe me a gold 
piece~
Ivan: Satia. I am not playing this game.
With hands removed from Ivan's eyes, Satia moved 
between him and the boiling meal.
Satia: Oh? I thought you liked to gamble.
Ivan: News to me.
Satia opened the lid herself and steam burst out.
Satia: And how long do you figure this has been cooking?
Ivan: ...
Satia used some tongs to pull out the fish meat 
held within.
Satia: What if you got sick? What if you went down and 
left the Crows without their commander?
Ivan: ...
A knife entered Satia's grip as she expertly diced 
the meat.
Satia: Better yet, what if you left your little Pup all alone?
Ivan: I imagine he'd be in good hands.
Satia: Regardless...
With a twirl, Satia's hand sprinkled a variety of 
spices across the meal.
Satia: Some days I wonder what Harold was thinking 
leaving the Nightless Crows under your command...
Ivan: ...
Satia: ...
Ivan: Are we done, then?
Satia: Obviously not.
Ivan: What's left then? What do you want?
Satia: A complete and utter reformation doesn't seem like 
too much to ask for?
Satia pulled a piece of packing paper and string 
from a nearby supply box.
Ivan: When you get to my age, it can become 
more dangerous than not to start doubting your 
instincts.
Satia: Yes, yes... "Old dogs can't learn new tricks". 
You've said as much before.
Ivan: Then may I have my meal?
Satia's hands weaved back and forth as the string 
became taught around the now packaged fish.
Satia: *Sigh*... Very well.
One packaged fish meal dropped into Ivan's hands.
Ivan: Thank you very much. Have a good evening.
Ivan promptly piv

passages.name: SP: Jakson x Ivan C - New Event
passages.content:
A shadow slipped through the night, sliding across 
the soft glow of light from within the camp's tents.
A dog sat in front of one of the tents. It's head 
dropped down as it relaxed it's body.
The glow of the tent faded to black, and the 
shadow disappeared into the darkness.
Jakson: ...
The dog's head bolted up at the sound.

The click of metal accompanied moonlight 
shimmering off a steel blade.
Jakson: *Growl*...
As the blade unsheathed, the dog met it with a 
quiet yet audible growl.

The sword stayed locked into placed, and only after 
several tense seconds did it return to its sheathe.
Jakson: ...
The dog stared intently at the shadow as it stared 
back.
With a step backwards, the shadow moved into 
the moonlight.
Ivan: ...
Another step back left Ivan having once more 
retreated into the dark.
Jakson: ...
Jakson stayed at attention for several minutes 
longer before finally relaxing.
The crowd moaned and swayed as the notable 
number obscured several presences.
Ivan: ...
Ivan moved deliberately to ensure he moved 
inconspicuously through the crowd.

His eyes had focused on one person in particular.
They were by a stall, haggling with a merchant.

With a click, a sword began to slide from 
it's sheathe.
Jakson: *Growl*
Jakson had placed himself between Ivan and his 
target.
Ivan: ...
Ivan raised his head to see a handful of the busy 
crowd turn and stare in their direction.

With a click once more, the weapon was put away 
and Ivan disappeared into the mass of people.
Jakson: ...
Jakson still stared into the crowd.
Pup: Everything okay, boy?
A familiar scene.
Jakson: *Growl*
Ivan: ...
The glow of the tent had faded into the shadows, 
leaving only the moonlit shine of the blade.

A step forward.
Jakson: *Growl*!
The growling intensified.

So too did the shine of the blade grow wider 
as the full length came into view.
Jakson: *Bark*...
A soft bark. It was a warning.
Ivan: ...
Another step.
Jakson: *Growl*!
Jakson launched himself forward towards the 
commander

passages.name: SP: Rowan x Ivan C - If in CH2
passages.content: Earlier in the Rabaneau Tavern...

passages.name: SP: Rowan x Ivan C - New Event
passages.content:
Ivan: And?
Rowan: The Kingdom of Cartenan.
Ivan tapped the quill in his hand on the table. It's 
beat was quiet, but audible within the sleepy 
tavern.
Ivan: Where in Cartenan are you from?
Rowan: Cambre. On the outskirts.
The taps of the quill calmed.
Ivan: And you've lived there all your life?
Rowan: Home is where the heart is.
Quill taps.
Ivan: ...
Rowan: I've left the country at times in my life, if that is 
what you pursue.
Ivan: Alright.

What brings you to Rabaneau?
Rowan: Have I not spoken of it?
Rowan: To quell the pains of war with a song of healing.
The tapping stopped, but a sigh echoed in 
the sleepy tavern.
Ivan: And how has that gone?
Rowan: Ah... Some wounds are best left closed, no?
Ivan: Where did you train in this so called singing?
Rowan: So the dagger slices ever deeper...
Ivan: And an answer?
Rowan: Hmm... Where did I learn to sing?
Rowan: Along the winds of the spring skies, I suppose?
The scribbling of words by the pen 
stopped abruptly.
Ivan: ...
No tapping resumed, but the quill - feather and all - 
softly dropped to the table's surface.
Ivan: What's your favorite color?
Rowan: Color?
Rowan: Raspberry.
A silence grated on Ivan.
Ivan: Favorite food?
Rowan: Orange.
The silence was broken by the wood of a chair 
scuffing across the ground.
Rowan: Mr. Savior-Crow-Man?
Ivan lowered himself haphazardly to the chair once 
more. This time, he had a wooden mug in hand.
Ivan: ...
Rowan: ...
Ivan took a sip from the mug.
Rowan: Well if we insist on that endeavor, then...
Rowan: May I perhaps have a
Ivan: Age?
Rowan: Old enough to love life.
Ivan: So not old enough to know your ass from your 
nose.
Ivan: You've met my son. Even I know how foolhardy 
that age can be.
Rowan: Ah, yes. The industrious "Anton", was it? Or 
perhaps "Pup"?

An interesting child that one is.
Ivan: Hmm...
With dramatic swing, Ivan gulped down the 
remains of the mug. It echoed as it was 
slammed down on the table.
Ivan: Let's start from the beginning.

Name?
Rowan: Ah, tedium.

passages.name: SP: Jakson x Norde C - New Event
passages.content:
Norde: Good. I'm back in time for supper rations.
Norde: Hmm...
Norde: I wonder who is on cooking duty today?
Norde: *Sigh*...
Norde slumped into a seat around the warm 
campfire.
Norde: Hm...? What was...
Norde turned to not see anything behind him.
Norde: ...

My imagination, maybe?
Fellow Crow: Norde, not gonna have any? The duck is great 
today.
Norde: ...Duck? We didn't purchase any duck meat lately.
Fellow Crow: Uh... Don't know what to tell ya.
Norde: Who is on cooking duty today?
Fellow Crow: I dunno. Maybe- Oh, hey boy.
Jakson: *Panting*
Norde: Jakson... do you need something?
Jakson: *Bark*!
Fellow Crow: I think he wants your order?
Norde: Excuse me?
Fellow Crow: Don't worry about it. Just get him some of the 
duck.
Jakson: *Happy Bark*!
Norde: Why is the dog taking food orders?
The other man just shrugged his shoulders.
Norde: Then I must inter-
Norde's effort to raise to his feet was cutoff by him 
hearing something from the nearby cooking tent.
Pup: DUCK!?
Pup: Why... Why is everyone ordering... duck?

We don't have any duck!
Jakson: *Bark*!
Pup: Norde? Then...
Pup: Does that mean we should have duck? Did I forget 
it when I was at the market?
Pup: Uh... What do we have left that might taste like 
duck? Even a little?
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
After a few short minutes, the flap of the tent  
burst open with a brown fuzzball now in sight.
Jakson: *Bark muffled by carrying food*...
A small bowl was dropped into Norde's hands.
Norde: ...
It was mostly empty. Distinct bite marks were left 
on multiple pieces of meat.
Jakson: *Licks lips*
Norde: Jakson...
Norde: I... would recommend showing this to your owner.
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Grabbing the bowl, Jakson headed back to the 
tent.
Pup: What? They already want seconds?!
Pup: W- What's left to...
Norde: ...
Norde was soon on his feet.
Fellow Crow: Not hungry?
Norde: An itch at the back of my mind has stolen my 
appetite.
Fellow Crow: Eh. Your loss.
Pup: Haha! This... Now this could work!
Norde made his way over

passages.name: SP: Pup x Ivan C - New Event
passages.content:
Ivan: ...and that makes three bushels of apples.
Pup: Grh!
Pup: There... we... go...
Pup: We finishing early this time?
Ivan: Yes. Now to weapon maintenance.
Pup: ...
Ivan continued to note down marks on his 
paperwork. He looked up after a few seconds 
of me hesitating.
Ivan: Pup?
Pup: Weapon maintenance. Got it.
Pup: (Maybe I can make it in half the
time this time?)
Pup: Grh!
With a thud, I dropped a greatsword next to me. 
Ivan leaned down to inspect it.
Pup: (Next one. Quicker this time.)
Ivan: Hmm... There's a small chip in...
Ivan: ...
Pup: And... there!
This time an axe lay at my father's feet.
Pup: Last one... to be accounted for...
fully sharpened.
Pup: Argh... How'd we do? We make good time this 
time around?
Ivan: Good enough. Thank you.
Pup: And... uh... How about me? I make good time 
myself?
Ivan: You did well. Make sure you get rested. 
Tomorrow's a long day, too.
Pup: Right... Will do...
I watched as my father dipped into a nearby tent.
Pup: ...

(He does have the entire group to worry about, 
after all.)

(...an entire group... to protect...)
An image of a silhouette covered in an onslaught of 
light popped into my head.
Pup: (Like usual, I just need to be strong like a proper 
man that can hold his head high.)

(To be strong like him. That's my step one. To be 
strong like a mercenary leader)
I clenched my hand into a fist.
Pup: (Step one... to no longer being weak.)
The air rushed out of my lungs along with the 
tension in my body.

I rubbed my biceps. They were quite sore from 
rushing around all day.
Pup: And that starts with a proper rest.
Pup: (I'll take the initiative in tomorrow's mission too.)
Pup: (I need every chance I can get to train and 
challenge myself.)
Ivan: ...
Ivan was scribbling down notes on parchment.
Norde: Are the plans for tomorrow's mission prepared?
Ivan: Not... quite...
Norde: I thought you were just needing to finalize them 
earlier this-
Norde: Ah. That's it.
Ivan: I believe if we deploy this group this way, then-
Nord

passages.name: SP: Pup x Satia C - New Event
passages.content:
Pup: ...!
The blade in my hand sliced through the air as I 
paced my way through a training routine.
Pup: ...!

There!
Pup: *Exhale*...
Pup: (Another ten on those and-)
Pup: Ow!
A stinging pain broke me out of the pattern.
Pup: What was that for?!
Satia: Hmm... Nope. Not good. Not good at all.
Satia was holding up the hair she had plucked from 
my head towards the sun above.
Pup: Huh?
Pup: This is... new.
Satia: Expect the unexpected?
Satia: But truly... Such a shame. It's like you try to bring 
misfortune upon yourself at times.
She went back to looking at the strand of hair.
Pup: You don't say...?
Pup: (Does she just want to rile me up?)
Pup: (Or... Is this what I think it is?)
Satia: A shame, a shame. It seems we'll
have to do a thorough-
Pup: Expect the unexpected!
Satia: ...?!
A sword, handle first, was lobbed towards Satia.
She caught it in her bewilderment, but I had 
already made a sprint for an exit.
Satia: Pup! Get back here!
Pup: *Pant*... did I... lose her?
I turned.
Satia: ...!
Pup: Crap!
Pup: This time. There's no way she-
I turned a corner.
Satia: ...
Pup: Every time!
Pup: (She's still hot on my tail... What now?)
Pup: (Oh, that's an idea.)
Pup: (If I can just swim across the river, she might not 
even want to follow!)
Satia: What are you doing?!
The water splashed around me as I dived into
the nearby river.
Pup: (Perfect, now I just need to...)
Pup: (Wait, what the...? What's that?)
Pup: (Dammit, not now!)
Fellow Crow: Hey, Satia.
Satia: Good afternoon.
Other Crow: Big catch today?
Satia: It was a feisty one, for sure.
Satia made her way through the camp dragging 
along a large net.
Satia: And...!
Satia dumped out the contents of the fishing net.
Pup: ...

Ow.
Satia: Shall we get started?
Pup: I just wanted to do my daily training. Is that so 
unreasonable?
Satia: You should've thought of that before you made it 
even worse.
Satia: Your hair smells like raw fish.
Pup: ...?
I took a sniff of some of my hair.
Pup: ...?!
Pup: (Yeah, that's bad.)

passages.name: SP: Pup x Satia C - Pup TG3
passages.content:
Satia: With... well, everything's that has happened, it's 
even more important for you to properly take care 
of it.
At worst, you'll draw more illadvised attention to us 
if you don't.

passages.name: SP: Pup x Satia C - Pup less than3
passages.content:
Satia: You don't exactly have a bald head. Hair care has 
it's importance.

How long ago was it that you decided to let your 
hair grow out some? Before all this started.
Satia: I said then that you'd need to actually take care of 
it, yes?

passages.name: SP: Pup x Satia C - Continue
passages.content:
Pup: I guess. It's not like my hair stunk when you came 
to me earlier, though.
I shifted myself to a sitting position.
Satia: Hair maintenance is more than just how it smells. 
It's a duty to yourself.
Satia: If there's anything you should try to not take after 
your father with, it's these sorts of habits.
Satia: And if you let me teach you properly, then you 
wouldn't need me to hassle you over it.
Pup: I...
Pup: (I didn't want to do it because I wanted to finish 
my training. This is going to take hours.)
Pup: (Well it's going to take hours with a lesson or 
not...)
Pup: I... guess. Fine.
Satia: Perfect!
Satia rustled through a nearby box.
Satia: I actually stumbled upon this mixture lately. They 
say it will make your hair smell like a flower.
Pup: You... don't say?
Pup: A better smell than fish, I suppose.

passages.name: SP: Ivan x Norde C - New Event
passages.content:
Mariel: ...
A glow arose from a bracelet on Mariel's arm. 
Through it, she was channeling divine healing.
Norde: Ms. Stewart? How goes it? Have they stabilized?
Mariel: Stable, yes. Your boss is still in a precarious
state, however. I've healed their wounds
with my blessings the best I can.
In the most optimistic case, they'll likely need 
plenty more rest and recovery, though.
Mariel looked over at Pup, who was on the bed she 
was not attending to.
Pup: ...
Mariel: Nightmares and all.
Norde: Is that so?
Norde: You have my thanks. We were lucky to have a Blue 
magic user to assist us.
Mariel: It's nothing. Especially after you helped my sister 
and me as you did.
Ivan: It... wouldn't do to understate it, Norde. 
We... really are thankful.
Mariel: A- Ah. You really shouldn't be up. You need to go 
back to sleep.
Ivan: In a short while, yes.
Mariel: You're going to hurt yourself. This time I may
not even be able to keep you alive.
Ivan: I imagine Norde came with the hopes that I would 
be stirring, though.
Norde: There is... truth in that.
Mariel: I...
As Mariel looked between the two faces,
it seemed as though the decision was 
already made.
Mariel: Let me know immediately if anything even
starts hurting a little.
Ivan: I certainly will. It is appreciated. 

We should be done shortly.
Ivan: Fairing well?
Norde: I am the same as ever.
Ivan: You have a bandage sticking out of your sleeve.
Norde: ...
Norde: Wounds are to be expected in battle.
Ivan: I'm happy to see you can be so lively. It's a good 
sign.
Norde: Are you truly in a position to be so worried about 
others?
Ivan: Ah... This? I'm not worth the worry.
Norde: Sir...
Ivan: Enough of that. You came to ask a question, I 
assume?
Norde: ...Very well.
Norde: That man. That "Steel Wolf". Do you know him?
Ivan: Hard to say.
Ivan: ...He mentioned Crekskia, though.
Norde: What?
Norde: Sir. I know it may be hard to talk about... But if 
ever there was a time to open up about that 
event, then this is it.
Ivan: ...
Iva

passages.name: SP: Pupx Jack B - Begining
passages.content:
Pup: ...
Jakson: ...
Pup: ...
Jakson: ...
Pup: ...
Jakson: ...
I blinked.
Pup: ...!
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Pup: Dammit...
I blinked rapidly. My eyes stung from the staring 
contest.
Pup: Fine. Take the bedding. It's not like I haven't slept 
on the ground before.
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Norde: Hello, you two.

We just had a messenger deliver the receipt for a
successful bedding purchase.
Pup: Perfect timing, Norde.
Norde: It isn't as though I had any control over it.
Norde: Though... of what I can control, I am surprised by 
the need for another set.
Norde: I could have sworn that the recent supply refresh 
purchased enough to suit our current numbers...
Pup: Ah... well...
I looked over at Jakson while trying to not let 
Norde notice.
Pup: (He never counts Jakson in those, since he's a 
dog.)
Pup: Mistakes like that are bound to happen sometime... 
yeah?
Norde: ...
Norde: Regardless, the bedding needs to be picked up 
from the nearby town.
Pup: It's not here?
Norde: Yes. Like I said, we heard from a messenger.
Norde: It's in your hands now.
Pup: Tsk.
Pup: (Why not send it instead of a messenger?)
Jakson: *Confused whine*...?
Pup: Looks like we've got a mission to complete before 
the day's out.
After trekking to the nearby town, we had 
procured the admittedly mediocre sleeping cot.
Tying it up like a backpack, we headed out to 
return to camp.
Pup: There we go. Let's head back, boy.
Jakson: *Happy pant*
Pup: (While we're here, maybe we should pick up some 
other supplies.)

(Aren't we running low on... on...)
Pup: (What was it again? It was-)
Pup: ...!?
Jakson: *Bark*!
Pup: Grk!
Pup: (A... horse? With some riding it?)

Yeah! You run away! You- You..!
Pup: *Sigh* ...Damn that asshole. He sort of looked 
drunk, even.
I turned, only to see the cot snapped in two and 
off to my side.
Pup: ...
My body slumped down fully onto the ground.
Pup: I'll just sleep here.
I had no energy while my body ragdolled in
exasperation.

Jakson approached me and started to lick my hand.
Jak

passages.name: SP: Pup x Cainan C - Begining
passages.content:
Pup: Hm... Not a bad price...
ShopKeep: Are you gonna buy something or not?
Pup: Maybe. I'm undecided.
ShopKeep: Kid, it's been over an hour.
Pup: W- Well...
Pup: Then the answer is no if you're going to be like 
that. I'm not going to buy shit from here.
I stormed off feeling like steam was rising from 
my ears.
Pup: Who does that guy think he is?
My aimless march brought me in front of a café.
Pup: (Something soothing actually sounds really nice 
right now)
With a paid for tea in hand, I found a corner of the 
shop to park myself in.

It wasn't long before I looked up to see a familiar 
face in front of me.
Cainan: Ah, one of those... mercenaries. The Dayless 
Doves, was it?
Pup: ...Nightless Crows...
Cainan: Ha! Much cooler.
Pup: I didn't name the thing.
Cainan: Would you mind some company? I just ordered a 
cup myself.
Pup: Do what you want.
Cainan: My thanks.
Cainan grabbed one of the chairs and sat himself 
down. A café staff member dropped off his own 
cup of tea soon after.
Pup: ...
Cainan: Hm...

So...

You are worried for your father?
Pup: No. He'll be fine. He's strong, after all.
Cainan: Is that so?

Who is your father then?
Pup: What? Why does that matter?
Cainan: I may hail from the Covenant, but I can offer no 
salvation for you or him. That is your burden to 
carry.
So I wished to know of him and the traits that 
inspire such confidence. To tell you how founded 
your belief in him is.
Pup: I...
Pup: ...
I bit my lip a little.

I wanted to hear him tell me it'd be alright, but 
there was the very real chance he wouldn't.
Pup: ...

My father is Ivan Baranov. Leader of the Nightless 
Crows.

He's... stalwart and powerful.

He's protected me all my life.
Pup: He's strong. He's always been the strongest person 
I've known.
My fist tightened enough that I started to lose 
feeling in it.
Cainan: ...

"Ivan Baranov"?
Pup: Yeah. What about it? I'm Anton Baranov.
Cainan: It has been a long time since I've heard that name. 
So he became a mercenary?
Pup: W- Wha

passages.name: SP: Pup x Mariel C - Begining
passages.content:
Pup: One, two, three!

One, two... three!
Pup: *Pant*
Drops of water fell back to the surface and left 
ripples among the otherwise static depths.
Pup: One more set...
I readied my sword once more, but my focus was 
broken by the sound of approaching footsteps.
Mariel: Pup? Up early for some training?
Pup: Ah, Mariel?
With her here, I shift my sword to a passive 
position.
Pup: Yep. Training to improve the quickness of my 
strike.
Mariel: At the shoreline?
Pup: My father once showed me how he could slice 
through the water.

Here...
Tightening the grip on my sword, I wound up a 
rising slice.
Pup: Hah!
...but it crashed into the water, kicking up a bunch 
of the liquid to fall back down in a mini shower.
Mariel: Oh~ Explosive!
She clapped a little.
Pup: Wait, no. It's not supposed to do that...
Pup: If I swing it fast enough, I should be able to slice 
cleanly through the water.
Mariel: I think it looked cool.
Pup: Thanks, I guess
I sheathed my sword.
Pup: What brings you here?
Mariel: I'm delivering a note from Charlotte.
With a few steps forward and an outstretched 
hand, Mariel handed off a small piece of 
parchment to me.
Mariel: Good luck with your training!
Mariel ran off, clearly in a hurry.
Pup: T- Thanks...
Pup: (A note from the head princess?)
I unfolded the paper and a couple short sentences 
were unveiled.
Charlotte's Note: Stop buying extra meat. We're not your bank.
Pup: ...?!
Pup: Blasphemy.
With a huff to my step, I soon found my way back 
to camp.

It was long enough of a walk for my head to cool 
down some.
Pup: (Maybe I could convince her that the meat is a 
good idea?)
Pup: ...?!
I had turned a corner and ended up running into 
someone.
Mariel: O- Ow...
Pup: Oh crap! I'm so sorry!
Mariel: No, it's my bad. I was rushing to find the medical 
supplies.
Pup: I was rushing, too.

Here.
I extended my arm and helped her to her feet.
Pup: Did someone get hurt?
Pup: B- Besides you...?
Mariel: No, it's about inventory.
Pup: (Oh, that's probably why Charlot

passages.name: SP: Pup x Satia B - Begining
passages.content:
Pup: ...23... 24... I think that's all of them?
I put away my notepad as I finished my inventory 
rounds for the day.
Pup: ...
Pup: Hah...
My hands reflexively brought themselves to my 
shoulders.
Pup: (Must still be sore from my workout earlier?)
Pup: Good thing I'm done for the day, then.
With a pivot on my heel, I made my way for a tent.
Pup: (Where did I put that-)
Pup: ...?!
I felt a pressing, cushioned feeling pressed against 
my back.
???: Guess who~
Pup: The cold, slimy hands of death?
???: ...

"Slimy"?
Pup: In- In a good way?
Pup: Ow!
Satia: Too far.
Pup: S- Sorry...
I rubbed the stinging feeling on the back of my
head as I probed Satia face for whether she
accepted the apology.
Pup: Did you need something?
Satia: So cold... and slimy.
Satia: What if I simply wished to spend time with my 
favorite Crow?
Pup: I'm sure Norde is around here somewhere.
Satia: Oh, he can be quite cold. That is true. But he's not 
nearly as slimy.
Pup: I... I said I was sorry.
Satia: Well if the rumors on the sliminess aren't true, 
mayhap you have grip enough to carry a few items?
Satia: They're quite heavy, and I was hoping for some 
help from our premiere soldier of fortune.
Pup: Boxes? S- Sure. I can help.
Satia led me to the edge of camp.
Pup: *Grunt*! There... G- Got it. Where to?
Satia: Hm... Where best to put it?
Pup: O- Of course... no hurry.
Satia: How gallant of you~
Pup: ...
Pup: W- What is even in this?
Satia: Oh, that's where it should go. Follow me.
Our path led us to the armory tent. Inside were a 
few stations for changing, and Satia led us into the 
woman's changing area.
Pup: There... we... go...
An audible thud filled the room as the box hit the 
ground.
Pup: Why here?
Satia: It had some storage space still open.
Satia: Actually, while we're here, could you help check 
this armor shipment? It's a different supplier 
than we've used in the past.
Pup: Ah... That's why it's so heavy.
Pup: Sure. I was just doing inventory earlier anyways.
Satia gave me some space

passages.name: SP: Pup x Satia A - Begining
passages.content:
Pup: Flanking approaches... Supply line...?
My head hurt a bit when I tried to process a recent 
lesson from Kara on battlefield strategy.
Pup: (Ah... Things really get complicated when you have 
a lot of people in a conflict.)
Pup: Hm?
Pup: (That smell...)
A hot bowl of stew dropped itself into my hands. I 
had been waiting in line for dinner.
Pup: (The evening is getting a bit cold, so this would hit 
the spot near the campfire.)
Fellow Crow: Pup. Made it in time for dinner?
Pup: I'd never miss it when we're having this stew.
I plopped myself down onto a bench by the 
campfire next to the other Nightless Crow.

He seemed to be finishing up his own meal.
Fellow Crow: I'll... I'll leave you to your little romance with your 
meal.
Pup: Ah, come on!
He started on his way.
Pup: More like a sibling relationship, if anything~
I raised the spoon, only to be interrupted by the 
sound of a familiar click of a boot.
Pup: (No! Not now!)
My body froze, as if I was hoping the foreboding 
feeling would go away if I pretended it wasn't 
there.
Satia: Pup! I thought I saw that flash of red cloth pitter-
patter past me before.
Pup: W- What brings you here...?
Pup: (Be careful. Be very careful!)
Satia: I could smell the stew from a mile away. It's a nice 
smell in the waning day.
Pup: Well, I was actually just about to-
Satia: It... reminded me of the old days.
Pup: ...

That so...?
Satia placed herself down in the seat the other 
Nightless Crow had just vacated.
Satia: You know that stew recipe pre-dates myself or 
Norde joining the Crows?
Pup: Wow. This is an old recipe.
Satia: ...
Pup: I take it back.
Pup: I just mean... I remember eating this as a kid.
Pup: Back when my dad used to chase me around 
because he feared that I'd trip onto a sword's 
edge.
Satia: *Giggle*
Satia: You were so cute then. I do miss those days.
Pup: I sometimes wonder if I'd go back if given the 
chance...
Satia: No need. In a roundabout way, you're back to 
being cute like then, again.
Pup: Th- That's no

passages.name: SP: RowanxCainanC - Talk
passages.content:
A figure stood on a street corner.
Rowan: So stands the horizon's valiant winds~

Swept up with blossoms so twilight rescinds~

Day by daybreak~

Passes us by~

Night by midnight~

Counters with questions of why~
Rowan: ...
The small crowd that had formed around Rowan 
stood still.

And stayed still for longer still.
Villager: ...is that... it?
A light, hesitant applause rose from the onlookers. 

The crowd soon dispersed with a small set of coins 
having found their way into Rowan's donation bag.
Rowan: ...
Rowan: Another brilliant performance.
Cainan: A performance? Is that what that was?
Cainan stepped forward from the dispersing crowd.
Rowan: The glittering of bronze and silver at my feet is 
proof enough.
Cainan: Of your skill?
Rowan: Of happiness.
Rowan: Appreciation that reflects a little joy being sparked 
within the world.
Cainan: Interesting. Interesting.
Cainan pulled out a gold coin and dropped it into 
the donation bag.
Cainan: Consider it a reflection much the same, though 
perhaps not so directly from the song.
Rowan: Every bit of light brightens the world.
Rowan: Such light is the light of the Goddess, no?
Cainan: You do well to refuse me the option of disagreeing, 
haha...
Cainan: Though, if this is your normal income... it would be 
difficult to travel as you have.
Rowan: There are... other sources of revenue for those 
that wander.
Cainan: Few of legal certainty, I imagine.
Cainan: Was joining this band of mercenaries meant to give 
you financial stability?
Rowan: It was an unexpected boon. That much is sure.
Rowan hummed a melody that cut through the
silence of a pause.
Cainan: You know...

I barely recognized you when we met again. You 
could be considered a new person in more ways 
than one.
Rowan: I feel...
Rowan: ...liberated.
Rowan: You may say I've thrown off those chains that 
weighed me down.
Cainan: Poetic.
Cainan: Do your parents know? I can't imagine this would 
please them.
Rowan: I would think news made its way home long ago. 
Maybe

passages.name: SP: Rowan x Eve C - Talk
passages.content:
Eve: Didn't they say there was going to be a 
"celebration" tonight?
Eve: I guess this will be peaceful after all.
Five minutes later...
Rowan: And so...~

The midnight wanders wearily~
Fellow Crow: *Whistles* Encore!
Fellow Crow 2: Haha! Bravo! I didn't know you could butcher that 
song so badly!
Rowan: Thank you, my dear fans! Thank you!
Shortly away from the singing and dancing...
Pup: And then the guy took a swing at me. Then he-
Charlotte: Then he missed?
Pup: S- Shut up. I'm telling the story.
Pup: So it turned out that his weapon wasn't sharpened 
properly, so it...
Shortly away from that still...
Eve: W- What is this... What is this a celebration of...?
Fellow Crow: Who gets next dibs on singing?
Rowan: Ah... I have an idea!
Rowan: Our dear beloved Eve... Would you?
Eve: Eek!
Charlotte: Did she faint?!
A blur of pink, blue, and brown could be seen 
literally rolling away from the festivities at a 
fevered pace.
Pup: I think that's more a tactical retreat...
Rowan: Oh my...
The blur of rolling stopped and jumped to its feet.
Eve: *Pant*... *pant*...
Eve: *Breathes in*

*Breathes out*
For a few minutes, Eve simply stood there to
catch her breath.
Rowan: Have you managed to calm yourself?
Eve: I won't let you-
Eve jumped to an awkward defensive stance.
Eve: Oh, you're not a monster.
Eve: I just wanted some fresh air, I guess...
Rowan: I suppose even a flower can get tired of the sun, 
after a time.
Eve: Uh... yeah?
Eve: That is why the night is important for them.
Eve: The seasons are probably a lot more impactful, 
though.
Eve: Unless you're an alrune... You'd be surprised how 
much sun they can handle.
Rowan: Hah! Such an avalanche of words.
Rowan: Are you sure you don't wish to take the stage 
tonight? Mayhap with melodies of flowers?
Eve: Oh, I don't sing.
Eve: Besides, you had plenty of good options for who 
could sing next. The guy before you was pretty 
good.
Rowan: Bah humbleness!
Rowan: Surely a flower sprouts forth from every seed?
Eve: *Chuckles*...

passages.name: SP: Satia x Jak C - Talk
passages.content:
Satia: There we go.
Satia placed down an axe on the weapon rack.
Satia: Now, with that organized, I should-
Jakson: *Bark*!
Satia stumbled back in surprise, and she almost 
knocked over the weapons she had just organized.
Satia: Phew...
Satia: Jakson? I didn't notice you enter. Did you need 
something?
Satia: Actually, maybe you shouldn't stand so... so...
Jakson had walked up to Satia to the point he was 
standing right next to her.
Satia: You shouldn't... stand so... so...
Satia: ...CLOSE! ACHOO!
Satia flailed back from her sneeze.
Satia: No!
One by one, the weapons acted like dominoes as 
they plunged to the ground.
Satia: Ah... fuck nuggets...
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Satia: Maybe you... you should.
Satia: ACHOO!
Satia: Please wait outside.
Jakson: *Curious whine*?
Satia hurriedly fixed the mess while Jakson
stepped outside.
Satia: ACHOO!
Satia: Ack!
Drops of hot grease flew upward from the pan 
after Satia's surprise sneeze.
Satia: Hot hot! That... might burn...
She turned to see...
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Satia: J- Jackson... Could you... wait outside?
Jakson: *Happy bark*!
Jakson happily complied and moved away from 
Satia.

She sighed with a feeling of relief and went back to 
her cooking.
Satia: It doesn't look like it was ruined?
Satia: Thank the Goddess... This was going so well.
Satia shook the pan over the fire and shuffled the 
meat around inside it.
Satia: Hmm...?
A sound had pulled her attention.
Satia: What was-
Satia: ACHOO!
Satia: The food!
As Satia's eyes scanned down to where the meat 
had fallen, she was immediately greeted with 
something else.
Jakson: *Munch* *munch* *munch*
Satia: ...
Satia: Again?
Jakson: *Laugh-Like Whine*
Satia: ...
Satia: Jakson...

You wouldn't be doing this on purpose, would 
you?
The dog looked up while throwing puppy-dog eyes 
at Satia.
Satia: Don't think I'm so easily bewitched.
Jakson: *Huff*
Satia: Do it again and you're not getting-
Satia: ACHOO!
Satia: ...and you're not getting dinner.
Jakson just scoffed and went ba

passages.name: SP: Satia x Norde C - Talk
passages.content:
Satia: ...
Satia walked through the setting night in the 
quiet and still camp.
Satia: ...?
A sound like a whisper came from a tent she was 
passing.
Satia: ...
Fellow Crow: ...and you... want it...
Fellow Crow: But yeah, I can grab that.
Norde: Thank you.
The Crow turned to notice Satia.
Fellow Crow: Didn't see you there, Dunaid.

Need something from town? I'm headed out 
to pick up a-
Norde: ...
A raised hand from Norde stopped the man from 
talking.
Fellow Crow: Uh... I guess you can ask, instead.

Still, need anything?
Satia: I appreciate the offer, but I'm good.
Fellow Crow: Gotcha. I'll be off.
The Nightless Crow walked out of the tent.
Satia: You're sending him off to wander through the 
night to town?
Norde: Are we not supposed to be "Nightless"?
Satia: *Gasp*! A joke? From grumpy face Norde of all 
people?
Satia: D- Did something happen?
Norde: *Sigh*... Of course not.
Norde: Now, may I-
Satia placed herself between Norde and the exit.
Satia: What did you send him to get?
Norde: Nothing to put you in a rush to find out.
Norde tried to sidestep Satia. She repositioned 
herself again.
Satia: ...
Norde: I really must...
Satia: I could chase after him myself.
Norde: ...There is no... need.
Satia: Maybe I could even distract him from finishing the 
job you sent him on?
Norde: *Sigh*... Fine.
Norde: A mantlet.
Satia: Sorry?
Norde: A mantlet.
Satia: I heard.

Why would we need one? Those are shields meant 
for adjustable fortifications.
Norde: Since Lockhart, I have felt...
Norde: No... We have objectively found ourselves passing 
through more populated areas than normal.
Satia: Right... We ARE new to most of these places.
Satia: Are you worried about the villages getting attacked 
because of us?

If so, we can just run away and pull the attacking 
forces away from the villages.
Norde: Even then...
Satia: Who would carry the mantlet? They are not small 
nor light.

We'd need more than one to provide a true 
defense, too.
Norde: Even... then...

passages.name: SP: Tatiana x Rowan C - Talk
passages.content:
Old Woman: T- Take it! Just take it and leave!
In an alleyway, an old woman's hand extended out.

It held a sparkling golden necklace with a beautiful 
ruby in its center.
A Bandit: Shit ain't a heirloom, is it?
A Bandit too: Yeah. Noble asses like you got that shit right?

Don't even think about trying to track us.
with your shitty magic!
The two men stood in the only path of retreat 
that the woman had. They were already holding 
a purse.
Old Woman: No magic! My damn brother got that thing...
A Bandit: Hmph.
He snatched the necklace from her.
A Bandit too: Nice doing business with you, then.
Slipping into a nearby abandoned building, the two 
bandits started to search through the purse they 
had also stolen.
A Bandit: Not bad.

Not bad at all...
A Bandit too: Think maybe she's got friends and-
A Bandit: Ack!
A metal hand burst through a nearby wall! 

It grabbed the man by his throat!
A Bandit too: What the fuck?!
A hollow voice echoed in the building.
Tatiana: Drop the crap and make yourself scarce.
A Bandit too: Who the fuck are you? The army?!
Tatiana: Don't make me say it twice.
A Bandit: D- D- Do what... it- it says...!
Both of the bandits dropped their loot.

Tatiana released her grip.
A Bandit: *Gasp*!

Run!
Like scared rats, the bandits scattered out of the 
building.
Tatiana: Perfect.
Not too long after, a crowd formed in the nearby 
street.
Soldier: On the ground! Hands where I can see them!
Old Woman: Y- Yes. Those were the men!
A Bandit: I swear! We don't got nothin'!
A set of eyes looked on the scene. They gazed 
from where the hushed whisper's of the crowd
resonated.
Tatiana: Heh. And you'll never get it back
Rowan: Mayhap that be the case.
Tatiana: ...!?
She jumped back a step in shock.
Tatiana: Oh, it's you...

Why are you here?
Rowan: I stake out the street corners on all the towns we 
visit. They are my stage, after all.
Tatiana: Okay... Sure. Whatever.
Tatiana started to turn away from the gathering.
Rowan: You don't need to do this, you know?
T

passages.name: SP: Charlotte x Mariel C - Talk
passages.content:
Charlotte: Hmph.
Charlotte fiddled with the gadget in her hand. The 
flickers of the firepit melded with the fire stained 
sky that curtained the scene.
Charlotte: What's the point of a mobile telegraph station if 
you can't handle the magic input?

If I could get this to work, we wouldn't have to 
rely on carriers and... and...
Charlotte: Argh! Dammit...
Charlotte: They really had the gall to claim the development 
of this was finished.
Charlotte, without looking, turned and reached 
towards a small work surface she had setup 
nearby.
Charlotte: Maybe... the energy storage needs to be 
expanded?

Maybe it... it...
Charlotte: ...it...?
Charlotte's head turned as the item she reached 
for didn't slide into her hand.
Charlotte: The power cell was definitely there.
Charlotte turned on her firepit adjacent seat and 
towards the camp around her.

It was mostly empty after people hustled to get 
some rest after a recent battle.
Pup: Here. This remedy typically helps with burns and 
blood loss.
Though, there was one set of people lined up 
directly in Charlotte's eyeline.
Charlotte: That one probably wouldn't be helpful...
The pair happened to be a pair of two.
The conversation included another.
Mariel: I didn't think you'd be able to get it so quickly.
Charlotte: Now her? She can probably help.
Mariel: Thank you. This is just what the doctor ordered.
Pup: My pleasure.
Charlotte stood up and stepped within earshot of 
the two.
Charlotte: Sis, would you happen to have seen-
Mariel: Oh, Charlotte. Good night to you, too!
Charlotte: ...happen to have seen... a power cell...?
With a tilt of the head, Charlotte watched as Mariel 
ducked into a nearby tent.
Charlotte: Hmm... What's she in a rush for?
Pup: You need something, too?
Charlotte: Maybe. You see where my power cell went?
Pup: A power what?
Charlotte: ...
Pup: I- If you lost something, then maybe you dropped 
it in that last fight?
Pup: It did just happen before we got back to camp.
Charlotte: Don't you have a stick to

passages.name: SP: Pup x Mariel B - Talk
passages.content:
Mariel: Next was... in the medical tent?
Mariel rounded a corner in the camp and 
a sight fell before her eyes.
Mariel: Is that...?
Pup: It's a matter of... morale...
Charlotte: Morale for who? You?
Pup: I'm among those counted, yes.
Pup: I don't think you want to do a thorough census on 
people who enjoy meat from our ranks.
Mariel: Is it... is it time?

Is Charlotte about to be confessed to?
Mariel ducked behind one of the larger nearby 
crates.
Mariel: What are they saying...?
She leaned a little forward, but it was to no avail.
Mariel: Mrrgrr...
After a short while of steaming in her frustrations, 
Mariel's hands rose.
Mariel: *Hand Puppets*
Left Hand: I wonder what they're up to?
Right Hand: It must be the awaited confession!
The hand opened and closed along with the words 
coming out of Mariel's mouth.
Mariel: *Clears throat*
Mariel: *Hand Puppets*
She looked on at the two and saw their mouths 
moving. She followed along with the seeming 
flow of their conversation.
"Charlotte": P- Pup? What brings you here?
"Pup": My dear Ms. Stewart...
"Pup": No. Charlotte, my dearest of all!
"Charlotte": Ah, you mustn't!
"Charlotte": I am a princess of Lockhart! And you are but a 
mercenary!
"Charlotte": Such a thing would be forbidden!
"Pup": Then... You know of my... my feelings?
"Charlotte": I can only speak of my idling speculation.
"Charlotte": But...

Should you say the words, then I might...
"Pup": Hush, my dearest. It is but words.

I will offer you no obligations of reciprocation.
"Pup": No worlds are left closed to you. It is... It is your 
decision to make.
"Pup": And more to say and extra words here because I 
am still talking.
"Charlotte": Pup... I...
"Pup": Charlotte. I love you.
"Charlotte": I love you too!
"Pup": *Kissing noises*
"Charlotte": *Kissing noises*
Mariel closed her eyes before giggling gleefully 
and softly to herself.
Mariel: I'm sure it'll go well.

Or went well, I suppose?
Pup: You're sure what went well?
Mariel: Ah!
She jumped back a step.
Pu

passages.name: SP: Tatiana x Rowan B - Talk
passages.content:
Villager: Really? Isn't that 6 pieces up from last week?
Merchant: What can I say? Market sways how the market 
sways.

Blame the cronies in Lockhart if you really need 
someone to throw shit at.
Villager: But apples went up last week too.

Now that I think on it, didn't they go up the week 
before that, too?
Merchant: Are you going to buy? I don't have time to explain 
market economics to every hick passing through.
The merchant said as he lazily slumped back 
into his chair.
Merchant: Or maybe go to another stall?
Villager: I did. They had the same price...
Merchant: And that, my dear simpleton, is supply and demand.

Instead of thanking me for my market low, 
generous prices, you complain and complain.
Villager: I- I only said one other stall had the same price. Not 
all of them.
Merchant: ...

And?
Villager: I- I'll... Guard!
The villager scampered up to a nearby guard.
Villager: Guard, uh, sir! I think the merchants are fixing their 
prices.
The guard turned towards the merchant.

He waved at him to leave and the guard nodded.
Villager: What are you...?
Footsteps met the villager's ears while the guard 
walked away.
Merchant: Now. I heard you needed some apples? Heheheh...
After locking up his stall for the today, the 
merchant started on his way home through a 
nearby alleyway.
Merchant: Another good day. Those villagers are getting 
annoying though.

Simple in the mind and simple in the pocketbook. 
They're not paying as much as they used to.
Tatiana: H- Hello, sir!
Merchant: Argh! You nearly have me a heart attack.
The merchant grabbed at the alley wall after 
jumping back from surprise.
Tatiana: Really? Have I got the product for you!
Tatiana: Wait, no... That comes later...
Merchant: Product? What are you on? Just head back to your 
parents, little girl.
Tatiana: ...
Tatiana: I am not a... "little girl"... I am a merchant like 
yourself.
Tatiana could hear a dull sound in her ear as she 
grinded her teeth through the smile.
Merchant: Hah! A failing merchan

passages.name: SP: Otis x Cainan C - Talk
passages.content:
Otis: Ye- e- e- e- eah, baby!

That meat carves so smoothly. You can see the 
blood shimmer~
Otis: Now this...
Otis: Now this is a meal!
The steam of the freshly carved meat wafted into 
the nostrils of a drooling Otis.

A knife stabbed into the ground, freshly bloodied 
by the act.
Otis: Ah~
Otis fell limp to the ground with meat and bottle in 
hand.
Otis: Meatier morsel than has ever met my mouth? Meet 
my beer and the sun!

What great company. Alas, such company calls for 
the perfect lunch.
He took a swig of the beer.
Otis: Ah...
Otis: ...

Perfect, eh? Maybe not quite? Somethin's a 
missing, I'd say.
Otis: What have we here?
Otis: You wouldn't happen to be on death's door, are 
you?
A face appeared in Otis's skyward eyeline. Cainan 
looked down on the limp body below.
Otis: Eh? You're blocking the sun.
Cainan: Then you are not in need of medical attention?

You have gone limp in the middle of a field. It is a 
natural inquiry, no?
Otis: Can’t a laddie-or-lassie eat a meal in the dirt without 
someone ass-uming they are lyin’ six lengths under 
it?
Cainan: Then you are in good spirits. That is good news.
Cainan: Might I recommend eating arrangements less... dirt
orientated?
Otis: Heh, a little dirt never hurt no one.
Cainan: If you say so.
Otis: Snarky little bastard, aren't you?

Really, what at this point could possibly do ol' Otis 
in?
Otis: Not even the damned demonic moon's curse could 
kill me!
Cainan: I imagine some individuals here doing well at such a 
task.
Otis: Hah! I've heard of stranger tides, yeah.

Would not even mind a cocky son-of-a-bitch coming 
over here and giving me a tussle!

Their blood could make a half decent condiment for 
my meal.
Cainan: You paint... quite a picture.
Otis: Hmm...

Matter-of-the-fact... stay right there and don't 
move a muscle.
Cainan: ...?
Otis raised his hands and made them into "L"s that 
formed a "frame" around Cainan.
Otis: Them's the look.
He took another drink as he shifted to a sitting 
position.
Otis: You'll

passages.name: SP: Nora x Jude c - Talk
passages.content:
A splurge of rice and meat landed on my plate.
Pup: Thanks.
It didn't look particularly appetizing.
Pup: (This slop again.)
Nora: I replaced a rice portion with some beans. Beans 
are an excellent food for those training.
Pup: (She... does well with the ingredients she works 
with.)
Nora: Next.
I walked away, but a shadow of orange got caught 
in the corner of my eye.

Turning back to look, I saw a plate with more of 
said orange than mine.
Nora: I replaced some rice with an extra vegetable 
serving.
Charlotte: Ugh... carrots? Really?
Nora: Eat a little and world might be a little more clear to 
you.
Nora: Anyways, you should stop avoiding them or your 
health will deteriorate.
Charlotte: ...
Nora: Next.
I turned my head back to see another person lining 
up for food.
Jude: Crap. She's cooking again...
Pup: It's not...
An ominous odor rose from my food.
Pup: It's not that bad...
Jude: You do recall I signed up with you guys specifically 
to get away from her cooking, right?
Pup: I- I'll let Charlotte know to expand your cuisine 
budget a little.
Jude: Dammit...
I sat down to eat, and Charlotte soon joined me.

Charlotte had started trying to separate the carrots 
from the rest, but the mix was too elaborate to do 
so effectively.

passages.content:

Charlotte: ...
She breathed in.

And out...

difference maker.

While I am gone, you will need to-
Footsteps interrupted her, and Mariel turned.

Charlotte: ...
Mariel: ...
Mariel turned back to the Lockhart based medic.

part to help each other thrive.

a difference every action you can take can be.

work.

her way to Mariel's side.

exit.

breathing.

They closed their eyes...
And took breaths slowly but surely.

In and out, preparing the self for the moment to 
come.

And... their eyes opened.
Mariel: It's that time.

Time to say goodbye.

creaked open.

The two sisters turned to each other and...

nostalgic.

shopping bags.

distraction of a beaming smile...

...

I collapsed against the alley wall with my 
exasperated exhale.

eyelids felt heavy.

I left them drift closed.

Flynn's words trailed off.

to Flynn.
Reagyn: I have. I think I would be an excellent heir to our
family's title.
Flynn: Oh...

Yeah, you have always been a natural at all this...
Reagyn: But I also cannot. I am not the heir. You are.

The choice was made long ago.
Flynn: I mean... If you really feel that way...

We could just do something to

passages.name: SP: PupxReagyn B - New Event
passages.content:
Pup: *Breathes in* ...
Pup: Ahhh........
The warmth of the sun shined down onto 
my relaxed visage.
Pup: Always nice to hear the birds chirping away under 
an inviting sun...

And along with that...
I held a piece of parchment up to that same sun.
Pup: ...I finished the count of ALL the mercenaries in 
camp now.

...
Pup: Finally... How is one person supposed to do this every
day, anyways?
Pup: But at least I can finally sit and relax...
I turned towards my tent.
And what met me was a set of judgmental eyes.
Reagyn: Hello, "leader"... Or was "Pup" the one that'd do?
Pup: Good, uh... afternoon, Reagyn.
Reagyn: I was hoping for a follow-up on my proposals.
Pup: Well... you see... I am busy since...
I looked around for who else was here.
Pup: Because... uh... Norde!
Norde: ...
Pup: Eh... I mean... Rowan!
Luckily for me, Rowan was passing by.
Pup: (At least one good thing came from counting everyone
here.)
Rowan: Fancy meeting you two ladies... or two... uh...

...well, meeting a Pup and a Reagyn, at least. 
Always a pleasure.
Rowan: Did you finish that task you were-
Pup: Actually, I was meaning to talk to you about that!
Pup: I have not finished and am busy with it, so can you
help me do it... right... over... far away from here.
Rowan: Ah... I see where this is going.
Rowan lowered his voice and whispered in my ear.
Rowan: Well, I have been feeling a bit... thirsty.

I hope you don't mind... sharing your "goods" with 
me for a week or so.
Pup: Rowan. I don't have any. I'm too young to-
Rowan: Ha! When has that ever stopped you?
Pup: ...Always.
Rowan: Exactly! Now, I expect it to be delivered to my tent by
midnight.
Pup: ...?!

(He's joking, right? Right?)
Rowan: And, but of course, such a task would take the WHOLE
day.
Rowan had swiftly shifted from whispers into 
something akin to someone projecting to an 
audience.
Rowan: The task includes such endeavors to keep one 
busy... doing... stuff. Manly stuff... and Pup stuff.
Pup: Really? That last part?
Reagyn: *Sigh* .

passages.name: SP: Pup x Charlotte A - Begining
passages.content:
I focused on the locket pinched between my fingers.
Pup: ...!
A curtain of crimson flames enveloped the dummy, 
then disappeared.
Pup: *Pant*...
Pup: *Exhale*...
Charlotte: I knew you'd eventually move on from pounding 
steel mindlessly.
Charlotte entered the training area with a 
smug grin.
Pup: Is "La Tornade" offering to help me refine my
technique?
Pup: Perhaps she could fan these flames with some of 
her legendary hot air?
Charlotte: ...
Pup: ...
Pup: Haha...
Charlotte: Hah... I see you've been doing your readings.
Charlotte: That line is similar to one of Sir Rangar's famous
retorts in that volume I recommended.
Pup: Huh? Really? 

I guess I just internalized that one into my
repertoire without realizing?
Charlotte: Trisyllabic words? Who are you and what have you 
done with Pup!?
My heart fluttered with humor and one other 
tingling feeling I couldn't quite identify.
Pup: Yeah. Sometimes I don't even recognize myself in 
the mirror.
Charlotte: ...Well... Speaking of changes, would you mind 
speaking privately in your tent?
Charlotte: Wow, you've really started to build up a collection of
books.
Charlotte: It suits you.
Charlotte glanced around at my small collection of
half-open tomes and scribbled notes.
Pup: Well, we can only carry so much once we move.
I picked up a loose book and put it on a small pile.
Pup: So what did you want to see me for? Another mutual
lesson?
Charlotte: No, actually. It's more of a personal matter.
I breathed a sigh of relief.
Pup: I'm glad. You've grown beyond my meager tutelage.
Charlotte: Likewise. Which leads me to my next point: I need 
some replacement parts for my revolver.
Charlotte: It's a prototype weapon, so the parts are hard to 
come by. Especially if I want to avoid getting undue
attention.
Pup: If you want extra muscle for a back alley deal, then...

passages.name: SP: Pup x Reagyn A - Begining
passages.content:
Reagyn: ...and you just have to shove that thing there...
Reagyn: Is there a problem? It's not about force, it's about
technique.
Reagyn: Come on, let me show you how it's done.
Reagyn gently moved my hands in a rhythmic 
pattern. I noticed an elegance to the motion.
The pen she guided in my hand moved like a 
dancer on a ballroom floor.
Graceful, no hesitation, no error.
Reagyn: And if you follow this specific pattern you will be
able to shave some seconds on each signature.

Trust me, these few seconds will accumulate to 
minutes or sometimes hours in the long run.

I looked towards the written words...
"...or your family line may end unceremoniously 
rather than flourish alongside ours."
Pup: ...
Reagyn: Hm...?
Pup: It's... graceful.
Reagyn: ...

Indeed. One must show respect and decorum.

And they must show that respect to their 
adversaries and, more importantly, to their 
own kin.
Reagyn: If one's noble leader cannot act with such 
confidence in their purpose, then how can one 
expect the people you lead to follow suit?
Pup: Yeah, I... I guess that makes sense.
Pup: (Reagyn really knows the theory on this all inside 
and out.)
Reagyn: Why don't you give it a try? This time you can do it 
by yourself.
I grabbed the pen, carefully dipped it into the ink 
and carefully moved it onto the paper.
Reagyn: ...
I carefully looked at Reagyn for approval.
I knew that if I took too long or made a mistake,
Reagyn would end up covering for me and do the 
whole thing without my input.
Pup: (I don't really wanna do this... but I do feel like I
should try.)
However...
*Splat*
Pup: ...?! No...
In a moment of hesitation, my nervous twitch 
knocked over the inkwell.
Reagyn: Quick! Pup, grab those cloths! We got to clean 
this spat of ink before it bleeds to other 
parchments!
Pup: *Exhale* ...
Pup: I think... only one piece of paper got ruined?
Reagyn: Luckily so...
Reagyn: Pup, why don't you go ahead and finish the other 
task? The one in the ar

passages.name: SP: Tatiana x Jakson C - Story
passages.content:
Tatiana: Ah... what a long battle.
Tatiana emptied her backpack, leaving a pile of 
armor sitting on a ground cloth.
Tatiana: Should make sure none of these are too banged 
up, then...?
Tatiana: *YAWN*

Eh... It's fine. Probably... I'll just...
She slumped with weary eyes that were becoming 
more difficult to keep open.
Tatiana: ...just take a...

...little...

...nap...
.........
Tatiana: ...?!?!
Tatiana: Wha' was...? Where am.. I...?
She blinked a few times.
Tatiana: Oh right... 

*Yawn*

...my armor.
With a few more blinks, her awakening mind forced 
her neck to creak her head towards the left.
Tatiana: ...
Tatiana: What the...?!
From her armor set, the cuirass and leg-guards 
were missing.
Tatiana: T- Thieves...?
A few angrier blinks directed her attention to 
nearby the incomplete armor set.
Tatiana: Footprints?

...

...Amateurs.
The footprints, while aged and indistinct, led her to 
a bonfire where Nightless Crows were carousing 
loudly.
Crow: Heresh to our victoreh! ... *hic* ...
The Crow toasted a mug of beer, nearly spilling the
contents.
Tatiana: All right, you drunken louts. Which one of you stole 
my armor?
Crow: Eh...?
Tatiana: Of for the fuckin' Goddess's sake... Why are you 
not even wearing shoes?!
The group of drunken Crows burst forth in laughs 
and snickers.
Tatiana: Is your imminent demise really that funny?
Other Crow: Should we tell 'er?
Tatiana: ...
Her stare was accompanied by the foreboding 
sound of cracking knuckles.
Tatiana: Five... four... three...
Crow: Aight! I'll tell ya...

'Tis the same feller that... *hic* ... nipped me 
shoes.

'Sides, we aint havin' enough legs to make off with 
yer armor... hehe...
Tatiana: Legs? Are you actually making a pass at me right now?
The Crow flailed about in a poor attempt to what
appeared to be a shrug.
And the remaining Crows burst into laughter around
them.
Tatiana: You're lucky I'm too busy catching a thief to teach 
you dogs a lesson.
Tatiana glared at them before walking off.
Crow: Ah, wait...

asking is excessive.

My bulk purchase business.

Norde: ...

passages.content:
So the sun hit its apex.
The beat of the Goddess's light shone down upon 
her realm.
The oppressive aura of the day fed into the daily 
lives of all those around.
After all, the agreed upon time had come.
This would be a day that lived in the shadows of 
fame and infamy.
It would be a decisive day for two nations and the
world around them.
Shadows blanketed the inside of the tent.
A sole table sat within the dim light at its center.
Feminine Voice?: So you're ready?
Masculine Voice?: Indeed I am.
One of the voices stepped from the shadows.
Charlotte: You better take this seriously.
She was flanked by two people, dressed in 
traditional Lockhart military garb.
Rowan: I will do my utmost.
He was also flanked by two people. They were 
dressed in Imperial military styles.

Charlotte: Hmm...
Charlotte was hesitant, but she soon took her seat.
Rowan soon followed her lead and sat across 
from her.

As for the why...

Beyond the conflict we are embroiled within, we 
both seek the empire's withdraw from Lockhart.

This meeting is meant to establish expectations and
initial plans for a post-conflict world for the both of
us.
Do you agree to this goal, with we as 
representatives of Nolvanus and Lockhart?
Charlotte: Mmm...
The room was met with silence as Rowan sat 
waiting for her to confirm.
Charlotte: Calling yourself a representative of the empire is a
bit...
She glared harder at Rowan.
Rowan: Then... what would manifest your trust in that
sentiment?
Charlotte: Do the shit you're claiming to want to do.
Rowan: Perfect.

empire.

Something I've already the motivation to do.

our two great states of people?

passages.content:

In a cozy corner of the encampment, Castel
flipped through an academic text.
Castel: Hmm... but then I would have to shift that to, 
wait... that won't work...
Castel: Hmm...

If my hypothesis is correct, that may be a good first
step.
Castel: Could the curse stabilize long enough to apply a
procedure properly?
Castel: ...
Castel leaned back in his seat.
Castel: Wait... that's it...?!

(Such tender and plump meat. I wonder what the 
chickens in the area eat?)
I looked over to the cook tent's interior to see who
was tasked with it today.
Pup: (I wonder if they know how they got the meat this
tender?)
As I was about to get up to ask...
Castel: Pup. I need you to undress and follow me.
Pup: ...
I stopped chewing.
I blinked back at the person that had suddenly 
appeared in front of me, but the distraction from 
the meat didn't go away.
So I started chewing again.
Pup: Insh… thash order?
I could barely talk with my mouth full of chicken.
Pup: *Gulp*
Castel: Order? Order is irrelevant.
Castel: Though, undressing as we travel could save time...
Pup: ...
Pup: W- What about I follow you... THEN I undress...?
Castel: If you must, but do please not dawdle, then.
I stood up, but Castel noticed something I was
carrying.
Castel: Are you... bringing the chicken into the lab?
Pup: ...
I looked at the "lab" and saw a tent.
Pup: Ywou mhen da tent?
I talked while munching on another piece 
of chicken.
Castel: Whatever you wish to call it, it is unhygienic to 
bring half eaten food into a place of research.
Pup: Aww...
Pup: Uh... Let me just... What to do with it...?
Jakson: *Hungrily licks lips* ...
I had just entered the lab's door, but Castel 
stopped me before I could.
Castel: Clothes off.
Pup: Ah...
While I hesitated for a second, the next few 
seconds after that were spent staring at Castel.
Castel: ...
Pup: (It'll... probably... be fine...?)
Pup: ...
Castel: ...
Pup: *Sigh*...

passages.content:
Tatiana: Hmm?
Tatiana leaned down with her eyes on her pants.
Tatiana: A... hole? 

Dammit.
She shuffled along across the camp.
Tatiana: Oi. Doily girl. We got any thread and needle sets in
that stash back there?
Mariel: Oh, Tatiana...? You mean for that hole in your 
pants? That might be hard to get done.
Mariel: Thread is good for stitching wounds when blue 
magic isn't plentiful, after all.
Mariel: We've gone through so much in our recent 
battles... could you perhaps find another source?
Tatiana: Oi. Crow friend. We got any thread and needle sets

the recent battles.

Thread is good for stitching wounds when blue 
magic ain't plentiful, after all.

You'll have to supply your own unless it's an
emergency.
Tatiana: Tsk. That's my luck, alright...
Tatiana: If that changes, let me know, 'kay?
As Tatiana began to walk off, a head popped 
around the corner.
One that overheard the conversation.
Satia: Oh? Hello, Tatiana... You were looking for thread?
Tatiana: Ai. My trousers finally ripped, so I need to close up
the hole in it.
Tatiana: A few threads and a minute of work and it'd be 
done, but supplies are low.
Satia: Well, if that's all, then I have a patch and bobby 
pins that you can have.

It won't be as stable as proper needlework, but it
should last until we can get more thread.
Tatiana: A patch can work. Where'd you have it?
Satia: Back at my quarters. Just follow me~
Satia turned, beckoning Tatiana to follow.
The two entered Satia's personal tent.
Satia: One moment.
Satia moved to her bag.
Rifling through it for a moment, she pulled out the
patch.
Satia: Here it is~
Tatiana: Thanks, that should-

Tatiana looked closer at it. It had a flowery design.
Specifically, it was a Peony patch. 
Prominently purple, too.
Tatiana: ...
Satia: Is something wrong?
Tatiana: It's... not... really my style.

Ya know... fancy flower patterns might give off the
wrong impression..

make it true! Eucrasia!

The cold air surrounding a piece of raw rat meat

Castel: Oh Goddess... may the light guide my magic and

The frozen piece of meat began to thaw, but as it 
did so, it began to crumble.
It fell apart into meat crystals, and those
transitioned to bloody game meat once 
more after the magic faded.
Castel: Tsk... Even if I reverse the order... the results are

Castel: Therefore it might be safe to discard the order as a
variable.

But if that is not it... then what could it be? Maybe
in Experiment 119, I can-
Castel: .........
Castel looked down into an empty bucket, now filled
with game meat blood instead of any usable meat.
Castel: I need to go to the provisions tent again.

Inefficient waste of time, but I can hypothesize 
while walking...
Castel hoisted his empty bucket and started 
walking towards the cafeteria.
Castel: There are no spells that will transform me, especially
permanently, to my original form.
Castel: Weaving multiple spells together should be a faster 
way of reaching the wanted result...

Perhaps with shorter and safer spells...?
Over crafting a new spell to make it quicker.
The bucket clattered around, creating a 
contrasting sight between the elegant 
shade and the bloodied metal.

failure...

due to it.
Charlotte had slowly worn me down to take care 
of myself a bit more...

Uncomfortable as bras could be, that sensation of

And so, Castel nonchalantly opened the door to 
the changing room, and I caught my breath.
Castel: Hmmm...? Unwarranted reaction, I feel.
Castel mentioned as much after a brief glance at 
both of our bodies.
Pup: Castel, how many times have I told you to knock 
on the door!?
Castel: 13 times, with this time, it would be 14.
Castel: Are you experimenting with something? It isn't as
though we aren't both female at this point.

someone seeing my naked body...

Or at least, after the last time... Charlotte lectured
me... so... so much...
Castel: Noted.
Castel: Anyway, I have come to the realization about our
experiments so far-
Pup: Castel. Still naked.

Pup: Out.
I shouted as I pushed Castel out the door with a 
hip check, due to my preoccupied hands.
*Slam*...!
Castel: ...
Shut out of the room, Castel touched his own 
breasts.

allow that comfortability...

Pup: Hmm...

*Thump*

.........

...

Ya with da police? What about the deal we
