Another Bandit: You're right on that boss.
Echoing Voice: A... show of force, you say?
Bandit: Are ya deaf? A show of force, I said.
Another Bandit: Yeah, a show of force he sa-

Gwahh...!
From the cover of the night, a hulking cluster of 
metal showed itself and quietly rushed the bandit 
into the dark of unconsciousness.
Then, as quickly as it appeared, it dipped into 
another shadow cast by the moon.
Bandit: Heh..?! Where did...

...

Show er'self, I say!

Ya with da police? What about the deal we 
struck?!
*Clink*... 

...*clink ... 

......*clink*......
.........
Slowly, the cluster of metal revealed itself to be a
person in plated armor, glistening with the light of
the moon.
Bandit: You er'... you er' the Armored Bandit, you er'...

You er' a bandit... just like us, you er'!
Bandit: GHAAA...!

Ya... knocked me out... ya did...
The glistening armored unit punched the bandit 
in his gut hard enough to knock him out for 
several hours.
And with that, it turned its head to the scene.
The armored unit took the stolen goods and put 
the sack over its shoulder.
Tatiana: I am not like you.

You stole from an old innocent woman to give to
yourself.

While I steal from corrupt nobles and their lackies to
give to the normal folk.
*Knock Knock*
The door opened.
Old Lady: Huh...?
She saw a sight illuminated by the candlelight from
within her home, and it showed a coin purse on 
her front porch.
Old Lady: This... purse...? I thought the bandits had taken it.
Tatiana: There we go...
She stretched out as she allowed herself to relax.
Tatiana: Mmm... Ah~

That should take care of those bandits. Hopefully, 
they never steal again.
Tatiana: Another win goes to THE Armored Bandit!
El

passages.name: SP-Kara x Charlotte C - New Event
passages.content:
Kara ate across from Charlotte, her attire and poise
with regality not befitting the simple camp chair.
In contrast, Charlotte had a more shabby look 
about her.
Charlotte: I honestly didn't expect to see you again after I
graduated from Theodal.
Kara: A good surprise, I hope?
Charlotte: Yes! You always seemed so unapproachable there, 
but now that I'm an alumni, too...
Charlotte: ...I'm not so easily intimidated. I'd like to get to
know you better.
Kara: Of course. I look forward to it much the same.
Kara took a bite of her hard bread and salted pork,
chewed it, and put it down with a grimace.
Kara: Not exactly mansion food, is it?
Charlotte: Not so much.
Kara: I know of a delightful location in a nearby city
where we could acquire something better,
if you are so inclined?
My treat?
It was a market day, so they pushed through a 
crowd of townsfolk buying from the farmers.
The city smelled earthy and musky.
Kara: How are you adapting to life in a mercenary 
company? It must be a far cry from Lockhart's 
luxuries.
Charlotte: Eh. It's not as bad as what other nobles would 
have you believe.
Charlotte: In the end, it'll mean that I can lead all sorts, from
knights to mercenaries. No need to pamper me. All 
of you can rely on me.
Charlotte: Still... 

Yeah, the food has been the worst part.
They turned and hiked up a hill away from 
the river.
A breeze blew fresh air down the cobblestone street.
Kara: I'm glad to hear the trials of the road haven't been
too harsh. Is it tough for you, being away from
Lockhart?
Charlotte: I've been away from Lockhart before.
Charlotte: Am I so forgettable that you don't remember where we
met?
Kara: Of course not.
Kara: Simply... it's one thing to be away from home and 
know you can go back, another to know you 
cannot return.
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte: I'm taking Lockhart back.
Kara: I understand, but...
Charlotte: Oh, we're here.
Kara introduced them to the hostess, asked for 
a table, and they waited off to the side of 
the anteroom.
Ch

passages.name: SP-ReagynxCharlotte B - New Event
passages.content:
Reagyn: Due to our recent skirmish, we are down 27.2% of 
our supply of weapons.

If we want to be ready for our next encounter, we 
will need to supply the camp with 22 kg of iron, 10 
kg copper, 1100 grams of tin, and 60kg of wood...
...by a conservative calculation, at least.
Reagyn stepped further into the tent, flipping 
through the pages of a report.
Reagyn: Due to the state our weapons are at, I predict that
repairs will take two and a half weeks.

The number of skirmishes we are in outpace that, 
so we will need to rely on the local blacksmiths, or 
expedite the ones in camp.
Reagyn closed the report, and stood tall.
Reagyn: Furthermore, we-
Pup: Zzzzz....
Pup: ...!

W- What?
Pup: *Yawwwnnn*... Morning.
Reagyn: ...
Reagyn took a minute to take a breath and look 
around for the first time after entering the tent.
Expecting a full entourage of people, Reagyn had 
burst in dramatically and started explaining things.
However, the only person in the room was... me.
Reagyn: Pup... are you the only one in the room?
Pup: Eh...? Yeah... Why?
Reagyn: *Sigh*... I guess I can't really expect much outside
Her Majesty's courts...
I looked towards a magical time keeping device 
within the meeting tent.
Pup: Wait, isn't the meeting booked to start in 10 
minutes?
Reagyn: Correct, but arriving on time is the same thing as
arriving late.
Reagyn: You are on time... surprising, actually.
Pup: I'm just trying to avoid a repeat of last time.
Reagyn: ...

Then we are to not expecting anyone for another 
ten minutes, then.
Pup: Seems to be the case. Norde and everyone aren't 
always on time anyways.
Pup: So...
Pup: How was your day...?
Reagyn: If you don't mind, I believe I'll use those 10 
minutes to double check the math.
Pup: Oh... sure. That's a good thing to trust to you.
Pup: Well... back to my nap, I guess?
Reagyn: If we move... calculate that...
Charlotte: ...and we can-
Charlotte: Oh, you're already here.
Norde: As well as Pup, it seems.
Charlotte: Sort of figured we'd get

passages.name: SP-ReagynxCharlotte A - New Event
passages.content:
Charlotte: How dare you!
Off in the corner of the mess tent, there sat two
"noble" "ladies"... as one may call them.
Reagyn: *Sigh*... You are making a scene.
One of them was a redhead with a somewhat 
diplomatic and subdued attitude, hands crossed 
across a lap until an opening to speak arose.
Charlotte: Making a scene!? You are the one that called me a dirty
pig!
While on the other side of the table, there stood a
feisty blonde speaking with gusto aplenty.
Even though her voice was raised, and her 
emotions were rampant, her voice was smooth 
and eloquent.
Crow: They are at it again, aren't they?
Other Crow: Hopefully without a food fight this time...
And on the other side of the tent, stood two 
Crows tasked with preparing the food...
With hopes in their hearts...
...that it would be eaten. Not thrown.
A show. Via both its drama and its audience.
Crow: We are low on supplies as it is... And its those two
who have been managing the budget lately.
Other Crow: ...Hey, I bet you one gold Miss Charlotte starts it
this time.
Crow: Doesn't she always?
Reagyn: I did not say that!
Charlotte: I heard you. Loud and clear.
Reagyn: I said...!
Reagyn: *Sigh*... forget it.
Charlotte: Then you admit it?
Reagyn: Not in the context you are imagining...
Out on the sidelines, there entered an extra to this
conflict.
Pup: Uh... did I miss something?
Crow: The usual.
Other Crow: Think they'll almost collapse the tent again? Chicken
bones can get some velocity when whipped fast.
Crow: Is the dog around to catch it like last time?
Crow: Man, we had to move quickly.
Pup: While you two are cooking again, too. You're not 
adding something to the sauce, are you?
Other Crow: By the Goddess, no. I've heard them argue in other
tents at night, too.
Charlotte: That's it...
As she said the words, her hand hovered over the
remaining chicken bone from her meal.
Other Crow: Here comes the money shot...!
Crow: I didn't make the bet.
Charlotte: I am...
Charlotte: ...leaving.
...and she left the mess t

passages.name: SP-Atticus x Tatiana B - New Event
passages.content:
Elliot: ...
Elliot stood there, hesitating a bit before the tent
flap.
Elliot: Excuse me, Castel? I received a message from 
you...
There were panicked sounds on the other side of 
the tent flap.
Castel: H- Hold on... for one moment... please...!
Elliot could hear a sound of shuffling, as though 
items were being hastily arranged.
Castel: And... perfect~
Elliot: ...
Castel: You may enter now.
Elliot pushed aside the tent flap, only to see...
Elliot: ...

Forgive me sir, but I don't understand what is
happening here.
There was a table set for two, with the rations of 
the day on them.
Castel: When we last spoke on the subject, I alluded to 
the possibility of discussing your... heirloom 
situation...
...over dinner.
Castel: Well, this is that opportunity.
Elliot: I see.
Elliot: Far be it for me to refuse such a gracious invitation.
Castel: Ah, your heirloom?
Castel looked at Elliot's body. 
The current form of it.
Elliot: Right. Our arrangement. Apologies.
There was a flash of light.
Elliot: As agreed.
Castel: That'll be much more conducive to studying it, 
thank you.
Without additional delay, the two sat at the table.
Castel: I hope you enjoy the libations. I find it difficult to
think on an empty stomach.
Elliot: I feel much the same.
Elliot: Though... the wine?
Castel: Ah, well... alcohol... s- stimulates the brain. It is
an established scientific fact.
Elliot: And the candles?
Castel: Well, how else does one expect to read, if they do 
not have adequate lighting?
Elliot seemed content with the answer. 

He went to take an initial bite of the food... 
only to pause...
Elliot: What of the rose petals?
Castel: That is just, eh... an effort of mine to counteract 
the smell of horses and sweat.
Castel: Mercenary camps can be so dirty, can't they?
A statement met by Elliot sniffing the air.
Elliot: But... they do not keep the horses on this side of
camp.
Elliot: And today is a rest day on the training schedule. 
Not even Pup is about.
Castel: Old habits... die hard...?

passages.name: SP-Atticus x Tatiana B - New Event
passages.content:
Atticus: ...
The old Guardian was making his rounds around 
the busy town as part of the Crows' journey 
across the lands.
Atticus: Let's see...
He peeked down at the list in his hands,
refamiliarizing himself with the goals of his 
mission.
Supplies, and some recon were the order of 
the day.
A good ways behind him was a light footed woman.
Tatiana: This should be a good distance to stay out of sight.
She whispered it to herself as she peeked around a
corner.
The young einlyn continued to whisper to herself 
as she tailed the old guardian.
Tatiana: Let's see what you're up to, old man, now that the
others' aren't around to keep an eye on you.
As she moved, she blended into crowds and 
jumped between various stalls, objects, and 
walls to keep herself out of line of sight.
All the while...
Atticus: ...
...keeping an eye on her target.
Shopkeep: Thank ya.
Atticus: No, I must thank you.
As the minutes turned to an hour, Atticus only 
seemed to perform the tasks given to him.
Tatiana: Really? He's truly just dutifully handling the list of
stuff?
Tatiana: *Sigh*... Maybe he's just used to following orders.
Like from the nobles he sold out to...
......
Tatiana: Wait...
It seemed that way... until the einlyn saw him start 
to go off the beaten path of his supposed task list.
She continued to track him, from an offshoot of 
the main market street, to the edges of the 
residential district...
...all the way into the doors of a comfy looking
bakery.
Tatiana: Interesting...
It wasn't long before he emerged back onto the 
street, the last of his free arm space full of 
aromatic freshly baked goods.
From there, still, he headed towards the outskirts 
of the town.
He came to a large cottage on the edge of the 
town's fields.
A number of children ran about, with some noticing 
as he approached the open door.
Director: Is that... you, Atticus?
Atticus: In the flesh.
Director: In a sense...

I heard you were making a living being as sturdy as
stone but...
He stared on with a nostal

passages.name: SP- CharlottexElliot C - New Event
passages.content:
Charlotte: Hmm...
As I approached the tent, I could hear a sound I 
didn't recognize.
Charlotte: ...

Hmmmmm...
Pup: Hm?
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte: HMMMM......!!!
Pup: C- Charlotte?
I stepped into the tent, only to find Charlotte in
front of a planning board.
They were boards that we setup to map out 
strategies or organize impending plans.
Charlotte: JonesBakerBellDaviesBrown...
Charlotte was staring intensely at it, mumbling
something.
Pup: You... okay...?
Charlotte: TaylorSmithJohnsonEvansHughes
Pup: (It's like... she's speaking another language...)
I took a step back towards the tent opening.
Pup: If you need anything... just... let me know...
And I left Charlotte to her devices.
Charlotte: ...

ARGGHHH!!!

How do you even do this without any of these 
guys on board?! Stupid oligarchies!
Charlotte threw her hands up, knocking the 
documents on the board off.
And also hitting...
Elliot: ...?
Elliot stumbled back after being hit in the face by
Charlotte's motion.
Charlotte: Oh... I'm sorry!
Elliot: It's... okay.
Elliot blinked a few times, shaking away the sting.
Elliot: Is something wrong?
Charlotte: Ah, nothing much.
Charlotte: ...Nothing that isn't of my own making 
at least.
Elliot: You were saying names before, right?
Elliot: Some of them sounded familiar. Are they from Lockhart?
Charlotte: Recognize them?
Elliot: Yes. Rare for them to come up, but they are 
distinct family names from that region, and I've 
seen them in the work I've helped audit before.
Charlotte: That'd make sense. They're merchants.
Charlotte: Specifically, ones that hold a grip over specific
industries in Lockhart.
Elliot: Your talk of "oligarchy" of the city?
Elliot: ...or was that rude?
Charlotte: Nah, we know the deal.
Charlotte: Speaking of which, I should clean them up here, too...
Charlotte leaned down, picking up the small stack 
of notes that was knocked off the board from 
before.
Elliot: Here, I can...
And so Elliot followed and grabbed a few of the 
sheets of paper himself.
Elli

passages.name: SP- CharlottexElliot B - New Event
passages.content:
Elliot: ...and of course, the movement didn't end there in 
that revolution.
Charlotte: I never realized there was such a cultural shift
underwriting that.
Charlotte and Elliot were walking around the camp.
Lunch had been served, so the two moved 
together towards the line.
Charlotte: Huh...?
They reached that line and it proved to be 
particularly long today.
It extended out the camp's entryway.
Elliot: Even the traveling merchants are closer to the 
camp than us...
Charlotte: *Sigh*... It'll be what it is.
Charlotte: Maybe we can continue our conversation as we 
wait?
Elliot: I'd like that.
The two had become regular partners in such
revolutionary discussions.
Elliot's intrigue into myth and his Covenant 
education left him well equipped to have them.
And Charlotte's own experiences in government 
created a curious mind on such a topic. One she 
only served to gain from.
Elliot: From my understanding, Cartenan was the first to 
rise up against the Emerald Empire.
Charlotte: I guess it would've been easier when they had that
Oathbreaker to control the weather.
Elliot: The story goes that the revolution was led by an
uncorrupted soul.
Charlotte: Yeah... One of those they say are sent by the 
Goddess to lead humanity in times of strife...
Elliot: One with no Oath to break, yes.
Charlotte: You think it was just a story?
Elliot: Well...
Charlotte: Why else would they have kept it a secret?
Elliot: Perhaps a better question for Lady Kara. I am not 
one to question the Covenant's teachings.
Charlotte: Ah, I can get that. Given your position.
The line continued on, and the two began to pass 
a merchant group.
Charlotte: Hm?
Crow: Sir, I can't just-
City Planner: You can, and you will!
Crow: S- sir...
City Planner: Well, then I'll just have to-!
The man stepped forward towards the Crow like he 
was about to strike.
Elliot: ...!
Elliot: ...!
City Planner: Argh!
The man fell to the ground as Elliot's nimble moves
took him down, pinning and immobilizing him.
Elliot: Calm down

passages.name: SP- RowanxFlynn B - New Event
passages.content:
Flynn: ...
Flynn found Rowan leaning against a supply wagon.

It was brought up from the village, and 
Rowan was idly tuning his lute.
In a short time, they would be loading it. So, the
laborers were gathering with Rowan and Flynn 
a part of their numbers.
Flynn: Rowan. Can I talk to you for a second?
Despite the chaos of the surrounding camp, Rowan 
seemed entirely in his own world.
He plucked soft notes that somehow rose above 
the din of barking orders and clanging steel.
Rowan: Flynn! Of course, my friend.

I was just practicing a new tune to soothe your 
weary soul.
Flynn: That's... actually what I wanted to talk about.

Could you... if it wouldn't be too much to ask... 
stop playing music for me?
Rowan: Stop?
Rowan tilted his head, his fingers halting mid-strum.
Rowan: Might I ask why?
Flynn: I know you're trying to help me...
Flynn: And I really do appreciate the effort.
Flynn: But... it's a little, err... embarrassing to have
you... s- serenading me whenever we hang out.
Rowan lowered his lute, his expression falling as he
gave Flynn an acknowledging nod.
Rowan: My deepest apologies, Flynn. I never meant to 
offend.
Flynn: H- Hey, I wouldn't go as far as to say you offended 
me!
Flynn: It's just... Well, I'm not sure how to explain it in
words.

Excessive maybe?
Rowan: I might have gotten caught up in the drama of 
playing musician to your troubles.
Rowan: Mayhap... like minstrels do for the kings and queens 
at court?
Rowan: Indeed, I simply have-
Rowan: Ah, no... I get ahead of myself again.

If my melodies are unwelcome, then I shall withhold
them.
Flynn: R- Rowan, I... didn't...
A bit flustered, Flynn took a seat on a nearby sack.
Flynn: I...

Mmm...
Starting and stopping a few times, Flynn tried to 
find the words to console a friend.
But Flynn got there, and calmly started again.
Flynn: Rowan... you've been to a lot of places in your
travels, right?

Is it common to have minstrels on hand to... 
"soothe the souls of troubled rulers"?
Rowan: Hm? Oh cert

passages.name: SP-Pup x Mariel A - New Event
passages.content:
Footsteps blistered through the blades along the
ground.
Each blade of grass crinkled under the feet of the
passionate stride.
And as the steps rose to their horizon, so did their
view of the setting sun.
Mariel: And... here... it... is!
Mariel jumped with joy as she reached the peak of 
the local mountain.
Mariel: *Inhale*...  *Exhale*...
The crisp air was a relief as she took in the sight of
the sunset before her.
Mariel: Yeah... This'd work well.

Sis and Pup would love this place for a date.
Pup: For a... what?
Mariel: Ah...?!
Mariel jumped back a little, startled by my own
arrival.
Mariel: H- Hello...
Pup: Hm?
I turned to the sunset myself.
Pup: Wow... That's a sight.
Pup: I didn't expect to see that here of all places. We
picked a good place to camp this time.
Mariel: I know, right? It's so pretty.

The sort of place where memories are made~
Pup: Yeah...
I looked between Mariel and the sunset.
I did indeed feel a memory forming.
Mariel: We're not gonna be camping here forever, so... no 
time to waste.
Pup: Hm...?
Mariel: First things first.
Mariel: How'd it go...!?
Pup: How did... what go?
Mariel: You know? With Sis?
Pup: ...
Pup: (With Charlotte? I guess there was that inventory 
thing a while back.)
Pup: (Or the training thing...)
Pup: (Or the...!)
So many memories passed through my mind over 
the course of our journey.
Memories of... lots of meetings... and lots of 
requests and questions we never actually 
followed up on.
Pup: (So... much... unfinished... business...!)
Mariel: T- That bad...?
As I short circuited from a lifetime of small regrets
packed into one convenient journey...
...Mariel turned to the side, away from 
my prying ears.
Mariel: So the confession really went that poorly...?

I guess it is Sis... and... Pup... 
Awkwardness was a given...

But what to do now?
Mariel: Well, awkward doesn't mean she said no? How 
could either of them say no this far in...?!
Mariel spun back towards me.
Pup: I never... ordered... that new... training sword
set

passages.name: SP - Pup x Norde A - New Event
passages.content:
Norde: *Pant*... *pant*...
Pup: *Pant*... *pant*...
Crow: Heh.
Other Crow: Backed into a corner, eh?
Crow: More like backed into a back.
Norde: ...
Pup: (They're not wrong...)
I peeked behind me to see Norde there.
We had, in fact, both retreated and found 
ourselves back to back and on the defensive.
Pup: You assume this isn't part of my strategy.
Flicking my sword up, I pointed it at the Crow 
that I was training with.
Pup: (Not that I'm actually faring that well.)
Norde: ...
Pup: (Norde isn't exactly doing so well either...)
Norde had been training with the other Crow.
I didn't get to observe since I was also sparring, 
but what little I saw seemed rough.
Slow reactions and just being a step behind...
Pup: (Maybe more importantly...)
Norde: ...!
Pup: (...Norde never said anything to me.)
Crow: C'mon little pup, you can do better than that.
Pup: You won't be saying that after I've won your dinner.
Crow: (Dammit! Again.)
I stepped back, trying to regain my balance 
as I did.
Pup: (He keeps doing that stutter step... I feel like I
normally read those well, but this time...)
Pup: ...

(Normally Norde would...)
Me eyes peeked to my side.
Norde: Rrragh...!
Other Crow: Haha! Fuck, that was actually close to my head.
Norde: Stay focused.
Other Crow: Really? Sure that's the quip you want to end this on?
Norde: ...End this on?
Other Crow: Heh.
Norde: ...
Norde's weapon had flown up, landing well away 
from the two training combatants.
Other Crow: Heh. First time for everything.

I win.
Norde: ...
Pup: (Norde...?)
Crow: Stay focused!
He lunged towards me.
Pup: ...!
And with that...
...we tied.
Pup: *Sigh*... I'm starved.
All four of us re-entered camp under the 
setting sun.
Crow: So I got that extra dinner I won, yeah? Wanna 
trade me some of your stash of jerky for half of it?
Other Crow: I guess... I am pretty hungry today.
Crow: Really?! I can trade the entire thing.
Other Crow: This is all assuming that they'll believe either of us
actually beat Norde.
The two chuckled

passages.name: SP-Rowan x Charlott A - New Event
passages.content:
It was a windy day.
The mountains of Cartenan and Nolvanus looked 
down and into the distance.
Onto a simple camp out and down below.
A simple day within the Nightless Crows camp.
With Crows themselves lined up to eat.
A steaming soup to coax the hungry men and 
women to the call of lunch...
Crow: ...think they got some of that high grade beef for 
the stew this time?
Other Crow: Hmm... *Sniff*...  *sniff*...

Nah, smells like chicken.
Crow: Really? Must have some nice spices this time cause 
that ain't a smell I remember.
Other Crow: Could be worse.
Crow: Mmm... *Stomach growls*...
Other Crow: ...or you could just be hungry.
Crow: ...maybe...
Other Crow: *Sigh*... We've not been able to get much high 
quality stuff since Lockhart got invaded.

Not like trade from the east is prosperous either,
given the constant war the Empire and Republic 
have got going.
Crow: What I'd give to get a t-bone steak sometime 
soon...

Heh, though maybe all we needed to do was help 
liberate Lockhart all proper like.

No more military occupation now, so the food 
flows~
Other Crow: Maybe..

Or... also maybe...

...those two...
Charlotte: ...
Rowan: ...
Other Crow: Who knows with those two?
Crow: You mean... cuz they keep fightin'?
Other Crow: More that it seems to be getting worse... They're 
more at each other's throats than ever.

And now that we actually revolutionized ol' 
Lockhart...

Those two are in line to influence what the Empire 
and Lockhart will be in the future yeah?
Crow: Argh... You're right...

...I just want my beef...
Other Crow: Well... W-
The Crows felt an ominous feeling wrap around 
their shoulders.
Rowan: Ye of little faith. You will have your beef, my good
man.
Crow: R- Really?!
Other Crow: How much of that did you hear?
Rowan: Do not fret.
Rowan: Dear Charlotte and I are not at such dire odds. It
is... more...
Rowan: Yes, it is more like when we were in school.

Like the two lovebirds of a schoolyard, performing 
an awkward courting dance~
Crow: Wait... reall

passages.name: SP- JenxEvexMacy C - New Event
passages.content:
Jenny: Mmmgghhh...
Macy: Hmm...?
Eve: Uuuugggnnnhhh...
Macy: Hmmm.
Jenny: Hrrrgghh...
Macy: Almost there...

Hold on a second...

Hrrrn!
Eve: I... can't hold on any longer!
Jenny: Aaahhh!
As two others were trying to clean a high shelf...
...a lonely redhead "priestess" was lying down on a
couch, trying to read a book to no avail.
Jenny: I'm so BORED!!!
Macy: O- Ouch...
Eve: H- Hey...

You're... kinda... heavy...!
Besides the bored priest, a maid and a farmer were 
down on the floor after an unsuccessful attempt at 
cleaning noted high shelf.
The modest-sized maid weighed upon the farmer's
existing... plateau.
Macy: You know, this would be easier if you helped us...
Macy said the words carefully, as she raised herself
from the floor.
Eve: Let her rest.
Eve followed, returning herself to her feet after the
stumble.
Eve: I am sure she is tired of doing... whatever she has
been doing... right?
Macy: What are you doing... exactly?
Jenny: I am trying to see if there are any good stories.
Jenny: Where are the stories of dragons and knights? Of
wizards defeating evil demons?
Macy: Is that like... a bard thing in an age like this? Did
you ask Rowan for a song or two?
Jenny: Eww...
Jenny: Last time I tried, he started flirting with me.
Jenny: ...as if I were a girl...
Macy: Are you... not?
Jenny: L- Long story...
Eve: Haha... I've been there.
Jenny: Where I am from, stories about the past and future 
are abundant.
Jenny: Stories of spaceships, dragons, and even a few 
about dragons in space!
Eve: That sounds... familiar.
Jenny: Even still, we have this sort of... I guess you all
would call it a magic item?
Jenny: They're called video games. They show all sorts of
fantastic sights from fictional worlds.

You could even interact with them!
Macy: Wait... are you not from this world?
Jenny: N- No... why?
Macy: I also... came from another world.
Macy: Actually, we had something called video games 
there, too.
Eve: Me too! We had stuff called that in the world I was
born.
Macy: ..

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - Begining
passages.content:
...*Poke*

*Poke*

...

*Poke*
...

................

................................................
Pup: Mmh...

...?
Pup: (What's that feeling of-)
Pup: (...?!)
Gravity took me.
Pup: ...!
Pup: ...?
With a light collision, I had fallen on several pillows
instead of the hard floor.
Charlotte: Evening, sleepyhead.
Pup: Ugh... What happened to the table?
Charlotte: Everyone has a busy schedule these days.
Charlotte: Speaking of which, some of the others are headed 
out to resupply.

You've been volunteered to help.
Pup: I really rather not...
Charlotte: No one said you volunteered yourself.
Charlotte: Now go do something instead of burning away 
what time we have.
Pup: Like I said, I rather-
Pup: Urk?!
A light kick landed into the side of my stomach.
Charlotte: Do it.
As I acclimated to the waking world, Charlotte left 
with those words as her finale.
Pup: (Why does it end up like this again?)
Along with other members of our group, I 
begrudgingly took part in the purchase of food 
supplies we had run out of while on the run.
Satia: That's one less apple than we were aiming to get.
Pup: Blame the stupid merchant.
Satia: It was a compliment.

There's no reason to be mad about a compliment 
on your hair.
Pup: *Sigh*... As if you'd understand.
Pup: Tsk... stupid waste of an apple...

Call me a girl, though? I'll just...
We were carrying the supplies we could back from 
the stores.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - Mariel Alive
passages.content:
Mariel: I can see where you're coming from if you wanted 
to be more like your father.
Pup: It's just a matter of time and training.

I'll be like a true hero and...
Mariel: Oh, but how you are now could really do well as a 
model!
Pup: A... what?
Mariel: You don't know? I suppose they're probably not 
well known outside of Lockhart, are they?
Cainan: I don't even think they're well known 
within Lockhart, haha.
Mariel: What do you mean? People know about them at 
the academy?
Cainan: Were these noble friends of yours?
Mariel: Why would that matter?
Pup: Ah, that sort of stuff.
Cainan: Behind the curtains of gold, haha...
Mariel: I... don't get it?
Pup: Just a cultural barrier, I think.

What are these models, anyways?
Mariel: Simply put, they're people who get paid to look 
attractive. Using cameras and advertisements.

They can be like a spokesperson for a brand.
Pup: A spokesperson... a model... cameras... 
advertisements... Are these even real words?
Pup: But... more importantly... did you just say I was... 
attractive?
Mariel: I- I'm just saying not all girls are into guys that are 
more muscle than man.
Cainan: I can attest to that truth.
Pup: Sure. What sort of man are you into?
Cainan: Jests such as that would be more effective if there 
was an actual insecurity to poke at.
Pup: Hmph.
Mariel: My point is that you'd probably do well as a model.
Mariel: Without any body hair, you wouldn't even have to 
shave for it.
Pup: Shave for what?
Mariel: I think they use oils to accentuate the... 
definition... of...
Mariel: ...of stuff...
Pup: I don't want to be a model.
Mariel: You don't have to be. I just thought... you might 
be good at it...
Pup: I guess I can't deny that opinion. Especially for 
something I don't really get...
Mariel: It doesn't hurt that I got a look at you naked a few 
times...
Pup: Sorry?
Mariel: N- Nothing.
Pup: You people some days...

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - Mariel Died
passages.content:
Cainan: It is... an intriguing change you've gone through.

I would find it difficult to not give onlookers the 
benefit of the doubt.
Pup: I have no patience to deal with it constantly.
Cainan: You may be forced to.
Pup: Not if I have anything to say about it.
Cainan: Then be sure to keep your sleeves at full length.
Cainan: The glisten of your hairless arms does accentuate 
the impression.
I turned my head away and scoffed at his 
implication.

At the same time, I adjusted my grip on the 
supplies to let my sleeves fall to their full length as 
they rested on my arms.
Cainan: More importantly...
Cainan: I have not seen you prior to this stage. Have you 
lost much in the way of height?
Pup: Not a ton, but...
Cainan: Was your face and hair significantly more masculine 
before?
Pup: I mean, I...
Cainan: Have you ever, prior to these events, been 
mistaken in a similar manner?
Pup: ...
Pup: We're not talking about this.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - Continue
passages.content:
Some light laughter came about from that 
interaction, and I could only sigh in response.
Pup: The world can be so unfair, can't it, boy?
Jakson: *Confused whine*?
Pup: Not you, too...
Our path took us through the setting sun, and 
soon we found ourselves back at the inn we had 
stayed at.
As we did, I noticed a unique building across the 
street from it.
Pup: What's that?
Mariel: A library, I believe.
Cainan: One run by the Covenant, too.
Cainan: One of the libraries run by the Covenant.
Pup: So it's got lots of info on magic? Like... the 
Oathbreakers, maybe?
I started to step towards it.
Cainan: Apologies, but I cannot let you proceed.

I will direct your gaze to the sign on the door. The 
one saying "Closed for Renovations".
Pup: ...I guess you're right...
Cainan: Then shall we deliver this to the stockpile? After 
that a good rest before a long trek tomorrow.
Cainan: Before I head to my own lodging, I'd like to 
complete the delivery of your supplies, yes?
Pup: ...

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - Scene 2
passages.content:
Later in the night...
Pup: ...
The library stood before me in the quiet stillness.
Pup: This window isn't barred off.
Pup: (I need to find something about the 
Oathbreakers.)
I sneaked through the hallways of 
dusty bookshelves.
Pup: (Magics section... here it is.)

(Oathbreakers... Oathbreakers... come on...)
Pup: (...Nothing? But this is a Covenant Library? I know 
it's not a big library, but...)
Pup: (I wonder if they have a restricted section?)
With that in mind, I was about to head off to look 
for one when a thought jumped to my mind.
Pup: (I don't actually know much about how magic 
works in the first place.)
Pup: (I have all night, so...)
I quickly scoured the books for a introductory text 
on magic.

My fingers flipped through the basics of the 
writings.
Pup: ('Magics are a blessing from the Goddess Aurier.')

('In the beginning, this world was created as a trial 
ground for the souls that once defied Aurier.')

('Within the spiritual realm of Miryo, this land was 
created between the dark and the light.')
I looked out to the darkness of the night sky. The 
thousands of shimmering stars looked back at me.
Pup: I sometimes forget how foreboding the night can 
be. With the army of the damned scattered across 
the sky above...
My eyes turned back to the page.
Pup: ('The souls that turned away from damnation 
pledged an Oath of loyalty to Aurier.')

('So their mortality was tested in this trial ground of 
life, for said holy Oath to the Mother Soul was the
key to eternal salvation.')
...
Pup: What did this have to do with magic, again?
It was all information I knew. I had been taught 
these things since I was young.

I flipped through a few more pages. It went into 
detail about the old war between Aurier and 
Zened, the first son.
Zened was defeated and banished to the dark of 
the night.
Pup: Wait, here's something new...
Book: Magics are blessings granted by dutiful lineages loyal 
to Aurier or her ideals of existence.

Over generations of this loyalty and

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - Scene 3
passages.content:
I shut the book as I sighed with audible frustration.
Pup: *Sigh*... This is such a pain...
Pup: ...?!
Pup: (Crap, is someone still here?!)
I slipped the book back and got up as carefully 
as I could.
Librarian: Is someone there?
Pup: (I should get out of here. I'm not supposed to be 
here.)

(What's the best approach though?)
[Choice]: Make up a story / Fake being a ghost / Just get out ASAP

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - S3 Diplomatic
passages.content:
I slid myself around the bookshelf to get a read on 
where the librarian was.
Pup: (I see a candlelight moving over there. That must 
be him.)
Librarian: Show yourself! Even if you're a rat, I can show 
mercy.
Pup: (What excuse can I give? Maybe... didn't someone 
say something about this place being renovated?)
I turned my head to see some scaffolding not too 
far from where the librarian was.
Pup: (Perfect.)
Librarian: Last chance... 5... 4... 3...
Pup: Did I hear someone?
Librarian: Huh? Who are you?
I walked out near the candlelight wielded by the 
librarian.
Pup: Just a passerby. Are you in charge of this place?
Librarian: How did you get in? The gate should have been 
locked before just now.
Pup: Y- Yeah. I tried to knock and yell, but I didn't get 
an answer.
Pup: I'm only here because I thought I saw something 
questionable in the renovations.
Librarian: Young lady, I don't know what you think you're 
saying, but...
Pup: Come on...

I'm just trying to help here.
Pup: Have you seen this craftmanship? Shoddy as can 
be.
I picked up my hand and gave a firm pat to 
structure next to me as emphasis.
Pup: If you look at it, then you'd notice...
Pup: ...notice that...
There was a low rumbling sound.

I turned my head to see the outline of something 
in the darkness moving.
Pup: (It's falling?!)
The crumbling structure was falling straight into the
librarian!
Pup: Watch out!
I leaped forward!
Pup: *Pant*... *pant*...
I looked back and saw a column had nearly fallen on 
us both before I knocked us out of the way.
Librarian: T- Thank you... for... saving me...
The librarian was struggling to find words after the
surprise.
Librarian: I guess you were right... after all...
Pup: (Is this me being lucky or unlucky?)
Pup: I- I'll go get someone!
I jumped to my feet and scrambled out the now 
unlocked door.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - S3 Charismatic
passages.content:
I slid myself around the bookshelf to get a read on 
where the librarian was.
Pup: (I see a candlelight moving over there. That must 
be him.)
Librarian: Show yourself! Even if you're a rat, I can show 
mercy.
Pup: (Could I convince him it wasn't a person? Maybe a 
rat...? Or a ghost...?)
I looked around and saw some rocks on the floor.
Pup: (From the renovation?)
Pup: (This could work, though.)
Librarian: Last chance... 5... 4... 3...
Librarian: Huh? Come out! I can hear you.

...

Don't make me start counting again.
Pup: *Soft ghostly wailing*...
Librarian: Ha ha... very funny-
Librarian: ...?!
He turned on his heels in the other direction.
Librarian: How are you... You can't be in two places at once.
I tip toed towards the end of an aisle 
of bookshelves.
Pup: (This should hopefully pull his eyesight away 
enough for me to get outside.)
I carefully placed a book at the end of the 
bookshelf in a precarious position.

Starting to move, I dropped another rock to pull 
him further in this direction.
Librarian: Think you're being sneaky? You won't feel sneaky 
when I am done with you.
The librarian slowly scooted towards the sound.

By the time he was there, I was at the other end 
of the bookshelf.
Pup: (Now just a firm shake, and...)
Librarian: Ack! Begone ghost!
Pup: (Time to sprint out of here!)
Pup: (No time to... to...)
There was a low rumbling sound.

I turned my head to see the outline of something 
in the darkness moving.
Pup: (The renovation stuff... it's falling?!)
It wasn't entirely localized, and I had to jump out of 
the way of falling debris myself.
Pup: *Cough* *cough*...
Librarian: Goddess... Goddess help me...

*Cough*... I guess it was just this thing falling 
apart, in the end.

Oh fucking...! This shit fell apart?!
Pup: (Okay, he's definitely distracted now.)
I jumped to my feet and scrambled out the door.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - S3 Direct
passages.content:
I slid myself around the bookshelf to get a read on 
where the librarian was.
Pup: (I see a candlelight moving over there. That must 
be him.)
Librarian: Show yourself! Even if you're a rat, I can show 
mercy.
Pup: (What would be the quickest way out?)
I looked around and saw a few paths I could take.
Pup: (There aren't many wide open places because of 
the renovation.)

(I can make this work, though.)
Librarian: Last chance... 5... 4... 3...
Librarian: There you are.
The librarian walked over to a set of bookshelves 
that had make a creaking sound.
Librarian: Gotcha!

Or... wait...?
He turned to the aisle and saw... nothing.
Librarian: Hmm...
Pup: (That was close...)
The silent thought felt like it echoed from where I 
was.

I had climbed the bookshelf to the top of one.
Pup: (Some of the scaffolding up here leads through a 
window.)
Slowly but surely, I crawled my way along the 
bookselves' tops and to the scaffolding.
Librarian: A rat... maybe...?

Hmm...
Through the corner of my eye I saw the candlelight 
raise like he was looking towards to the top of the 
bookshelves.
Pup: (Shit, did he figure it out?)
I started to rush.
Pup: (No!)
Librarian: The rat?!
Pup: No more time for stealth.
My feet propped myself to jump up and sprint from 
where I was, but...
There was a low rumbling sound. I turned my head 
down to see the surface beneath me falling.
Pup: (The renovation stuff... it's falling?!)
Pup: ...?!
The surface fell forward and forced me to tumbled 
along the path I was walking!
Pup: Urgh!
I hit the ground hard as I fell out of a window and 
onto the ground outside.
Pup: O- Ow...
A voice could be heard from within.
Librarian: Goddess... Goddess help me...

*Cough*... I guess it was just this
thing falling apart, in the end.

Oh fucking...! This shit fell apart?!
Pup: (Okay, he's definitely distracted now.)
I jumped to my feet and scrambled around the 
side of the library towards its entranceway.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch4 - Continue 2
passages.content:
Pup: *Pant*... *pant*...
I turned back to see the librarian wander out the 
front door.
Pup: (At least he's okay.)
Librarian: Dammit, the main branch will not be happy about 
this. It'll cost a ton to fix.

The damn contractors will face the wrath of the 
Covenant!
Pup: And... I don't want any part of that.
I ran off to the inn.
With supplies on hand, our Nightless Crows 
company and allies started on our way out 
of town.
Pup: Mr. DeClares, was it?
Cainan: Cainan DeClares at your service.
Pup: You said that people at this... academy, was it...?
Cainan: The Theodal Royal Academy, yes.
Pup: Right.
Pup: You said they'd be able to offset the symptoms of 
this curse, correct?
Cainan: It is a possibility.
Cainan: But if there is any place that can, it would be them. 
They are a bastion of knowledge and research.
Pup: R- Right...
As we were talking, we passed by the library.
Cainan: Did something happen here?
Librarian: Hmph. Looks like the contractors we hired for the 
renovations did a poor job.
Cainan: Unfortunate. Shall I send word to Oadthine for 
assistance?
Librarian: If you could, that would be most appreciated.
The librarian headed off grumbling under 
his breath.
Cainan: I am happy I stopped you from entering.
Cainan: It would do us no good if you had been trapped 
beneath the rubble.
Pup: Y- Yeah... That was... That was a good call...

passages.name: Supply Run Ch5-6 - Begining
passages.content:
Rowan: And take one down, pass it around~ 
23 boxes left to pack~
Charlotte: Oh dear Aurier up in the sky... Please strike down 
this fool.
Rowan: The goddess would not dare starve the world of 
my lovely singing.
Charlotte: You actually think you're good at singing?
Rowan: How about we let the goddess herself decide?
Rowan raised his chin to look towards the sky.

..........
Rowan: It appears your prayer went... unanswered?
Charlotte: That doesn't mean anything.
Rowan: Ah... It is good to be goddess approved~
Rowan: 23 boxes left to pack~
Charlotte: Shut up, shut up, SHUT UP!
Otis: Ai, shut it yourself. I'm trying to take a nap.
Otis was strewn about on top of a tall box nearby.
Otis: If ya want to get it to stop, just finish up the prep 
work.
Charlotte: And why aren't you or your crew helping?!
Otis: Hungover, lass.
Otis: You do wanna leave today, ay?
Charlotte: I wish for you to do the job you were hired for...
Otis: Then we'll leave... *yawn*... tomorrow...
Otis rolled his back towards Charlotte and quickly 
started producing snores.
Charlotte: You little...
Rowan: 23 boxes left to pack~
Charlotte: Urgh! I get it!
Charlotte turned towards the loading ramp.
Charlotte: ...
Pup: ...
Charlotte: Why are you unloading a box?
I stood there with a box still in my hands. It was 
covering my chest.
Pup: Uh... well... It has good shape to get a grip on. It 
works well as a foundation to what I am carrying...
Pup: It's... more efficient.
My grip on the box tightened as I drew it a little 
closer to my chest.
Charlotte: *Sigh*... I don't care... We shouldn't even be 
doing this.
Pup: Well... It is what it is... so...

passages.name: Supply Run Ch5-6 - Choice
passages.content: [Choice]: We should act like a team. / Make light of the situation. / Complain about Otis, as well.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch5-6 - S3 Diplomatic
passages.content:
I started to move towards and around Charlotte.
Pup: We're all on the same team at this point.

Maybe they're not contributing now, but we'll be 
reliant on them once we set sail.
As I began to make my way around the two, I kept 
facing them and sidestepped as I kept moving.
Pup: It's the least we can do to get from point A to 
point B safely, right?
Charlotte: ...
I had made my way to the other side.
Pup: We should try to all get along, no? I'll get another 
box to pack.
With those words, I quickly pivoted to facing away 
from them and scurried off from the scene.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch5-6 - S3 Charismatic
passages.content:
I started to move towards and around Charlotte.
Pup: What else do you expect of the bandits of the sea? 
I've heard some tales myself.
Pup: You should hear some of the stories the Crows 
have of pirates. Bard boy over there probably has a 
few tales, too.
As I began to make my way around the two, I kept 
facing them and sidestepped as I kept moving.
Pup: Then again, if we don't want it to happen again...?

Maybe we should pour out the rum before setting 
off?
Otis: Urgh...
I had made my way to the other side.
Pup: As for this? Better to just get it over with, right? 
Haha... ha...
With those words, I quickly pivoted to facing away 
from them and scurried off from the scene.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch5-6 - S3 Direct
passages.content:
I started to move towards and around Charlotte.
Pup: Yeah, it is the typical sort of pain in the butt.
Pup: That dumb nekolyn is going to be the death of us if 
this keeps up.
As I began to make my way around the two, I kept 
facing them and sidestepped as I kept moving.
Pup: Rowan, you should keep singing as a punishment 
for the dead weight snoring up there.
Rowan: ...
I had made my way to the other side.
Pup: I guess... let's not dawdle. We can make up for 
these guys being lazy, at least.
With those words, I pivoted to facing away from 
them and scurried off from the scene.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch5-6 - Continue 2
passages.content:
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte turned back to Rowan.
Charlotte: What? Not going to sing "24 boxes" since one was 
taken off?
Rowan: ...
Rowan's eyes were set on the skies above the sea.
Rowan: It looks as though a storm may be setting in?
Charlotte: A storm...?
Otis: Shit. Kid's right.
Otis jumped down from the box. He rubbed his 
neck that was stiff from sleeping.
Otis: I'll get me mates. We really can't burn our time if 
dark clouds are formin'.
Otis: Ah... The Crimson Sea's bloody enough without 
the cracklin' of lightnin'.
Charlotte: Wait, then shouldn't we stay in port?
Otis: Eh, by the looks of it we can stay to its edges even 
if it gets bad.
Otis: Well, if we hurry to get going at least. 
Chop-chop, princess.
Charlotte: ...
With the full crew getting whipped into action, we 
were able to get out of port soon enough.
Norde: Such unnecessary dramatics...
Satia: At least we were able to get out of port before 
the sun was fully up.
Norde: Small victories do not always feel as such.
Norde: At least we left before the sun was able to fully 
rise. Small victory that it is.
For my part, as the ship began to drift away from 
port, I closely grabbed onto the ship's railings.
Mariel: Watching the town as it goes over the horizon?
When she approached, I scooted myself closer to 
the railing as to not face her.
Pup: Y- Yeah... That sounds about right?
Mariel: Is it your first time?
Pup: ...

(I guess I haven't before but...)
Pup: (How could I care about that when dealing with... 
this...)
I looked down to the small protrusions on my 
chest. The ones that I was attempting to hide.
Mariel: I was little at the time. It has a sort of magical air in 
my memories.

But even now it still is a pretty sight to watch.
Rowan: Watching the town as it goes over the horizon?
When he approached, I scooted myself closer to 
the railing as to not face him.
Pup: Y- Yeah... That sounds about right?
Rowan: Mayhap this be your first chance to do do?
Pup: ...

(I guess I haven't before but...)
Pup

passages.name: Supply Run Ch6-7 - Begining
passages.content:
My mind was dulled.

Static buzzed like white noise among my thoughts.
Recent events felt unreal.

They felt detached from my end goal.

My destination.

My...

*Bump*
Pup: ...?
The bumps of the carriage wheel along the 
roadside had shaken me out of my stupor.

I was greeted with the sight of the port and 
lodgings we were at... being left behind.
Kara: So, you've simply been traveling aimlessly since 
dropping out of the academy?
Rowan: 'Aimless' might be the wrong word, but...
Rowan: It has indeed been a glorious sequence of 
happenstance on many occasion.
Charlotte: ...!
An awkward air filled my senses.

I felt like an outsider to every word being 
discussed.
Pup: (Right, this is why I tried to zone out...)
Turning my head, I looked again at the situation 
playing out in the carriage.

The greater group had been split among carriages 
for a tour of the Cartenan capital.

I had somehow ended up with this group.
Kara: Haha... to think that young boy Alexei would be 
able to travel the world like so.

I still remember that time you collapsed from 
running in the physical education courses.
Rowan: Ah... I do insist. "Rowan" is my name.
Rowan: And believe me. I would still faint.
Pup: ("Kara"... and "Alexei"... This is... Who even are 
these people? These names?)
I turned my head away from that conversation to 
our fourth passenger...
Charlotte: ...!
...who was staring daggers at Rowan.
Pup: (Has she blinked?)
Pup: (Well, maybe this is better than nothing.)
Pup: Isn't this crazy? All this talk about a "prince" and 
stuff?
Charlotte: ...
Pup: Yeah... like... all that stuff.
Charlotte: Allegedly... he just had a growth spurt.

And a complete personality shift.
Pup: So... you actually knew him? Do you buy that?
Charlotte: Allegedly... he dropped out of school to go 
wandering about who knows where.

Allegedly... he hasn't spoken to his royal parentage 
since before all that took place.
Pup: Uh... I wasn't really...
Charlotte: Allegedly... he thought it a good idea to ju

passages.name: Supply Run Ch6-7 - Diplomatic
passages.content:
Pup: You know...
I leaned over towards Charlotte.
Pup: You really think Rowan is this "Alexei" guy?
Charlotte: Hmm... Good question.
Pup: Well, we should keep an eye out for any... foul play 
by him, right?
Pup: We could make a great team for doing just that.

With your brains and my brawn, we could cover the 
gambit.
Charlotte: Hmm...
Charlotte: I'd be up for being cautious. Too many alleged 
claims not to be.
Charlotte: But are you sure about that last part?

Me brains and you brawn? Is that how that'd work 
out?
Pup: Uh... I mean, why wouldn't it? I'm a mercenary and 
you're a princess.
Charlotte: Hmm... I wonder.
Rowan: There was a time when Charlotte loved to play the 
big bad guardian.
Charlotte: Hey. You were just a little kid.
Rowan: Was I?
Charlotte: A- Allegedly...

passages.name: Supply Run Ch6-7 - Charisma
passages.content:
Pup: So...
I leaned over towards Kara.
Pup: You're supposed to be a friend of these two, right?

Have they always been at each others' necks like 
this?
Kara: They had their moments.
Kara: But they always made for a cute pairing of 
underclassman and upperclassman.
Pup: Moments, then? Anything particularly scandalous? 
Stuff that surprised you?
Kara: I can't say anything comes to mind. Not much will 
surprise me these days.
Pup: Ah, come on. I'm sure there's something fun like 
that.
Kara: I cannot say I remember the last time I was truly 
surprised by something.
Kara: You'd be better off rephrasing your question.
Pup: Uh... O- Okay...
Pup: Then... maybe...?
As I was about to do just that...
Charlotte: What are you talking about "no surprises"?

There was that time Alexei got dragged by a horse 
in riding class.
Rowan: Ugh... What a cruel memory to introduce.
Kara: *Giggle*... I don't believe that to be a perfectly 
accurate account. After all, there was...

passages.name: Supply Run Ch6-7 - Direct
passages.content:
Pup: You know...
I leaned over towards Rowan.
Pup: This 'Alexei' thing...

I don't know if I buy it, but Charlotte definitely 
seems to want your head on a pike.
Rowan: I have grown used to it.
Rowan: You had a similar sentiment as of
just recently, did you not?
Pup: R- Right... Out of the fire and into another, I 
guess?
Pup: You do tend to do everything you can to stop 
people from trusting you, though.
Rowan: At this rate I may need a bodyguard.
Rowan: Might you be willing to take up that mantle?
Pup: B- Bodyguard? You mean...?

(Wait, is he being serious?)
Pup: I mean...
Charlotte: As if a bodyguard would keep you safe if I really 
wanted to.
Rowan: This reminds me of that one boy you sought 
revenge on in the academy.

What did he do? Try to take your hat from you?
Charlotte: Yeah, and if you want to end up like him...

passages.name: Supply Run Ch6-7 - Continue
passages.content:
And so each of them went back to their nostalgic 
topics.
Pup: ...
So I sat back and just waited.

Less than a minute later a plate was put before me 
with a meal.
Pup: Looks good...
I picked at the food with my fork and took small 
bites.
Pup: Looks good. Is good...

...
Pup: (I wonder if I could take some as leftovers?)

(It'll be my turn for a supply run soon. Maybe that'll 
get me out of it?)
Pup: ...

Maybe.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch7-8 - Begining
passages.content:
*Click*
*Click*
*Click*
*Click*

The carriage moved swiftly, but the click of wheels 
on brick roads were loud.

Very loud.

*Click*
Pup: ...!
I started to feel like I was going to hurl as the next 
bump of the brick road rattled my senses.
Pup: (The Queen... We need to talk to... the Queen...)
I tried to focus my attention into staring at a single 
point.

In this case, it was my arm.
I stared at my...

I expected to see hairs standing on edge, but I 
didn’t have any body hair to do so.
Pup: (Right, I had that-)
Pup: Ugh...

(I need to stop thinking about it...)
I stared at my...

I expected to see hairs standing on edge, but I 
didn’t have any body hair to do so.
Pup: (It really is just hitting me all-)
Pup: Ugh...

(I need to stop thinking about it...)
As my eyes unfocused and my breathing caught up 
with me, I tilted towards the carriage window.
Pup: (Snowy... mountains... how... how pretty?)
My mind struggled to focus on it, so I gave in to 
the distractions.
Norde: Do not lose focus.
Pup: I know. I know, I know...
Norde: Mmm...
Norde had a drop of sweat going down his brow.

His breathing was distinctly controlled and calm, 
as though it required effort.

And he couldn’t get that look of frustration off his 
face anymore.
Pup: You’re also...?
Norde: Do not... say it.
Pup: (Yeah, he is.)

(I can’t be mad at him about it. He’s handling it 
way better than I am...)
Norde: It... will not be long now.
As Norde said as much, the city... and the palace... 
was coming into view.
Pup: Yeah...
Avalina: ...You DARE set foot here as such?!
Pup: ...?!
The outburst shook me from my stupor.
Avalina: ...a sacred place of authority and...
Kara: ...n’t have done it if...
Rowan: ...not know the minds of...
Charlotte: ...save the kingdom and then...
Pup: (And then...?)
Pup: (And then...?!)
I tried to pay attention to the conversation they 
were having with the Queen. I really did.

But I couldn’t.
Pup: What did she...?
Knight: Shh!
Pup: S- Sorry...
We had been placed in a group b

passages.name: Supply Run Ch7-8 - Dip
passages.content:
I rose to my feet and pulled the bedside curtain 
out of the way.
Pup: I can help.
Charlotte: You’re awake?
Pup: We all remember what happened in Lockhart. We 
need everyone we can get.
Rowan: Are you alright?
Pup: I’m...
Pup: I’m better.

I’m ready to help.
Kara: You believe yourself to be fit to fight?
Pup: After what happened at Lockhart. I need to help. I 
can.

We don’t even have... We don’t even have my 
father this time.

There isn’t room for debate on this.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch7-8 - Cha
passages.content:
I rose to my feet and pulled the bedside curtain 
out of the way.
Pup: So we’re headed out now? Let’s get going.
Charlotte: You’re awake?
Pup: Sorry if I have some bed head, but I think we have 
more important things to deal with.
Rowan: Are you alright?
Pup: I’m...
Pup: I’m doing as well as one can expect.

I wouldn’t dare sit this one out.
Kara: You believe yourself to be fit to fight?
Pup: I know I can handle a sword. Maybe even swing it 
with some righteous fury, too.
Pup: If this is the Empire... I... You all know I cannot just 
sit this out.

This is too important for too many reasons to 
debate.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch7-8 - Dir
passages.content:
I rose to my feet and pulled the bedside curtain 
out of the way.
Pup: Let’s get going, then.
Charlotte: You’re awake?
Pup: And ready to go.
Rowan: Are you alright?
Pup: I’m...
Pup: I’m ready to fight.

I wouldn’t dare sit this one out.
Kara: You believe yourself to be fit to fight?
Pup: I believe I will fight. I KNOW I will.

If this is anything like Lockhart... I’m not going to 
just let it pass me by.
Pup: I will make a difference. I won’t... I won’t be the 
reason for sacrifices being made.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch7-8 - New Event
passages.content:
The stares that came my way were wary.
I could press the issue only so much.
Norde: I... agree.
Satia: You... what?
Satia: We shouldn’t...
Pup: You... wait, really?
Norde: If one is compelled to action and can make a true 
difference...
Norde: Do you think you could make a true difference, 
Anton?
Pup: Yes.
Norde: I support it, then.
Pup: ...
Pup: Thank you...
I turned back and stared at the others with a 
determined face.
Pup: ...
But...
Pup: ...!
Satia: Is it the curse again?!
Mariel: U- Uh... I can get a first aid kit!
Otis: Eh, lad. Knowin’ ya limits are important.
Otis: Especially in the early days for ya.
Charlotte: Yeah, this is getting irresponsible.
Pup: I... No...
A barrage of worried faces that couldn’t look 
anymore like antagonists filled my vision.

Voices of worry barraged my hearing.

And I dreaded the approaching hands of mercy.
Pup: I... I can...!
Kara: Then make a promise.
There it was. An opening.

A path through the ocean of goodwill.
Kara: Promise everyone you will not allow yourself to die.

That you will stop yourself when you cross that line 
of becoming a hindrance.
Pup: ...
A medic approached Kara.
Medic: These are the supplies you wanted me to run out 
and get, right?
Kara: They are. Thank you.
As the medic scurried off, she seemed to start 
preparing a small sort of tonic.
Kara: Promise.
Pup: ...
Pup: Okay. I promise.

I promise I will retreat when it goes too far.
Kara: Good.
With her tonic nearly complete, she unbuttoned 
her collar and took out a necklace.

Soon enough, it shone with a brilliant light.
Rowan: Magic? This is an heirloom?
Mariel: Are you enchanting the tonic in some way?
The shimmering lights of the magic settled into 
the tonic.
Kara: This will not cure you. This will not ease your 
symptoms.

It will, however, stop them from getting worse for 
a time.

And that is all it will be. Time. Time that you must 
make the most of.
Pup: I... How did you...?
I looked down at the bottle she had placed in my 
hand.
Pup: Thank you

passages.name: Supply Run Ch10-11 - Begining
passages.content:
The fluttering rays of light filtered through the
morning haze.
Blinded by it in the awakening daze, I could only 
hear the ruckus of something from afar.
Atticus: ...
Charlotte: ...
I couldn't make out words, but I assumed 
something had happened.
.........
Marya: Apologies, but excuse me.
Pup: ...?
Pup: ...Hello?
A woman was standing over my sleeping bag,
folding some sort of a fabric.
Marya: Oh, did I wake you? I'm so sorry.
Pup: Who are...
Pup: (Oh wait...)

Mrs. Ranasseur.
Mrs. Marya Ranasseur was standing over me. 
Atticus's wife.
Marya: I was just getting an early start on rolling up your
supplies here.
Pup: Why... would you do that?
Pup: (Did someone spot the army in the area already?)
I picked myself up and yawned.
Marya: Well...
As I knelt down to start collecting my own sleeping
bag, she told me about how the Oathbreaker was 
gone.
Pup: W- What?!

(After everything we did?! How did... How did that
happen?!)
Marya: That sweet girl Charlotte agreed to help track it 
down as part of your group's efforts.
Pup: Yeah, of course we can help.
I quickened my rolling of the sleeping bag.
Marya: Thank you. I know it would do my husband's heart 
good to know you have his back wholeheartedly.
With a huff, I pulled the stored sleeping bag up.
Pup: Of course. After all, if we don't, then who will?
Kara: In this case, especially.
Kara approached, with Charlotte not far behind her.
Charlotte: How did they get it in the night? We were all here...
Kara: If there's a trail to follow, we're the only ones with
a shot of finding that lead.

It would be weeks before a Covenant deployment
could be here to start an investigation.
Pup: I'll carry this over to the horses and-
I stepped forward.
As I did...
Pup: Ah...?
...I stumbled a little.
My clothes had gotten tangled with the sleeping 
bag a little, catching on it in a way I didn't expect.
Pup: I- I'll just be on my way.
Marya: Oh my, are you alright?

You're absolutely swimming in that outfit...
Charlotte: Oh, you noticed, too?

passages.name: Supply Run Ch10-11 - New Event
passages.content:
STAGE DIRECTION> IN BETWEEN CHAPTER 10->11 ONLY
STAGE DIRECTION> BLACK SCREEN, WAIT 60 FRAMES
STAGE DIRECTION> PLAY BGM PERITUNE VERDURE
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE TO WHITE BG
The fluttering rays of light filtered through the
morning haze.
Blinded by it in the awakening daze, I could only hear
the ruckus of something from afar.
Atticus: ...
Charlotte: ...
I couldn't make out words, but I assumed something had
happened.
STAGE DIRECTION> .........
STAGE DIRECTION> MARYA IS ATTICUS'S WIFE. SHE CAN HAVE
A GENERIC PORTRAIT. NICE OLDER LADY.
Marya: Apologies, but excuse me.
Pup: ...?
STAGE DIRECTION> FADE TO BG DLC SNOW_CASTLE (DAY)
STAGE DIRECTION> WAIT 90 FRAMES
Pup: ...Hello?
A woman was standing over my sleeping bag, folding a
fabric.
Marya: Oh, did I wake you? I'm so sorry.
Pup: Who are...
Pup: (Oh wait...)

Mrs. Ranasseur.
Mrs. Marya Ranasseur was standing over me. Atticus's
wife.
Marya: I was just getting an early start on rolling up your
supplies here.
Pup: Why... would you do that?
Pup: (Did someone spot the army in the area already?)
I picked myself up and yawn.
Marya: Well...
As I knelt down to start collecting my own sleeping
bag, she told me about how the Oathbreaker was gone.
Pup: W- What?!

(After everything we did?! How did... How did that
happen?!)
Marya: That sweet girl Charlotte agreed to help track it down
as part of your group's efforts.
Pup: Yeah, of course we can.
My motions to roll the sleeping bag hurried.
Marya: Thank you. I know it would do my husband's heart good
to know you have his back wholeheartedly.
With a huff, I pulled the stored sleeping bag up.
Pup: Of course. After all, if we don't, then who will?
Kara: In this case especially.
Kara approached, with Charlotte not far behind her.
Charlotte: How did they get it in the night? We were all here...
Kara: If there's a trail to follow, we're the only ones with
a shot of finding that lead.

Any Covenant deployment couldn't be here to start
anytime soon.
Pup: I'll get this over to the horses and-
A

passages.name: Supply Run Ch8-9 - Begining
passages.content:
Our group reached the western border of the 
Kingdom of Cartenan.
Pup: Ugh...
Satia: Here, Pup. Just hold on and try to get your energy
back.
Norde: Anton... It'll be...
Carried from the battlefield, I had only recently
stopped slipping in and out of consciousness.
My exhaustion from the fight and the effects of the
curse had hit me hard.
Rowan: I'll admit, even I'm at a bit of a loss.
Kara: For now... regrouping feels like the apt step to take.
Norde: All of our group was scattered in the retreat. Crows
and otherwise.
Norde: We'll need to find a safe place to regroup soon if 
we hope to reform.
Charlotte: Is it... safe to stop here?
Kara: Hmm...

Sir Norde. How are the effects of that curse for 
you?
Norde: ...Manageable.
Norde adjusted his equipment as though he was 
insecure about what might be beneath.
Norde: At least with your concoction. It assisted at staving
off the worst, if just for a time.
Kara: Be careful with attempting to hold it back too 
much.
Kara eyed over to me.
Kara: It seems resistance can have more... explosive 
changes, if the cards play out that way.
Norde: Hmm...
Rowan: All the more reason to establish this 'regrouping
point' sooner over later.
Charlotte: Any ideas, Kara? You know the Kingdom better 
than anyone.
Kara: A few... potentially viable options come to mind.
Charlotte: Works for me. Let's do one of those.

How about you all in the Crows?
Does it sound agreeable?
Norde: It'll be-
Pup: ...F- fine... We'll be... fine to keep going.

If there's a better place to stop, then... then...

Argh...
I started to fall over as my consciousness slipped 
for a second.
Rowan: Are you okay?
I had fallen in a pile of snow,
and Rowan went to help me up.

Between the newfound winter and our 
group reaching the edge of the mountain
range, it was all over the place.
Norde: ...

Ignore Anton. We can follow your lead. Choose 
what you think is best.
Pup: Ugh...
Kara led us to a nearby cave.
She told us that it was an old mine used as a 
hidden reserve for

passages.name: Supply Run Ch8-9 - Dip
passages.content:
Pup: Ho... Hi... Whom... Hum...?
Pup: "The great and respected King Minae had two 
subjects placed before him."

"Each claimed paren-"
Pup: "...parenta- parentage of a baby."
The different feel of the voice and my feverish 
state started making me slur and stumble over 
words by the end.
That may be my limit.
Charlotte: Everything... okay?
Pup: N- Nothing... Just... repeating a story...

...just... testing stuff...
I mumbled out those parts, but as of now it 
definitely did feel like my voice had gone up in 
pitch.
I never had a deep voice, but now it'd be hard to
mistake it as a guy's voice when you saw me.
Pup: (Maybe if someone wasn't seeing me, then they 
wouldn't be able to tell?)
Charlotte: I think it sounds nice.
Pup: Huh?
Charlotte: Your new voice, I mean.

It still sounds like you, but... maybe a little more
soothing.
Pup: ...
Pup: Mmm...
I didn't know what to say.
Or maybe I just didn't want to talk any more.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch8-9 - Cha
passages.content:
My hand guided itself through the strands of 
hair dangling down along my chest.
Pup: (So much longer...)
The feeling of my hands gliding along the 
silky smooth hair was relaxing, though.
Pup: Mmm...
The feeling of playing with my hair had 
something of a relaxing effect, though.
Pup: Hmm...
Pup: Heh...
As I did, my mind changed gears.
I started to swing it around like a sword.
A toy sword, at least.
Pup: ...Hah! Heheh~
Charlotte: Hm?
Charlotte: You okay?
Pup: Y- Yeah...
Pup: J- Just... Stuff...
Embarrassed, I stuffed my hair back to 
where it was.
Charlotte: *Giggle*...
Charlotte turned back to her task.
As she did, I shook my head some and felt the long 
hair shake and flutter across my neck and such.
Pup: ...
Charlotte: It looks nice, if you're worried.
Pup: Hm?
Charlotte: Your hair. It has a pretty shade with that length.
Pup: I...

(W- What is she saying?!)
I turtled myself up a little.

My already hot head felt like it was burning
for a few seconds after she said that.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch8-9 - Dir
passages.content:
Pup: Mm...!

(I should... I have to...)
I positioned my hands to take a peek.
Hesitating, my feverish mind started to fill my
thoughts with more ridiculous imaginings.
The image crossed my mind's eye of it turning 
towards me and snapping at me like a snake.
Then one image was of something akin to a 
dried, shriveled up cucumber.
Another felt like it might just fall off if I looked at
it wrong.
Pup: ...!
I peeked!
Pup: ...!
It was smaller.
Pup: ...
Pup: (IT'S SMALLER?!)
Charlotte: Hahah...
Charlotte: ...I think.
Pup: Ah..?!
The peephole to within my bottom side coverings 
snapped shut.
Charlotte: You... Y- You don't need to worry so much 
about... ah...
Charlotte: ....just... try to rest.

You may find others care less about it than you 
may think...
Pup: ...
Pup: Huh?
She turned away from me as we both blushed 
up a storm.
Pup: Mmm...
Thinking on it, I hadn't been able to tell if it was
smaller after the previous change.
But this time the change felt unmistakable.

passages.name: Supply Run Ch8-9 - New Event
passages.content:
Charlotte: *Clears throat*
Charlotte: There's the fire going now.

I'll grab a blanket for you. I think I saw one around
the corner.
Charlotte turned the corner and circled back to me.
Charlotte: Here we are, one for each of you.
Norde: ...

...zzzz...
The light snore from Norde made it clear that
sleep had taken him.
Charlotte set the blanket on him without 
waking him.
Charlotte: Now, you...
Charlotte: Hmm... You really should get a new set of clothes 
at this rate.

Your gambeson is one thing, but the rest is more
sticking to you because its damp.

It's really starting to get tight and loose in all the
wrong places.
Pup: I guess it can be a bit hard to move around in. I 
could get something...?
Charlotte: I wonder what color would go well with your hair 
like is now?
Pup: Well, I always liked-
Pup: Ah... no...
Pup: N- No... I... I'm sticking with these.
Clutching to the collar of my shirt, I held on
tightly to the thing I still had control over.
Charlotte: Hmm... Then maybe we can get it tailored so it fits...
a little better, at least?
Pup: I... I can't just give up. I need to be able to turn
back to normal.
Charlotte: Right...
Charlotte shifted and sat next to me.
Pup: I need to hold the fort until.... until my father...
until he...
Pup: ...
Charlotte: ...
Charlotte leaned against my blanketed body, 
resting her head on my shoulder.
Pup: *Pant* ...  *pant* ...
With me having snapped back to the present, I 
panted a little in a slight panic.
The silence continued with us together, and I 
started to calm down some.
Pup: ...
I looked over at Norde, another inflicted by this.
Pup: Maybe... Maybe it's all pointless...
I muttered it under my breath.
Charlotte: It's not.
Charlotte: In Lockhart, you saved people. In Cartenan, you 
saved people.

Even in this predicament we find ourselves in... 
we're still helping. You're still helping.
Pup: ...
I breathed in deeply. I didn't have words.
Charlotte: After everything that has happened...

...I get the feeling of losing..

passages.name: Supply Run Ch9-10 - Begining
passages.content:
Pup: And...
Pup: ...there!
The hilt of my sheathed sword slammed down, 
and the stake was set into the ground. 

The tent should be stable now.
Pup: Ahh...~
That was the last one needed.
Charlotte: *Exhale*... How do you guys do this all the time?
Pup: It's super easy, barely an...
Pup: ...barely an... inconvenience...

...

*Sigh*...
I tried to stand tall, but I was wavering.
Charlotte: Well, I'm not used to it, but you could really use 
some rest, too.
Pup: I said already that I'm fine.

Most of the way to being a girl or not, whatever. 

I just need to focus on the task at hand 
and I can...
Pup: ...and I can...
Charlotte: Sure.

And I wonder if you're hiding any injuries behind 
that mask?
Pup: Charlotte, you don't need to-
Charlotte: Go get a health check before your rest.
Pup: My time would be better spent-
Charlotte: Consider that a directive of your client.
Pup: Ack...
Charlotte: I am really starting to love those magic words~
Charlotte poked at the tip of her nose with a big of
arrogant bravado.
Charlotte: That said, I am serious.

Go get checked out before too long.

We can't have...
Charlotte: ... *Yaawnnnn* ... can't...
Charlotte: ...can't have you bleeding out internally as you
sleep...
Charlotte's words trailed off as she started to drag
herself away to go and rest.
Pup: Hmmm...

(Well, if she's asleep, I can just tell her I did.)
But the faint voice of Charlotte's words managed to
reach me from where she had walked to.
Charlotte: Kara, you took your rest already, right?
Pup: (Kara, but she isn't here right now?)
And so Charlotte continued away from where I 
was...
.........
And so did the tents...
Pup: (Why are the tents...?)
I turned my head.
Kara: Hello, dear Baranov.
I was being dragged.
Pup: I...
Pup: ...
Pup: *Sigh*...
Pup: (Let's just get this over with...)
We arrived in the medical tent with Kara 
as the lead.
Kara: Hello? Is anyone...
Kara stepped in only to find an empty tent.
No one was there.
But my mind went in a different direction.
Pup:
