Charlotte: That said, I am serious.

Go get checked out before too long.

We can't have...
Charlotte: ...
Yaawnnnn
... can't...
Charlotte: ...can't have you bleeding out internally as you
sleep...
Charlotte's words trailed off as she started to drag
herself away to go and rest.
Pup: Hmmm...

(Well, if she's asleep, I can just tell her I did.)
But the faint voice of Charlotte's words managed to
reach me from where she had walked to.
Charlotte: Kara, you took your rest already, right?
Pup: (Kara, but she isn't here right now?)
And so Charlotte continued away from where I was...
STAGE DIRECTION> .........
And so did the tents...
Pup: (Why are the tents...?)
I turned my head.
Kara: Hello, dear Baranov.
I was being

passages.name: Supply Run Ch11-12 - Begining
passages.content:
The fluttering rays of light filtered through the
morning haze.
Blinded by it in the awakening daze, I could only 
hear the ruckus of something from afar.
Atticus: ...
Charlotte: ...
I couldn't make out words, but I assumed 
something had happened.
.........
Marya: Apologies, but excuse me.
Pup: ...?
Pup: ...Hello?
A woman was standing over my sleeping bag,
folding some sort of a fabric.
Marya: Oh, did I wake you? I'm so sorry.
Pup: Who are...
Pup: (Oh wait...)

Mrs. Ranasseur.
Mrs. Marya Ranasseur was standing over me. 
Atticus's wife.
Marya: I was just getting an early start on rolling up your
supplies here.
Pup: Why... would you do that?
Pup: (Did someone spot the army in the area already?)
I picked myself up and yawned.
Marya: Well...
As I knelt down to start collecting my own sleeping
bag, she told me about how the Oathbreaker was 
gone.
Pup: W- What?!

(After everything we did?! How did... How did that
happen?!)
Marya: That sweet girl Charlotte agreed to help track it 
down as part of your group's efforts.
Pup: Yeah, of course we can help.
I quickened my rolling of the sleeping bag.
Marya: Thank you. I know it would do my husband's heart 
good to know you have his back wholeheartedly.
With a huff, I pulled the stored sleeping bag up.
Pup: Of course. After all, if we don't, then who will?
Kara: In this case, especially.
Kara approached, with Charlotte not far behind her.
Charlotte: How did they get it in the night? We were all here...
Kara: If there's a trail to follow, we're the only ones with
a shot of finding that lead.

It would be weeks before a Covenant deployment
could be here to start an investigation.
Pup: I'll carry this over to the horses and-
I stepped forward.
As I did...
Pup: Ah...?
...I stumbled a little.
My clothes had gotten tangled with the sleeping 
bag a little, catching on it in a way I didn't expect.
Pup: I- I'll just be on my way.
Marya: Oh my, are you alright?

You're absolutely swimming in that outfit...
Charlotte: Oh, you noticed, too?

passages.name: Supply Run Ch11-12 - New Event
passages.content:
We stepped through the bustling morning 
of Crekskia.
Charlotte: So... big changes?
Pup: In a sense.
I hiked up my gambeson to over my shoulders 
once more.
But, after a few more steps, the jostling had 
pushed them to slide off again, with the straps on 
my clothes being what kept it on overall.
Pup: *Sigh*...
Kara: First of all, you slept outside for the night, yes?

It may have not been for long, but do you feel 
alright?
Pup: I'm feeling okay... maybe a little sore?
Charlotte: So why did you head off like that?
Mariel: Yeah, what happened to cause... you to change more?
Satia: Indeed. What brought you out to a graveyard?
Charlotte: Or, better yet, what led you to that chamber in 
the first place?
Kara: You did have some strange behavior as you uncovered it.
Pup: W- Well...
Norde: One question at a time, yes?
Norde: Few of us have had much sleep, Anton included.
I looked over to Norde, who had cut off the topic
before I could be piled underneath the questions.
I smiled softly at the gesture.
Pup: Actually, I had a question, too.

What happened to the Imperials we were fighting? 
I missed the last bits of that.
Rowan: Yours truly rallied the town and Crows to the 
rescue.

Hand in hand, their leader was placed under our 
very own lock and key.
Pup: That fox eared lady merc? We captured her?
Rowan: Amongst others.
Rowan: In fact, she was set to the side to be interrogated 
by our very own Charlotte~
Rowan said in a melodic tone, and tilted his head
towards Charlotte as he did.
Charlotte: I'm... taking a break.
Charlotte: *Sigh*... it's way too early in the morning for that.
Rowan: Yes, a break.

Before even starting.
Charlotte: I don't exactly see you benefiting from beauty 
sleep yourself.
Rowan: Alas, I was too worried for our fair Pup.
Charlotte: So was I...!
The two's familiar bickering seemed to trail off in 
the background, and I could only chuckle.
Soon enough, Kara's face popped forward and 
into my view.
Kara: On that topic, we are tasked with completing p

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Noble Officer (Pup)
passages.content:
Noble Officer: Step aside young lady. We are fulfilling justice here!
Pup: Justice? Yeah, I'm not even going to give you the 
time of day.

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Noble Officer (Tatiana)
passages.content:
Tatiana: Really good job you're doing here. You do your 
lineage proud.
Noble Officer: That voice...

Is that the insect from before?
Tatiana: ...

Thanks. You gave me another reason for you to 
die.

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Start
passages.content:
Pup: Everyone is scattered about...

What can we do...?
Pup: I'll have to trust them. I'll head to the town center 
where we can hopefully meet up.
Pup: (And maybe deal with some of these soldiers on 
the way...)
I placed my hand on my sword and turned to the 
girl I had met in this havoc.
Pup: Stay as safe as possible. I'll handle these guys as 
best I can.
Tatiana: What? Do you want to get yourself killed?
Pup: Believe it or not, I'm a mercenary. One with allies in 
town with me.
Pup: I just need to regroup with them...
Tatiana: You're still gonna...
Tatiana: *Sigh*... What to do?
Win Condition: The officer dies
Lose Condition: Pup, Tatiana, Rowan or Charlotte 
die.
Win Condition: The officer dies
Lose Condition: Pup, Otis, Tatiana, Rowan or 
Charlotte  die.

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Pup → Tatiana
passages.content:
Pup: What are you still doing here?! I said get to safety!
Tatiana: To think they'd go this far? Could I even...?
Tatiana: Argh! Fuck it! I'll kill them myself!
She looked around the area.
Tatiana: It looks like everyone else has ran away? It should 
be safe to do it...
Pup: Are you even listening?
Tatiana: I'll clean up my own mess, thank you very much.
Tatiana: Now...
She raised her hand and a bracelet she wore 
around her wrist seemed to glisten in the sun.
After a second silence, there was a whoosh of air 
approaching us and ringing through me ears.
As my head turned to it, the object in question 
flew in and out of my sight only for it to snap to 
the girl's arm.
Pup: What in the Goddess's name is that?!
A gauntlet had attached itself to her hand. It was 
double the size of her actual hand, even.

Another whoosh of air came as a metal boot did 
the same to her foot.
Tatiana: Well if you're too dumb to put two and two 
together, then that makes this simpler.
One after another, pieces of armor attached to her 
body.

What stood before me at the end was a hulking 
set of armor that was at least double her size.
Pup: The... "Armored Bandit"?
Tatiana: Took you long enough.
Tatiana: Let's keep this our little secret, yeah?
Pup: I didn't even catch your name.
Tatiana: Tatiana. Not that'd help those idiots try and catch 
me.
Pup: So many questions...
Pup: I'll save them, though. You up for trying to meet 
up with my allies?
Tatiana: If I get to boot stomp that fuckwad in charge of 
the soldiers? Gladly.
Tatiana was recruited!

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Pup → Tatiana
passages.content:
Pup: Might I ask... How are you... you know? How are 
you doing that?
Tatiana: The armor?

I'm not going to pretend I get the theory, but I've 
got a knack for being able to manipulate it.

One day I found an heirloom, and moving shit 
around was the thing that worked for me when I 
tried to use it.
Pup: So you're... using magic to hold it in place around 
you? And move it around as you need to?
Tatiana: As best as I understand it? Yeah. Some shit like 
that.
Pup: That's... pretty cool...
Pup: (I need to ask the others how that could work... 
Maybe I could...)

(No, for now we need to focus on the task at 
hand.)

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Satia → Mariel
passages.content:
Mariel: Wh- Why are the soldiers acting like this?
Satia: Some commander likely got too big for their 
britches.

What to do... They look like they're looking for 
someone or something.
Mariel: Shouldn't we find the others? What if they're in 
danger?
Satia: Very true! Focus on keeping our friends and loved 
ones safe.
Satia: That should be our number 1 priority.
Mariel: Just let me know what I need to do.

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Norde → Jakson
passages.content:
Jakson: *Concerned bark*
Norde: No, you may not carry the meat.
Jakson: *Disagreeable bark*
Norde: Because you will eat it.
Jakson: *Offended bark*
Norde: Because you've done it before.
Norde: More enemies approach. Do not distract me 
further.
Jakson: *Huff*...

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Cainan → Charlotte
passages.content:
Cainan: Hmm... This appears to be troublesome.
Charlotte: We can't go anywhere nice, can we?
Cainan: Shall we, then?
Charlotte: The big bad auditor is going to stand up to the 
local army?
Cainan: It is but a trifle.
Cainan: May I escort you through the flames of battle, 
princess?
Charlotte: Why not? Be sure to watch out for friendly fire, 
dear auditor.

passages.name: Paralogue 1 (Battle) - Rowan → Otis
passages.content:
Rowan: This... What are the soldiers doing?
Otis: Looks like a raid to me.
Rowan: It was such a pleasant day, too.
Otis: I don't know... This looks pretty fun, too.
Rowan: Wait, don't run off! We were supposed to be 
purchasing sanitary supplies!

passages.name: Paralogue Pre-Story - Scene 2
passages.content:
The Nightless Crows had been traveling to a new 
destination among the many in their journey.

Along that path, they came across a medium sized 
village that they could rest and resupply within.
Shopkeep: Fresh lobster! 20% off until noontime!

Get your lobster! So fresh you'd think you're 
swimming seaside yourself!
Pup: (Why give a discount to super fresh lobster? I think 
I smell a little white lie in that.)
I approached the food stand.
Shopkeep: Welcome, welcome! Lobster for your evening 
dinner?
Pup: A little rich for my blood.
Pup: You have any trout in stock?
Shopkeep: Splendid choice! Let me see...
Away from the market town scene, some rumbling 
from horse hooves and steel boots rattled the 
eardrum.
Villager: Are those...?
Another Villager: Maybe we should move.
Pup: Hmm...
Looking at the trout, I wasn't sure how actually 
fresh it was.
Pup: May I?
Shopkeep: Of course. I wouldn't ask you to not trust your 
own senses.
Pup: Thank you.
I picked up one of the fish and stepped back a few 
paces to smell it for how fresh it was away from 
the other fish.
Pup: *Sniff*...

(It doesn't smell like it's going bad... I think?)

(I could probably-)
Pup: Grk!
Pup: What the-...?!
I turned to see an annoyed soldier looking down 
on me.
Soldier: Watch where you're going!
Pup: YOU hit me.
I looked over to the ground around me.

The fish I was holding was covered in the 
surrounding's dirt.
Shopkeep: My- My product?!
Pup: Goddess dammit...
Pup: You going to pay for that?
Soldier: Pay for... a fish? Hahaha! You don't know who 
you're talking to, do you?
Pup: A minimum wage hired hand?
Soldier: Hmph. Maybe we should teach you a lesson?

You scuffed my armor. How about you treat us to 
a nice fish dinner?
The other soldiers had gathered around the 
first. They started chuckling along with him.
Pup: Tsk. I...
Tatiana: Hey ladies~

Gossiping without me?
Pup: Huh?
I turned to see a girl around my age sitting on the 
food stand I was at before.
Tatiana: You know... gossip is often

passages.name: Paralogue1 Post Story - Tatiana Recluited
passages.content:
Noble Officer: You... disgusting... insect!
Tatiana: Hmph. Got what he deserved.
Villager: Ahhh! The- The soldier is dead!?
Tatiana: Tell everyone that the Armored Bandit is to be 
feared!
Villager: Eek!
The villagers around the fight all ran off well away 
from our group.
Tatiana: *Sigh*... Maybe that'll keep those assholes down 
for a bit.

I'd hate for this sort of thing to happen again...
Tatiana released the magic she was using on the 
armor and it fell to the ground around her.

With another swipe of her hand, the armor came 
together into a bundle like it was magnetized.
Charlotte: What's this now?
Tatiana: It's easier to carry like this.
Charlotte: No... I mean... everything.
Pup: Well...
Pup: Is it okay to tell?
Tatiana: I guess. You bunch seem alright. You did help keep 
this asshole from harassing the whole town.
I did my best to explain the situation.
Charlotte: The "Armored Bandit"?
Pup: Have you heard of her?
Charlotte: It's a boogeyman story they tell in the halls of 
nobility.

And probably an older story than this girl is.
Tatiana: You're not that much older than me
Rowan: I believe the point our fair lady was trying to make 
was less accusatory than that.
Rowan: If the tale predates your activity, then it is likely 
people made the connection between the two 
rather than you inspiring it.
Rowan: Quite a clever bit of luck. To grasp onto reputation 
beyond your own.
Tatiana: Well, I've never heard of it.
Charlotte: It's sort of beside the point.

Knowing the idiot local nobility here, they're 
probably going to get more aggressive.

They may truly tear this town down to nothing just 
to chase the "evil" boogeyman they grew up 
hearing about.
Tatiana: No way...

I need to get out of here, then. Maybe I can...
Pup: We can't just let that happen, either.
Rowan: Indeed, but what to do?

Perhaps if we intercept any rumors and remove the 
"Armored Bandit"'s involvement?

That would quell the deep seated fears that 
motivate the nobles.
Charlotte: I don't

passages.name: Paralogue1 Post Story - Tatiana not recluited
passages.content:
Noble Officer: Damn you... bastards!
The girl from before ran up and saw the 
commander as he fell.
Tatiana: Hmph. Got what he deserved.
Villager: Ahhh! The- The soldier is dead!?
Tatiana: I saw the Armored Bandit landed the killing blow! 
Tell everyone to flee!
Pup: What?
The girl began to flee herself, but turned to give 
me a wink and smile in her departure.
Charlotte: The Armored Bandit?
Charlotte: That's a boogeyman tale that is passed around as a 
rumor in noble hallways.

Why would she...?
Pup: I saw her before and was hearing about this myth. 
The soldiers were looking for that Armored Bandit,
even.
Pup: Maybe she wanted to shift the blame away from
us?
Charlotte: On us would be better, though? The nobles might 
attack this place again if they think their 
boogeyman is here.
Pup: Maybe she didn't realize?
Pup: She was pretty confident in them not finding the 
Armored Bandit, though.
Rowan: Intriguing. You don't think...?
Pup: N- No way...
Pup: Could that even be possible? For someone with her 
size and frame?
Charlotte: They do say the Armored Bandit is a giant...
All of us stood there, silent, for what was likely a 
minute but felt like much longer.
Pup: (I wonder if we'll ever meet that girl again?)

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Start
passages.content:
Norde: Yes, I'd imagine this would make for a good place 
to hunt.
Pup: It's... been a while.
Kara: I'm sure you'll find the instincts coming back.
Kara: For hunting, the first time can be the... biggest
learning curve, in a sense.
Pup: Yeah...
Charlotte: Ugh... Can we not talk about it? I'm already feeling 
a bit... Ugh...

Let's just start.

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - End of turn 1
passages.content:
Castel: Argh...!

B- Back away!
Beast: Rrargh!
Castel: I had enough to deal with already with the imperial
soldiers...!
Soldier: You're not getting away this time!
Castel: Hmph. Regardless, I am prepared for you after 
what happened before!
Castel: Behold my heirloom's might. I may specialize in red
magic, but I can also access green magic!
Castel: Summonings, go!
Shade: ...
Castel: N- Now! Protect me!
Rowan: Ah, a damsel in distress~
Charlotte: Hmm... He looks familiar.
Kara: Is that Professor Castel Balreig?
Pup: Wait... That's the Professor from the Kingdom's
capital? The one who was trying to help me control 
the curse?
Kara: I... believe so. We may need to get closer to confirm.
Charlotte: I guess we should help, then?
Defeat Condition: Pup, Rowan, Charlotte, Kara, or 
Castel dies.

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Castel TF
passages.content:
Castel: S- Stay back...!
Castel: I- I need to do something more.

Can I do another summoning? I only prepared for...
Castel: Hmph...
Castel: S- Summoning...!
Castel?: H- Huh...?!

W- What just...!?

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Talk to Castel
passages.content:
Castel: U- Uh...?!
Unknown_4294967295: Alright, we're here.
Unknown_4294967295: Alright, we're here.
Kara: Professor Balreig, we've arrived to help-!
Kara: N- No!
Kara ran over to the body of Castel lying limp on 
the ground.
Castel?: ...?
Rowan: Ah! Were we too late to save the damsel in distress?
Mariel: I'm sorry, but... there's no signs of life. No
breathing... no... anything...
Charlotte: He doesn't look... like he's... breathing.
Pup: Of... Of course...

(Time after time, we just keep...)
Castel: Ah... Lady Lyons?
Kara: ...!
Kara turned towards the figure, with fiery fingertips
ready to strike.
Castel: N- N- N- No! It's me!

I'm here. I'm Professor Balreig!
..........
Charlotte: Huh?
Norde: Why is a shade talking?
Pup: Shades... aren't those... like magical rats?
Norde: Correct.

They can mimic the silhouette of anything and are 
beast enough to have their actions controlled.

Summoners will commonly use them as a base for 
their pawns, as a result.
Kara: ...
Castel: I- I- I tried to summon another shade, and... next
thing I knew...
Kara: You somehow transferred your soul to the new body.
Castel: Yes, indeed! I did-
Castel: I did... that...
Pup: I... I'm not sure I get it.
Charlotte: Yeah, me neither. That's not exactly something I 
can imagine when compared to my engineering 
experience.
Rowan: It is quite simple, my dear friends...
Rowan: It merely means we have a damsel even more 
enchanting than before~
Rowan approached Castel in his new form.
Rowan: We shall assist you however we can.
Castel: S- Stay back!

What are... Who even are you all!? Are you the 
ones who invaded the Kingdom?!
The ethereal like form of Castel dropped into a 
mage's battle stance.
Castel: I wasn't so dumb as to not retrieve my heirloom, 
at least! I can and will fight!
Kara: ...

Professor Balreig...

Castel...

We can fix this.
Castel: ...
Castel's panicked panting subsided as he scanned 
Kara and the group.
Castel: Hah... Then... my apologies. I let myself get ahead 
of myself.

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Place Event
passages.content:
Lumberjack: If you see 3 lone beasts wandering the woods, do 
not approach them. 

They are savaged beasts that have survived the 
harshest environments. 

If you leave them alone long enough, they will 
scatter. 

If you are foolish enough to approach them, take 
my bow. Bring me some of their meat if you are 
succesful.

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Pup → Norde
passages.content:
Norde: It has been some time.
Pup: ...
Pup: Oh... were you talking to me? Some time since what?
Norde: Some time since we hunted together.

Opportunities became less and less as Ivan had the
group work within the Republic, after all.
Pup: ...Right.
I ended my thought there. I didn't want to think 
about it further.
Norde: ...
Norde: Well, I will choose to remember him, then.
Pup: ...

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Castel → Rowan
passages.content:
Rowan: What lovely hair you have cascading down your 
back~

It is like glass in its beauty.
Castel: Ugh...
Rowan: Ah! My dear, is something wrong?!
Castel: Despite my... predicament, I am still a man.
Rowan: And where, pray tell, is the problem? Such is the 
spice of life.
Castel: I am not interested!
Rowan: Alas, that was all you needed to say, as 
disheartened as I may be.

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Kara → Otis
passages.content:
Otis: So, pretty little noble lady has hunted before?
Kara: As a necessity, but yes.

And, after all, some nobles do need to hunt. Minor
ones, especially.
Otis: Well?

It get ya off-kiltered to be hurtin' them animals like
the other nobles who never had to?
Kara: Oh, I am quite neutral on the subject.

I've neither the stature of a huntswoman nor the
resolve to fight for the Goddess's creatures.
Otis: Eh. The "Goddess's creatures"? Quite 
complimentary of you to the latter in ya phrasin'.

Ya sure you're okay with killin' the critters yourself?
Kara: People will do what they must.

But if we allow ourselves to forget the ideals, then 
we lose sight of a better tomorrow.

Such is the balance of life.
Otis: We're talkin' about huntin', right?
Kara: *Giggle* ... That we are.

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Flynn → Tatiana
passages.content:
Tatiana: Eh! Get back here, ya beast!
Flynn: You need to be quieter on your approach.
Tatiana: Huh?
Flynn: You make an unnatural ruckus in that armor. I- I'm 
just saying that it scares the animals away.
Tatiana: ...
Tatiana: Gotcha. Stealth mode it is.

Thanks.
Tatiana: Now I'll hunt ya down, you annoying little...!
Tatiana clamored off... more quietly.
Flynn: Wow... So that's what it's like to teach someone 
for once.

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Satia → Atticus
passages.content:
Atticus: On your left.
Satia: You seem quite experienced in tracking prey.
Atticus: Yes... In such a remote location, supply drops often
are delayed.
Atticus: And even before the Vault, life does not always go 
the way you want.
Atticus: What of you? You also seem familiar.
Satia: I've had a similar plight at times.
Satia: Though that was small fry in comparison to these
beasts.
Satia: But it did help develop a skill I could use later with
the Crows.
Atticus: Haha... One man's crisis is another's life lesson at
times, it seems.

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Jakson → Reagyn
passages.content:
Jakson: *Sniff sniff* ...?

*Directional bark* !
Reagyn: You found one?!

Hrrraaaaaggghhh!!!
Reagyn's lance proved true to find its target.
Reagyn: Good job, boy!
Reagyn: I thought you were more of a rescue dog type 
breed, unlike our hunting dogs from back home.
Reagyn: But I guess that just means you're quite skilled at
finding things.
Jakson: *Happy bark* !

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Story
passages.content:
Our journey had taken us to many lands.
But through those trials and tribulations, a certain
truth became self evident.
Rowan: *Stomach growling*...
Charlotte: I actually heard that.
Pup: *Stomach growling*...
Charlotte: And another?!
Charlotte: I wonder if we could get them in sequence? Like a
chorus?
Norde: I think it just means we've reached lunchtime.
Mariel: That does sound nice right now.
Rowan: A splendid proposition.
Pup: Mmm...
As with our many lengthy treks, we had prepared 
rations to expedite the meal process for such a big 
group.
Flynn: ...
Otis: ...!
Taking shifts to ensure we couldn't be ambushed, 
we started during our break in our march.
Rowan: Ah, that does hit the spot at times like these~
As Rowan chowed down, I looked on from a seat 
off to the side of the wider group.
Pup: ...
It was a basic bread roll.
Pup: Hmm...
I took a bite.
Pup: ...
Pup: *Sigh*...
The blandness of it got to me.
After an extensive last few days, I felt emotionally
exhausted.
This blandness was the lack of frosting on the
metaphorical cake.
Pup: (I feel like we've had only bread for the past several
days, too.)
Apparently, my sigh was enough to attract 
attention.
Satia: Are you okay?
Charlotte: Fan of the food?
Kara: Perhaps it is due to the bread.

We've run out of some of our designated ration 
stock.
Kara seemed to be choosing her words very 
carefully. Each one a little more deliberate than I 
was used to.
Pup: (I think she's trying to be nice...)
Pup: (But regardless of that, if we're out of meat and
stuff...)
Charlotte: I guess it has been sometime since we could resupply in
a town.
Kara: Indeed. It was unfortunate that the last village's
disrupted supply lines left its stocks so depleted.
Charlotte: Where is the closest town?
Pup: Norde might know, but we don't operate a ton in 
this area.
Kara: We should have enough to get by on our current path.
Charlotte: Just trying to live on the pile of bread we have
left...
Pup: Urgh...
I turned away from the two with my ins

passages.name: Paralogue 2 - Castel recruited
passages.content:
Castel: *Pant*... Is that... all of them?
Norde: Clear in this section.
Norde: FLANK.
Uncharacteristically, Norde yelled across the
battlefield to get the all clear.
Crow: Clear over here!
The voice was difficult to hear, but audible.

I stood in my tent at camp.
In the process of changing, I found myself looking 
over my body.
I saw a face and body I had seen many times before.
I saw a face and body that was innately altered 
from journey's start.

Changes had happened, and I couldn't deny that in 
this state.
Pup: ...
Pup: (Why am I focusing on how I look?)
Pup: (I look like how I've always looked.)
Pup: That's...
Pup: It really does look longer.
It was hard to deny, my hair had grown notably. It
wasn't long, but it was longer than it was.
I brushed my hand through it quickly, and it 
flickered back and forth as its longest tips tickled 
the bottom of my neck.
My face also looked slightly different. This was 
harder to be confident in, but it felt softer to me.
I didn't have a rough looking face before, so I
squinted trying to tell if features had changed.
Pup: (I'm not imagining it, am I?)
My general frame had, however, clearly adjusted 
in a more discernable way.
I could feel that from how my clothes fit. I had to
clasp belts slightly farther down the leather.
Pup: (Is it more height loss, or...)
My eyes settled on my chest at the center of my
previous thought.
They seemed less defined, like I had gained some
weight. It was subtle.
Pup: (Slightly... puffy...?)
Those words came to mind, and I tried not to think 
of it more deeply. There was a clear implication and 
one I preferred to look elsewhere on.
Downwards, I looked over my butt and legs.
Once more I wasn't sure how much of it changed 
or if the rest of the changes reframed parts of my 
body.
Pup: (Maybe they're smaller, since... ya know...)
My penis did not appear significantly altered. Once
more, it was hard to tell, but it felt within the 
range I expected to see it at.
It was also something I was hesitant to test, even 
if I had measurements to compare against from 
before.
Pup: That's...!
My eyes were quick to scan myself from

passages.name: Intro Map - Story
passages.content:
A bedtime story? Hmm...

Have I ever told you two a tale of the 
Oathbreakers? What about the story of 
Eul'minae?
It's an old legend that goes back a millennia.

The great and respected King Minae had two 
subjects placed before him. Each claimed 
parentage of a baby.
But only one could be the true mother of the child. 
So the good king was asked to give judgement.

His edict was to split the babe in two. One half for 
each that claimed to be its mother.

The liar of the two accepted the offer. To avoid 
such tragedy, the other relented the child to the 
former.
Minae then knew the true mother. For such 
disparity of love revealed the latter to be sincere 
in her devotion.
And so comes the name Eul'minae. Named in honor 
of the wisdom King Minae showed to the world 
that day.
Hm? No, it doesn't work in reverse like that. I am 
blessed to have both of you as my children.

No matter what happens in life... No matter what 
person you may become in the future...

That will never change.

Good night, Nikolai.

Good night, Anton.
The continent of Ilvanis.
Year 813 of the modern era.

The Republic of Rabaneau...
Outskirts along the border of 
the Nolvanus Empire.
Ivan: Dead men tell no tales.
Pup: Neither does any man once they've had their 
tongue cut out.
Gk!!

Pup: There we go.
The man uttered obscenities under his breath, and 
the three of us surrounded him at a short distance.
Ivan: Let's make this simple. Name and company?
Bandit Leader: My name is the last thing you lot are getting. I can 
see the wanted posters already...
Satia: A shame. Nameless graves are often a sad sight.
Ivan: I suppose a name doesn't matter all that much.
Ivan: But you are a commanding officer of the Hell's 
Raisers mercenary corp, yes?
Bandit Leader: ...What of it?
Ivan: "What of it?"... You've made few friends in the 
past few weeks.
Ivan: Raiding... Pillaging... Though I guess that in itself is 
nothing new to you.
Pup: It's got the local governors in a panic. That much is 
certain.
Ivan: Something most would avoid. It's why the typical 
bandit raiding corp avoids staying in one place 
too long.
Ivan: I imagine you can tell where I am going with this? 
What we were hired to do?
Bandit Leader: Hmph. I thought you wanted me to sell out my 
fellow "bandits"?
Pup: (Is this guy really more willing to sell out 
his comrades than just admit what they 
were up to here?)
Pup: ...
With a few steps, I pulled my father to the side.
Pup: Let me try.
Ivan: You don't have to.
Pup: ...
Ivan: ...Very well.
Pup: Don't worry. I can do this.
Satia: Be wary over your approach. You came into this 
wanting to use it as training, after all.

It's the little things that influence how you develop 
as a warrior. As a person.

How you carry yourself will bleed into your view of 
every aspect of the world in due time.
Pup: (Yeah, but I just need to do what works. If it gets 
me results, then I'll gladly take that route.)

certain types of conflict.

everyone...

is...

promise.

Satia: It'll be okay, my little Pup... You're... You're not so

passages.name: Satia - Injured

passages.name: Rowan - Dead

impressed.
Rowan: At least... At least I could see my end... with just 
that one lingering regret...

passages.content:

Kara: To think. Here of all places... After all this... all 
this...

passages.name: Kara - Injured
passages.content:
Kara: That truly stings... If I do not have these treated,

Charlotte: Ngh!

Charlotte, please keep pushing forward... I know 
you...

passages.name: Mariel - Injured
passages.content:

passages.name: Jenny - Dead
passages.content:

I wonder if I will get back home.

passages.name: Jenny - Injured

passages.content:

make this now?

At least I did some good in my short time here. I 
wonder... if I'll get to meet that Goddess again?

passages.name: Eve - Injured
passages.content:
Eve: Ah, I don't want to die... again! Sorry everyone. I 
need to get to safety for now.

before...

passages.name: Bennett - Injured
passages.content:

passages.content:

body...?
Liebra: Ah... I wished to see the end of this story...

passages.name: Liebra - Injured
passages.content:
Liebra: Hmph... So these are the limits of this constructed 
body...?
Liebra: Then, to see the end of this story, I must retreat...

...one more taste...

payment at this point.

passages.name: Tatiana - Dead

passages.content:

passages.name: Reagyn - Injured

passages.name: Elliot - Injured
